gene:HGNC:42:function.text: ABCB11 encodes bile salt export pump. It participates in cholesterol homeostasis and lipid homeostasis.

gene:HGNC:42:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis type 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:52:function.text: ABCC10 encodes ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 10. Its functions include ABC-type glutathione S-conjugate transporter activity and ABC-type transporter activity.

gene:HGNC:52:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ABCC10 have been reported in glioblastoma, breast carcinoma, and low-grade glioma.

gene:HGNC:76:function.text: ABL1 encodes tyrosine-protein kinase ABL1. It participates in mismatch repair and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:76:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital heart defects and skeletal malformations syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:76:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ABL1 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, chronic myeloid leukemia, and b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:77:function.text: ABL2 encodes tyrosine-protein kinase ABL2. It participates in signal transduction and negative regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:77:somatic.text: ABL2 can participate in leukemia-associated rearrangements, including fusion with ETV6.

gene:HGNC:25829:function.text: ABRAXAS1 encodes BRCA1-A complex subunit Abraxas 1. It participates in regulation of DNA repair and positive regulation of DNA repair.

gene:HGNC:23844:function.text: ABTB3 encodes ankyrin repeat and BTB domain containing 3. Its functions include protein heterodimerization activity.

gene:HGNC:23844:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ABTB3 have been reported in esophageal carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:90:function.text: ACADS encodes acyl-CoA dehydrogenase short chain. Its functions include acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity and flavin adenine dinucleotide binding.

gene:HGNC:90:germline.text: Germline disease associations include short chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:90:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ACADS have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and colorectal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29609:function.text: ACP6 encodes acid phosphatase 6, lysophosphatidic. Its functions include lysophosphatidic acid phosphatase activity and lysobisphosphatidic acid metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:29609:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ACP6 have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:24174:function.text: ACSBG2 encodes acyl-CoA synthetase bubblegum family member 2. Its functions include arachidonate-CoA ligase activity and fatty acyl-CoA hydrolase activity.

gene:HGNC:24174:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ACSBG2 have been reported in papillary renal cell carcinoma and clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:132:function.text: ACTB encodes actin, cytoplasmic 1 [Cleaved into: Actin, cytoplasmic 1, N-terminally processed]. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:132:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Baraitser-Winter cerebrofrontofacial syndrome (autosomal dominant); Baraitser-Winter syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:132:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ACTB have been reported in GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing.

gene:HGNC:144:function.text: ACTG1 encodes actin, cytoplasmic 2 [Cleaved into: Actin, cytoplasmic 2, N-terminally processed]. It participates in angiogenesis and axonogenesis.

gene:HGNC:144:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Baraitser-winter syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant); nonsyndromic genetic hearing loss (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:171:function.text: ACVR1 encodes activin receptor type-1. It participates in negative regulation of signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:171:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:171:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ACVR1 have been reported in diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered, endometrial carcinoma, and high-Grade glioma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:172:function.text: ACVR1B encodes activin receptor type-1B. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:172:somatic.text: Sequence mutations in ACVR1B have been reported in pituitary tumors.

gene:HGNC:173:function.text: ACVR2A encodes activin receptor type-2A. It participates in positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:173:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ACVR2A have been reported in stomach adenocarcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17849:function.text: ADGRA2 encodes adhesion G protein-coupled receptor A2. It participates in sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial cell migration.

gene:HGNC:4512:function.text: ADGRG1 encodes adhesion G protein-coupled receptor G1 [Cleaved into: Adhesion G protein-coupled receptor G1, N-terminal fragment); Adhesion G protein-coupled receptor G1, C-terminal fragment)]. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:4512:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with bilateral frontoparietal polymicrogyria (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:4512:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ADGRG1 have been reported in CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration.

gene:HGNC:20822:function.text: ADGRL4 encodes adhesion G protein-coupled receptor L4. Its functions include calcium ion binding and G protein-coupled receptor activity.

gene:HGNC:20822:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ADGRL4 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7137:function.text: AFDN encodes afadin. It participates in signal transduction and cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:7137:somatic.text: AFDN is a fusion partner of KMT2A in acute myeloid leukemia, including rearrangements involving chromosomes 6 and 11.

gene:HGNC:7135:function.text: AFF1 encodes AF4/FMR2 family member 1. It participates in DNA-templated transcription elongation and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7135:somatic.text: AFF1 is a recurrent fusion partner of KMT2A in acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:3776:function.text: AFF2 encodes AF4/FMR2 family member 2. It participates in DNA-templated transcription elongation and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:3776:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability (x-linked); FRAXE intellectual disability (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:3776:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AFF2 have been reported in DEK::AFF2 fusion-associated sinonasal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3262:function.text: AGO1 encodes protein argonaute-1. It participates in regulatory ncRNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing and positive regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:3262:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder with language delay and behavioral abnormalities, with or without seizures (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3263:function.text: AGO2 encodes protein argonaute-2. It participates in regulatory ncRNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3263:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Lessel-Kreienkamp syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:21575:function.text: AHI1 encodes Abelson helper integration site 1. Its functions include cell surface receptor protein tyrosine kinase signaling pathway and cilium assembly.

gene:HGNC:21575:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Joubert syndrome 3 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:21575:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AHI1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:346:function.text: AHRR encodes aryl hydrocarbon receptor repressor. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and xenobiotic metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:358:function.text: AIP encodes AH receptor-interacting protein. It participates in protein maturation and protein localization to mitochondrion.

gene:HGNC:358:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with growth hormone secreting pituitary adenoma 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:391:function.text: AKT1 encodes RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:391:mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with Proteus syndrome.

gene:HGNC:391:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AKT1 have been reported in juvenile granulosa cell tumor of ovary, malignant adenomyoepithelioma of breast, and papillary carcinoma of breast, invasive.

gene:HGNC:392:function.text: AKT2 encodes RAC-beta serine/threonine-protein kinase. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:392:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hypoinsulinemic hypoglycemia and body hemihypertrophy (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:393:function.text: AKT3 encodes RAC-gamma serine/threonine-protein kinase. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:393:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes (autosomal dominant); megalencephaly-polymicrogyria-polydactyly-hydrocephalus syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:393:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AKT3 have been reported in prostate and cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:399:function.text: ALB encodes albumin. It participates in heme biosynthetic process and heme catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:399:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital analbuminemia (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:427:function.text: ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in developmental signaling, with downstream effects on cell growth, survival, and differentiation.

gene:HGNC:427:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neuroblastoma, susceptibility to, 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:427:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ALK have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and ALK-positive histiocytosis.

gene:HGNC:430:function.text: ALOX12B encodes arachidonate 12-lipoxygenase, 12R-type. It participates in lipid oxidation and lipoxygenase pathway.

gene:HGNC:430:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:20917:function.text: ALPK1 encodes alpha-protein kinase 1. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and cilium assembly.

gene:HGNC:20917:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with retinal dystrophy, optic nerve edema, splenomegaly, anhidrosis, and migraine headache syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:20917:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ALPK1 have been reported in spiradenocarcinoma and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:451:function.text: AMACR encodes alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase. It participates in bile acid biosynthetic process and bile acid metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:451:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:26837:function.text: AMER1 encodes APC membrane recruitment protein 1. It participates in positive regulation of protein ubiquitination and positive regulation of protein catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:26837:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with osteopathia striata with cranial sclerosis (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:26837:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AMER1 have been reported in Wilms tumor, colon adenocarcinoma, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:468:function.text: AMPD1 encodes adenosine monophosphate deaminase 1. Its functions include AMP deaminase activity and AMP metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:468:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AMPD1 have been reported in esophageal carcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:21316:function.text: ANKRD11 encodes ankyrin repeat domain-containing protein 11. It participates in face morphogenesis and skeletal system morphogenesis.

gene:HGNC:21316:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with KBG syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:21316:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ANKRD11 have been reported in malignant lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:29186:function.text: ANKRD26 encodes ankyrin repeat domain-containing protein 26. It participates in negative regulation of fat cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:29186:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with thrombocytopenia 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:25527:function.text: ANKZF1 encodes ankyrin repeat and zinc finger peptidyl tRNA hydrolase 1. Its functions include catalytic activity, acting on a tRNA and RNA endonuclease activity.

gene:HGNC:25527:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ANKZF1 have been reported in low-grade glioma, cutaneous melanoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:583:function.text: APC encodes a tumor-suppressor scaffold involved in the β-catenin destruction complex, helping restrain canonical Wnt signaling and regulate cellular organization.

gene:HGNC:583:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with classic or attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis (autosomal dominant); gastric adenocarcinoma and proximal polyposis of the stomach (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:583:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving APC have been reported in colorectal adenocarcinoma, small intestinal adenocarcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:339:function.text: APLNR encodes apelin receptor. It participates in vasculogenesis and aorta development.

gene:HGNC:24087:function.text: APOBR encodes apolipoprotein B receptor. Its functions include lipoprotein particle receptor activity and very-low-density lipoprotein particle receptor activity.

gene:HGNC:24087:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving APOBR have been reported in breast carcinoma, ovarian carcinoma, and cervical carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:644:function.text: AR encodes androgen receptor. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:644:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Kennedy disease (x-linked); androgen insensitivity syndrome (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:644:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AR have been reported in prostate adenocarcinoma, prostate, and cholangiocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:646:function.text: ARAF encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase A-Raf. It participates in MAPK cascade and protein modification process.

gene:HGNC:646:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARAF have been reported in erdheim–Chester disease and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:662:function.text: ARFRP1 encodes ADP-ribosylation factor-related protein 1. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular protein transport.

gene:HGNC:17073:function.text: ARHGAP26 encodes rho GTPase-activating protein 26. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:17073:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARHGAP26 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:25509:function.text: ARHGAP28 encodes Rho GTPase activating protein 28. Its functions include GTPase activator activity and negative regulation of stress fiber assembly.

gene:HGNC:25509:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARHGAP28 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, esophageal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:23085:function.text: ARHGAP33 encodes Rho GTPase activating protein 33. Its functions include GTPase activator activity and phosphatidylinositol binding.

gene:HGNC:23085:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARHGAP33 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:4591:function.text: ARHGAP35 encodes rho GTPase-activating protein 35. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and negative regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:4591:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:4591:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARHGAP35 have been reported in basal cell carcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and ovarian epithelial tumor.

gene:HGNC:676:function.text: ARHGAP6 encodes rho GTPase-activating protein 6. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:676:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARHGAP6 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:14193:function.text: ARHGEF12 encodes rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 12. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:14193:somatic.text: ARHGEF12 has been described as a fusion partner in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:30322:function.text: ARHGEF28 encodes rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 28. It participates in small GTPase-mediated signal transduction and regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:11110:function.text: ARID1A encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 1A. It participates in transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11110:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); intellectual disability, autosomal dominant 14 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11110:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARID1A have been reported in urothelial carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18040:function.text: ARID1B encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 1B. It participates in transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:18040:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); Coffin-Siris syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18040:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARID1B have been reported in undifferentiated / dedifferentiated endometrial carcinoma, biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma, and angiosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:18037:function.text: ARID2 encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 2. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:18037:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); Coffin-Siris syndrome 6 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18037:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARID2 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma, melanoma, and medulloblastoma.

gene:HGNC:3031:function.text: ARID3A encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 3A. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:14350:function.text: ARID3B encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 3B. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:21209:function.text: ARID3C encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 3C. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and macrophage differentiation.

gene:HGNC:9885:function.text: ARID4A encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 4A. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:15550:function.text: ARID4B encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 4B. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:17361:function.text: ARID5A encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 5A. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:17362:function.text: ARID5B encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 5B. It participates in transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:689:function.text: ARIH1 encodes ariadne RBR E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1. Its functions include ISG15 ligase activity and ubiquitin conjugating enzyme binding.

gene:HGNC:689:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARIH1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:27902:function.text: ARL16 encodes ARF like GTPase 16. Its functions include GTP binding and GTPase activity.

gene:HGNC:27902:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARL16 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:2720:function.text: ASAP1 encodes arf-GAP with SH3 domain, ANK repeat and PH domain-containing protein 1. It participates in cilium assembly and protein localization to cilium.

gene:HGNC:2720:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ASAP1 have been reported in CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration.

gene:HGNC:20996:function.text: ASF1B encodes anti-silencing function 1B histone chaperone. Its functions include histone binding and histone chaperone activity.

gene:HGNC:20996:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ASF1B have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:13825:function.text: ASPSCR1 encodes tether containing UBX domain for GLUT4. It participates in ERAD pathway and glucose homeostasis.

gene:HGNC:13825:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ASPSCR1 have been reported in alveolar soft part sarcoma and TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18318:function.text: ASXL1 encodes a chromatin-regulatory protein involved in controlling histone modifications and transcriptional programs, including those governing hematopoietic differentiation.

gene:HGNC:18318:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Bohring-Opitz syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18318:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ASXL1 have been reported in MDS/MPN, NOS, primary myelofibrosis, and systemic mastocytosis.

gene:HGNC:23805:function.text: ASXL2 encodes putative Polycomb group protein ASXL2. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of fat cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:23805:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Shashi-Pena syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:23805:somatic.text: Somatic ASXL2 mutations have been reported in several cancer types, including breast, bladder, pancreatic, ovarian, prostate, and hematologic tumors.

gene:HGNC:783:function.text: ATF1 encodes cyclic AMP-dependent transcription factor ATF-1. It participates in cAMP/PKA signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:783:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ATF1 have been reported in clear cell odontogenic carcinoma, clear cell sarcoma of soft tissue, and pulmonary hyalinizing clear cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:20187:function.text: ATG2B encodes autophagy-related protein 2 homolog B. It participates in glycophagy and pexophagy.

gene:HGNC:24047:function.text: ATL2 encodes atlastin-2. It participates in protein homooligomerization and endoplasmic reticulum organization.

gene:HGNC:24047:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ATL2 have been reported in cribriform adenocarcinoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:795:function.text: ATM encodes a protein kinase that coordinates DNA-damage responses, particularly following DNA double-strand breaks, through checkpoint and repair signaling.

gene:HGNC:795:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with ATM-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); ataxia telangiectasia (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:795:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ATM have been reported in mantle cell lymphoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and t-cell prolymphocytic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:804:function.text: ATP1B1 encodes sodium/potassium-transporting ATPase subunit beta-1. It participates in membrane repolarization and protein stabilization.

gene:HGNC:804:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ATP1B1 have been reported in extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:868:function.text: ATP6AP1 encodes v-type proton ATPase subunit S1. It participates in osteoclast development and vacuolar acidification.

gene:HGNC:868:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital disorder of glycosylation type II (x-linked); immunodeficiency 47 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:18305:function.text: ATP6AP2 encodes renin receptor (ATPase H(+)-transporting lysosomal accessory protein 2) (ATPase H(+)-transporting lysosomal-interacting protein 2) [Cleaved into: Renin receptor N-terminal fragment; Renin receptor C-terminal fragment]. It participates in angiotensin maturation and eye pigmentation.

gene:HGNC:18305:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with ATP6AP2-related disorder (x-linked); congenital disorder of glycosylation, type IIr (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:854:function.text: ATP6V1B2 encodes v-type proton ATPase subunit B, brain isoform. It participates in vacuolar acidification and ATP metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:882:function.text: ATR encodes a protein kinase that responds to replication stress and single-stranded DNA-associated damage to coordinate cell-cycle checkpoints and genome maintenance.

gene:HGNC:882:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Seckel syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:882:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ATR have been reported in melanoma and stomach adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:886:function.text: ATRX encodes an ATP-dependent chromatin-regulatory protein that works with DAXX in deposition of histone H3.3 and maintenance of repetitive chromatin, including telomeric regions.

gene:HGNC:886:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with ATR-X-related syndrome (x-linked); alpha-thalassemia/impaired intellectual development syndrome, X-linked (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:886:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ATRX have been reported in liposarcoma, osteosarcoma, and paraganglioma.

gene:HGNC:10555:function.text: ATXN2 encodes ataxin-2. It participates in P-body assembly and RNA transport.

gene:HGNC:10555:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with spinocerebellar ataxia type 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10560:function.text: ATXN7 encodes ataxin-7. It participates in regulation of DNA repair and regulation of RNA splicing.

gene:HGNC:10560:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with spinocerebellar ataxia 7 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:25416:function.text: ATXN7L3 encodes ataxin-7-like protein 3. It participates in regulation of DNA repair and regulation of RNA splicing.

gene:HGNC:25416:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ATXN7L3 have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11393:function.text: AURKA encodes aurora kinase A. It participates in regulation of signal transduction by p53 class mediator and cilium disassembly.

gene:HGNC:11393:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AURKA have been reported in neuroendocrine carcinoma of prostate.

gene:HGNC:11390:function.text: AURKB encodes aurora kinase B. It participates in positive regulation of telomere maintenance and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:903:function.text: AXIN1 encodes axin-1. It participates in cell development and protein-containing complex assembly.

gene:HGNC:903:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AXIN1 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma and glioblastoma multiforme.

gene:HGNC:904:function.text: AXIN2 encodes axin-2. It participates in regulation of mismatch repair and odontogenesis.

gene:HGNC:904:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with oligodontia-cancer predisposition syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:904:somatic.text: AXIN2 mutations have been reported in colorectal cancer, including mismatch-repair-deficient tumors.

gene:HGNC:905:function.text: AXL encodes tyrosine-protein kinase receptor UFO. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:914:function.text: B2M encodes beta-2-microglobulin [Cleaved into: Beta-2-microglobulin form pI 5.3]. It participates in immune response and protein homotetramerization.

gene:HGNC:914:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hypoproteinemia, hypercatabolic (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:914:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving B2M have been reported in melanoma, malignant lymphoma, and non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:25008:function.text: BABAM1 encodes BRISC and BRCA1-A complex member 1. It participates in DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling and regulation of DNA repair.

gene:HGNC:1106:function.text: BABAM2 encodes BRISC and BRCA1-A complex member 2. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA repair.

gene:HGNC:14078:function.text: BACH2 encodes transcription regulator protein BACH2. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:14078:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 60 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:950:function.text: BAP1 encodes a deubiquitinase involved in chromatin regulation and other cellular processes, including regulation of transcription and DNA-damage responses.

gene:HGNC:950:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with BAP1-related tumor predisposition syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:950:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BAP1 have been reported in mesothelioma, uveal melanoma, and meningioma, CNS WHO grade 3.

gene:HGNC:952:function.text: BARD1 encodes BRCA1-associated RING domain protein 1. It participates in DNA repair and homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:952:germline.text: Germline disease associations include BARD1-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); hereditary breast carcinoma (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17868:function.text: BBC3 encodes bcl-2-binding component 3, isoforms 3/4. It participates in apoptotic process and execution phase of apoptosis.

gene:HGNC:989:function.text: BCL10 encodes b-cell lymphoma/leukemia 10. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:989:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 37 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:989:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BCL10 have been reported in marginal zone lymphoma, malignant lymphoma, and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:13222:function.text: BCL11B encodes b-cell lymphoma/leukemia 11B. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and hematopoietic stem cell migration.

gene:HGNC:13222:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with intellectual developmental disorder with speech delay, dysmorphic facies, and t-cell abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:13222:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BCL11B have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, and acute leukemia of ambiguous lineage.

gene:HGNC:990:function.text: BCL2 encodes an anti-apoptotic mitochondrial protein that restrains activation of the intrinsic cell-death pathway.

gene:HGNC:990:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BCL2 have been reported in follicular lymphoma, diffuse large b-cell lymphoma, and DLBCL / high-grade b-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

gene:HGNC:992:function.text: BCL2L1 encodes bcl-2-like protein 1. It participates in apoptotic mitochondrial changes and regulation of cytokinesis.

gene:HGNC:992:somatic.text: BCL2L1 lies in a recurrent focal amplification region in human cancers, with evidence that amplified tumor models depend on its anti-apoptotic activity.

gene:HGNC:994:function.text: BCL2L11 encodes bcl-2-like protein 11. It participates in apoptotic process and regulation of apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:13787:function.text: BCL2L12 encodes bcl-2-like protein 12. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:995:function.text: BCL2L2 encodes bcl-2-like protein 2. It participates in spermatogenesis and regulation of apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:1001:function.text: BCL6 encodes a transcriptional repressor important for germinal-center B-cell development and regulation of differentiation and DNA-damage-response programs.

gene:HGNC:1001:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BCL6 have been reported in diffuse large b-cell lymphoma, nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, and DLBCL / high-grade b-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

gene:HGNC:20893:function.text: BCOR encodes BCL-6 corepressor. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:20893:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with microphthalmia, syndromic 2 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:20893:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BCOR have been reported in retinoblastoma, acute myeloid leukemia, and endometrial stromal sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:25657:function.text: BCORL1 encodes BCL-6 corepressor-like protein 1. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:25657:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BCORL1 have been reported in CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion, neuroblastoma, and high-Grade glioma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:1014:function.text: BCR encodes breakpoint cluster region protein. It participates in signal transduction and small GTPase-mediated signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:1014:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BCR have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, chronic myeloid leukemia, and b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:28509:function.text: BEND2 encodes BEN domain-containing protein 2. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:28509:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BEND2 have been reported in astroblastoma, MN1-altered.

gene:HGNC:19351:function.text: BICC1 encodes protein bicaudal C homolog 1. It participates in mRNA catabolic process and determination of left/right symmetry.

gene:HGNC:19351:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BICC1 have been reported in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma and small-duct intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:591:function.text: BIRC3 encodes baculoviral IAP repeat-containing protein 3. It participates in canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:591:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BIRC3 have been reported in marginal zone lymphoma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia / small lymphocytic lymphoma, and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1058:function.text: BLM encodes recQ-like DNA helicase BLM. It participates in regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity and DNA repair.

gene:HGNC:1058:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Bloom syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:24132:function.text: BMF encodes bcl-2-modifying factor. It participates in anoikis and negative regulation of autophagy.

gene:HGNC:1073:function.text: BMP6 encodes bone morphogenetic protein 6. It participates in positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:1073:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BMP6 have been reported in prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1076:function.text: BMPR1A encodes bone morphogenetic protein receptor type-1A. It participates in positive regulation of miRNA transcription and positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:1076:germline.text: Germline disease associations include juvenile polyposis syndrome (autosomal dominant); generalized juvenile polyposis/juvenile polyposis coli (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1076:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BMPR1A have been reported in stomach adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:30988:function.text: BNC2 encodes basonuclin zinc finger protein 2. Its functions include regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:30988:germline.text: Germline disease associations include lower urinary tract obstruction, congenital (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:30988:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BNC2 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, colorectal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1097:function.text: BRAF encodes a RAF-family serine/threonine kinase that relays signals through the MAPK/ERK pathway to regulate cell growth and differentiation.

gene:HGNC:1097:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1097:somatic.text: Somatic activating BRAF mutations occur in melanoma, colorectal and thyroid carcinomas, lung carcinoma, and hairy cell leukemia, among other neoplasms.

gene:HGNC:1100:function.text: BRCA1 encodes a tumor-suppressor protein that coordinates the DNA-damage response and homologous-recombination repair, including functions performed with BARD1 and other repair factors.

gene:HGNC:1100:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with BRCA1-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); Fanconi anemia, complementation group S (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:1100:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BRCA1 have been reported in high-grade serous carcinoma, tubo-ovarian / peritoneal, invasive breast carcinoma, and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1101:function.text: BRCA2 encodes a tumor-suppressor protein that loads and regulates RAD51 at damaged DNA, supporting accurate repair of double-strand breaks by homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:1101:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with BRCA2-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); Fanconi anemia complementation group D1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:1101:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BRCA2 have been reported in invasive breast carcinoma, high-grade serous carcinoma, tubo-ovarian / peritoneal, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:24185:function.text: BRCC3 encodes lys-63-specific deubiquitinase BRCC36. It participates in DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling and regulation of DNA repair.

gene:HGNC:1104:function.text: BRD3 encodes bromodomain-containing protein 3. It participates in transcription elongation-coupled chromatin remodeling and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:1104:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BRD3 have been reported in NUT carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:13575:function.text: BRD4 encodes bromodomain-containing protein 4. It participates in host-mediated suppression of viral transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:13575:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 6 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:13575:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BRD4 have been reported in NUT carcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:14310:function.text: BRD7 encodes bromodomain containing 7. Its functions include histone binding and histone H3K14ac reader activity.

gene:HGNC:14310:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BRD7 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2687:function.text: BRINP1 encodes BMP/retinoic acid inducible neural specific 1. Its functions include brain development and cellular response to retinoic acid.

gene:HGNC:2687:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BRINP1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:20473:function.text: BRIP1 encodes Fanconi anemia group J protein. It participates in DNA repair and homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:20473:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Fanconi anemia complementation group J (autosomal recessive); familial ovarian cancer (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:20473:somatic.text: Somatic BRIP1 loss-of-function mutations have been documented in ovarian carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1130:function.text: BTG1 encodes protein BTG1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:1130:somatic.text: BTG1 has been involved in chromosomal rearrangements reported in B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:1133:function.text: BTK encodes Bruton tyrosine kinase, a signaling protein important for B-cell development and transmission of B-cell antigen-receptor signals.

gene:HGNC:1133:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Bruton-type agammaglobulinemia (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:1133:somatic.text: Acquired BTK mutations are documented in chronic lymphocytic leukemia under BTK-inhibitor selective pressure. This treatment-associated somatic context is distinct from constitutional BTK loss of function causing immunodeficiency.

gene:HGNC:1149:function.text: BUB1B encodes mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine-protein kinase BUB1 beta. It participates in meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, centromeric and mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling.

gene:HGNC:1149:mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1.

gene:HGNC:33731:function.text: C3orf70 encodes chromosome 3 open reading frame 70. Its functions include circadian behavior and nervous system development.

gene:HGNC:33731:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving C3orf70 have been reported in breast carcinoma, cervical carcinoma, and bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1339:function.text: C6 encodes complement C6. Its functions include complement activation and complement activation, GZMK pathway.

gene:HGNC:1339:germline.text: Germline disease associations include complement component 6 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:1339:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving C6 have been reported in ovarian carcinoma, colorectal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1383:function.text: CA9 encodes carbonic anhydrase 9. It participates in response to hypoxia and response to testosterone.

gene:HGNC:29849:function.text: CADM2 encodes cell adhesion molecule 2. It participates in homophilic cell-cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:29849:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CADM2 have been reported in melanoma.

gene:HGNC:1455:function.text: CALR encodes calreticulin, an endoplasmic-reticulum chaperone that assists glycoprotein folding and contributes to intracellular calcium homeostasis.

gene:HGNC:1455:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CALR have been reported in primary myelofibrosis, essential thrombocythemia, and myeloproliferative neoplasm, NOS.

gene:HGNC:18806:function.text: CAMTA1 encodes calmodulin-binding transcription activator 1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:18806:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cerebellar dysfunction with variable cognitive and behavioral abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18806:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CAMTA1 have been reported in epithelioid hemangioendothelioma.

gene:HGNC:19721:function.text: CANT1 encodes calcium activated nucleotidase 1. Its functions include ADP phosphatase activity and calcium ion binding.

gene:HGNC:19721:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Desbuquois dysplasia 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:19721:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CANT1 have been reported in low-grade glioma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1476:function.text: CAPN1 encodes calpain-1 catalytic subunit. It participates in regulation of catalytic activity and proteolysis.

gene:HGNC:1476:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia type 76 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:16393:function.text: CARD11 encodes caspase recruitment domain-containing protein 11. It participates in signal transduction and canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:16393:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with BENTA disease (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 11b with atopic dermatitis (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:16393:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CARD11 have been reported in sézary syndrome, diffuse large b-cell lymphoma, and adult t-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:23393:function.text: CARM1 encodes histone-arginine methyltransferase CARM1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase I.

gene:HGNC:42872:function.text: CARMN produces a long noncoding RNA implicated in regulation of cardiac muscle cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:42872:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CARMN have been reported in glomus tumor, malignant.

gene:HGNC:1509:function.text: CASP8 encodes caspase-8 [Cleaved into: Caspase-8 subunit p18; Caspase-8 subunit p10]. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:1509:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome type 2B (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:1509:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CASP8 have been reported in basal cell carcinoma, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and stomach adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1537:function.text: CBFA2T3 encodes transcriptional corepressor CBFA2T3. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:1537:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CBFA2T3 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:1539:function.text: CBFB encodes core-binding factor subunit beta. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:1539:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cleidocranial dysplasia 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1539:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CBFB have been reported in myeloid sarcoma, acute myeloid leukemia, and invasive breast carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1541:function.text: CBL encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase CBL. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:1541:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with CBL-related disorder (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1541:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CBL have been reported in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:1542:function.text: CBLB encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase CBL-B. It participates in signal transduction and protein stabilization.

gene:HGNC:1542:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CBLB have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18782:function.text: CCDC6 encodes coiled-coil domain-containing protein 6. It participates in positive regulation of SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:18782:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CCDC6 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, papillary thyroid carcinoma, and basal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12771:function.text: CCN6 encodes cellular communication network factor 6. It participates in signal transduction and cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:12771:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with progressive pseudorheumatoid arthropathy of childhood (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:18709:function.text: CCNB3 encodes G2/mitotic-specific cyclin-B3. It participates in G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle.

gene:HGNC:18709:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CCNB3 have been reported in sarcoma with BCOR genetic alterations.

gene:HGNC:1582:function.text: CCND1 encodes G1/S-specific cyclin-D1. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and liver development.

gene:HGNC:1582:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CCND1 have been reported in mucosal melanoma, cutaneous melanoma, and plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:1583:function.text: CCND2 encodes G1/S-specific cyclin-D2. It participates in negative regulation of apoptotic process and G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle.

gene:HGNC:1583:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with megalencephaly-polymicrogyria-polydactyly-hydrocephalus syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1583:somatic.text: CCND2 rearrangements, often involving immunoglobulin regulatory elements, occur in a subset of cyclin D1-negative mantle cell lymphomas.

gene:HGNC:1585:function.text: CCND3 encodes G1/S-specific cyclin-D3. It participates in G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle and positive regulation of G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle.

gene:HGNC:1585:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CCND3 have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma, splenic diffuse red pulp small b-cell lymphoma, and malignant lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:1589:function.text: CCNE1 encodes G1/S-specific cyclin-E1. It participates in protein phosphorylation and G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle.

gene:HGNC:1589:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CCNE1 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and esophageal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:28434:function.text: CCNQ encodes cyclin-Q. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of cell cycle G2/M phase transition.

gene:HGNC:28434:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndactyly-telecanthus-anogenital and renal malformations syndrome (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:1605:function.text: CCR4 encodes C-C chemokine receptor type 4. It participates in chemotaxis and calcium-mediated signaling.

gene:HGNC:1605:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CCR4 have been reported in sézary syndrome and adult t-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:1623:function.text: CCT8 encodes chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 8. Its functions include ATP hydrolysis activity and ATP-dependent protein folding chaperone.

gene:HGNC:1623:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CCT8 have been reported in low-grade glioma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17635:function.text: CD274 encodes programmed cell death 1 ligand 1. It participates in signal transduction and immune response.

gene:HGNC:17635:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CD274 have been reported in classic Hodgkin lymphoma, primary mediastinal large b-cell lymphoma, and t-cell/histiocyte-rich large b-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:19137:function.text: CD276 encodes CD276 antigen. It participates in T cell activation and regulation of cytokine production.

gene:HGNC:1653:function.text: CD28 encodes t-cell-specific surface glycoprotein CD28. It participates in T cell activation and T cell costimulation.

gene:HGNC:1653:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CD28 have been reported in adult t-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:1662:function.text: CD34 encodes hematopoietic progenitor cell antigen CD34. It participates in signal transduction and hemopoiesis.

gene:HGNC:1688:function.text: CD58 encodes lymphocyte function-associated antigen 3. It participates in signal transduction and cell-cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:1688:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CD58 have been reported in diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:1695:function.text: CD7 encodes t-cell antigen CD7. It participates in immune response and T cell activation.

gene:HGNC:11937:function.text: CD70 encodes CD70 antigen. It participates in B cell proliferation and CD27 signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:11937:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with severe combined immunodeficiency due to CD70 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:1697:function.text: CD74 encodes HLA class II histocompatibility antigen gamma chain [Cleaved into: Class-II-associated invariant chain peptide]. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator.

gene:HGNC:1697:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CD74 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1698:function.text: CD79A encodes b-cell antigen receptor complex-associated protein alpha chain. It participates in B cell activation and B cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:1698:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with agammaglobulinemia 3, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:1699:function.text: CD79B encodes b-cell antigen receptor complex-associated protein beta chain. It participates in signal transduction and immune response.

gene:HGNC:1699:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with agammaglobulinemia 6, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:1699:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CD79B have been reported in diffuse large b-cell lymphoma, intravascular large b-cell lymphoma, and large b-cell lymphoma of immune-privileged sites.

gene:HGNC:1736:function.text: CDC42 encodes cell division control protein 42 homolog. It participates in signal transduction and endocytosis.

gene:HGNC:1736:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Takenouchi-Kosaki syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:16783:function.text: CDC73 encodes parafibromin. It participates in transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:16783:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hyperparathyroidism 2 with jaw tumors (autosomal dominant); parathyroid gland carcinoma (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:16783:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDC73 have been reported in parathyroid carcinoma and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:30777:function.text: CDCA7L encodes cell division cycle-associated 7-like protein. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of cell population proliferation.

gene:HGNC:1748:function.text: CDH1 encodes cadherin-1 [Cleaved into: E-Cad/CTF1; E-Cad/CTF2; E-Cad/CTF3]. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:1748:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with CDH1-related diffuse gastric and lobular breast cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant); blepharocheilodontic syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1748:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDH1 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma, invasive lobular carcinoma of breast, and stomach adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1750:function.text: CDH11 encodes cadherin-11. It participates in ossification and cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:1750:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Elsahy-Waters syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:1750:somatic.text: CDH11 can act as a promoter-donating partner in USP6 rearrangements in primary aneurysmal bone cysts. This fusion context is distinct from an arbitrary CDH11 sequence alteration.

gene:HGNC:1763:function.text: CDH4 encodes cadherin-4. It participates in cell adhesion and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:24224:function.text: CDK12 encodes cyclin-dependent kinase 12. It participates in regulation of MAP kinase activity and RNA splicing.

gene:HGNC:24224:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDK12 have been reported in prostate adenocarcinoma, melanoma, and prostate.

gene:HGNC:1773:function.text: CDK4 encodes cyclin-dependent kinase 4. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of transcription initiation by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:1773:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with melanoma, cutaneous malignant, susceptibility to, 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1773:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDK4 have been reported in liposarcoma, osteosarcoma, and intimal sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:1777:function.text: CDK6 encodes cyclin-dependent kinase 6. It participates in signal transduction and gliogenesis.

gene:HGNC:1777:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDK6 have been reported in medulloblastoma.

gene:HGNC:1779:function.text: CDK8 encodes cyclin-dependent kinase 8. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:1779:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with intellectual developmental disorder with hypotonia and behavioral abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1779:somatic.text: CDK8 amplification and increased activity have been described in colorectal cancer, with experimental evidence linking CDK8 to beta-catenin-dependent tumor-cell proliferation. This amplification-associated context is distinct from an isolated sequence variant.

gene:HGNC:1784:function.text: CDKN1A encodes cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1. It participates in positive regulation of protein kinase activity and Ras protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:1784:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDKN1A have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma and bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1785:function.text: CDKN1B encodes cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1B. It participates in regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity and DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator.

gene:HGNC:1785:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 4 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1785:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDKN1B have been reported in jejunoileal neuroendocrine tumor, plasma cell myeloma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1786:function.text: CDKN1C encodes cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1C. It participates in negative regulation of epithelial cell proliferation and negative regulation of G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle.

gene:HGNC:1786:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome due to CDKN1C mutation (autosomal dominant); Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1787:function.text: CDKN2A produces distinct tumor-suppressor proteins through alternative transcripts: p16INK4A regulates CDK4/6–RB signaling, while p14ARF influences the MDM2–p53 pathway.

gene:HGNC:1787:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with melanoma-pancreatic cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1787:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDKN2A have been reported in thymoma, chordoma, and angiosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:1788:function.text: CDKN2B encodes cyclin-dependent kinase 4 inhibitor B. It participates in cellular senescence and megakaryocyte differentiation.

gene:HGNC:1788:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDKN2B have been reported in meningioma, CNS WHO grade 3 and biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:34341:function.text: CDKN2B-AS1 produces an antisense long noncoding RNA at the CDKN2A/CDKN2B locus that interacts with chromatin-regulatory complexes and can influence expression of neighboring cell-cycle regulators.

gene:HGNC:1789:function.text: CDKN2C encodes cyclin-dependent kinase 4 inhibitor C. It participates in oligodendrocyte differentiation and negative regulation of cell growth.

gene:HGNC:1789:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDKN2C have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma and low-Grade glioma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:1806:function.text: CDX2 encodes homeobox protein CDX-2. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:1806:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CDX2 have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma and esophageal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1833:function.text: CEBPA encodes a basic leucine-zipper transcription factor that regulates differentiation programs, including granulocytic maturation, and can influence cell-cycle control.

gene:HGNC:1833:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with acute myeloid leukemia (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1833:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CEBPA have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:1850:function.text: CELSR1 encodes cadherin EGF LAG seven-pass G-type receptor 1. Its functions include calcium ion binding and G protein-coupled receptor activity.

gene:HGNC:1850:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CELSR1 have been reported in glioblastoma, ovarian carcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1851:function.text: CENPA encodes histone H3-like centromeric protein A. It participates in kinetochore assembly and mitotic cytokinesis.

gene:HGNC:17012:function.text: CEP43 encodes centrosomal protein 43. It participates in negative regulation of protein kinase activity and microtubule anchoring.

gene:HGNC:25815:function.text: CEP63 encodes centrosomal protein 63. Its functions include molecular adaptor activity and centriole replication.

gene:HGNC:25815:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Seckel syndrome 6 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:25815:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CEP63 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, colorectal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:25907:function.text: CEP89 encodes centrosomal protein 89. Its functions include chemical synaptic transmission and cilium assembly.

gene:HGNC:25907:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CEP89 have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and chromophobe renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29523:function.text: CFAP20 encodes cilia and flagella associated protein 20. Its functions include cilium assembly and flagellated sperm motility.

gene:HGNC:29523:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CFAP20 have been reported in breast carcinoma, cervical carcinoma, and colorectal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:25631:function.text: CFAP44 encodes cilia and flagella associated protein 44. Its functions include peptidase activity and microtubule cytoskeleton organization.

gene:HGNC:25631:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CFAP44 have been reported in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:27028:function.text: CFAP90 encodes cilia and flagella associated protein 90. Its functions include flagellated sperm motility.

gene:HGNC:27028:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CFAP90 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1917:function.text: CHD2 encodes ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler CHD2. It participates in nucleosome organization and muscle organ development.

gene:HGNC:1917:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 94 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1917:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHD2 have been reported in gastrointestinal stromal tumor and chronic lymphocytic leukemia/Small lymphocytic lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:1918:function.text: CHD3 encodes chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 3. Its functions include ATP hydrolysis activity and ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity.

gene:HGNC:1918:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Snijders Blok-Campeau syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1918:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHD3 have been reported in low-grade glioma, lung adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1919:function.text: CHD4 encodes ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler CHD4. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:1919:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Sifrim-Hitz-Weiss syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1919:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHD4 have been reported in DEK::AFF2 fusion-associated sinonasal carcinoma, colon adenocarcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:20626:function.text: CHD7 encodes ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler CHD7. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and cognition.

gene:HGNC:20626:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with CHARGE syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:20626:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHD7 have been reported in CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration.

gene:HGNC:1925:function.text: CHEK1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase Chk1. It participates in DNA repair and signal transduction in response to DNA damage.

gene:HGNC:16627:function.text: CHEK2 encodes the CHK2 checkpoint kinase, which transmits DNA-damage signals to regulators of cell-cycle progression and other stress responses.

gene:HGNC:16627:germline.text: Germline disease associations include CHEK2-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:16627:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHEK2 have been reported in biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1935:function.text: CHIC2 encodes cysteine-rich hydrophobic domain-containing protein 2. Its functions include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and protein complex scaffold activity.

gene:HGNC:1936:function.text: CHIT1 encodes chitinase 1. Its functions include chitin binding and chitinase activity.

gene:HGNC:1936:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHIT1 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17423:function.text: CHST12 encodes carbohydrate sulfotransferase 12. Its functions include 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate binding and chondroitin 4-sulfotransferase activity.

gene:HGNC:17423:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHST12 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:14214:function.text: CIC encodes protein capicua homolog. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:14214:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 45 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:14214:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CIC have been reported in CIC-rearranged sarcoma, CNS CIC-rearranged sarcoma, and oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted.

gene:HGNC:7067:function.text: CIITA encodes MHC class II transactivator. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7067:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with MHC class II deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7067:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CIITA have been reported in primary mediastinal large b-cell lymphoma and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:1987:function.text: CITED2 encodes cbp/p300-interacting transactivator 2. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:16744:function.text: CIZ1 encodes CDKN1A interacting zinc finger protein 1. Its functions include nucleic acid binding and zinc ion binding.

gene:HGNC:16744:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CIZ1 have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:19083:function.text: CKS1B encodes cyclin-dependent kinases regulatory subunit 1. It participates in mitotic cell cycle phase transition.

gene:HGNC:2039:function.text: CLDN18 encodes claudin-18. It participates in organ growth and calcium-independent cell-cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:2039:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CLDN18 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:19832:function.text: CLEC14A encodes C-type lectin domain containing 14A. Its functions include extracellular matrix binding and extracellular matrix protein binding.

gene:HGNC:19832:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CLEC14A have been reported in glioblastoma, cutaneous melanoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:24462:function.text: CLECL1 encodes C-type lectin like 1. Its functions include signaling receptor activity and B cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:24462:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CLECL1 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10461:function.text: CLIP1 encodes CAP-Gly domain-containing linker protein 1. It participates in cytoplasmic microtubule organization and microtubule bundle formation.

gene:HGNC:2092:function.text: CLTC encodes clathrin heavy chain 1. It participates in chromosome segregation and clathrin-dependent endocytosis.

gene:HGNC:2092:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 56 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2092:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CLTC have been reported in ALK-positive histiocytosis, ALK-positive large b-cell lymphoma, and cholangiocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:25635:function.text: CMTR2 encodes cap-specific mRNA (nucleoside-2'-O-)-methyltransferase 2. It participates in 7-methylguanosine mRNA capping.

gene:HGNC:25635:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CMTR2 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10445:function.text: CNOT9 encodes CCR4-NOT transcription complex subunit 9. Its functions include epidermal growth factor receptor binding and kinase binding.

gene:HGNC:10445:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CNOT9 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:22199:function.text: COBL encodes cordon-bleu WH2 repeat protein. Its functions include actin monomer binding and actin filament network formation.

gene:HGNC:22199:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving COBL have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2188:function.text: COL12A1 encodes collagen alpha-1(XII) chain. It participates in collagen fibril organization and endodermal cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:2188:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Ullrich congenital muscular dystrophy 2 (autosomal recessive); Bethlem myopathy 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2197:function.text: COL1A1 encodes collagen alpha-1(I) chain. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and osteoblast differentiation.

gene:HGNC:2197:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with COL1A1-related Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (autosomal dominant); Caffey disease (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2197:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving COL1A1 have been reported in COL1A1::PDGFB fusion-associated uterine sarcoma, dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, fibrosarcomatous, and melanoma.

gene:HGNC:2198:function.text: COL1A2 encodes collagen alpha-2(I) chain. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and odontogenesis.

gene:HGNC:2198:germline.text: Germline disease associations include COL1A2-related Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (autosomal dominant); COL1A2-related osteogenesis imperfecta (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2198:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving COL1A2 have been reported in ALK-positive histiocytosis.

gene:HGNC:17025:function.text: COL21A1 encodes collagen alpha-1(XXI) chain. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:2213:function.text: COL6A3 encodes collagen alpha-3(VI) chain. It participates in muscle organ development and response to glucose.

gene:HGNC:2213:germline.text: Germline disease associations include collagen 6-related myopathy (autosomal dominant); collagen 6-related myopathy (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2213:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving COL6A3 have been reported in melanoma.

gene:HGNC:2214:function.text: COL7A1 encodes collagen alpha-1(VII) chain. It participates in cell adhesion and epidermis development.

gene:HGNC:2214:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (autosomal recessive); dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17440:function.text: COP1 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase COP1. It participates in protein ubiquitination and response to ionizing radiation.

gene:HGNC:2334:function.text: CR1 encodes complement C3b/C4b receptor 1 (Knops blood group). Its functions include complement component C3b binding and complement component C3b receptor activity.

gene:HGNC:2334:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CR1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and colorectal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2343:function.text: CRB1 encodes crumbs cell polarity complex component 1. Its functions include calcium ion binding and cell-cell signaling.

gene:HGNC:2343:germline.text: Germline disease associations include inherited retinal dystrophy (autosomal recessive); Leber congenital amaurosis 8 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2343:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CRB1 have been reported in esophageal carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:30185:function.text: CRBN encodes protein cereblon. It participates in protein ubiquitination and locomotory exploration behavior.

gene:HGNC:2345:function.text: CREB1 encodes cyclic AMP-responsive element-binding protein 1. It participates in signal transduction and cAMP/PKA signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:2345:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CREB1 have been reported in clear cell odontogenic carcinoma, primary pulmonary myxoid sarcoma, and clear cell sarcoma of soft tissue.

gene:HGNC:18856:function.text: CREB3L1 encodes cyclic AMP-responsive element-binding protein 3-like protein 1 [Cleaved into: Processed cyclic AMP-responsive element-binding protein 3-like protein 1]. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:18856:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CREB3L1 have been reported in low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma and sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:23720:function.text: CREB3L2 encodes cyclic AMP-responsive element-binding protein 3-like protein 2 [Cleaved into: Processed cyclic AMP-responsive element-binding protein 3-like protein 2]. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:23720:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CREB3L2 have been reported in low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma and sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:2348:function.text: CREBBP encodes the CBP transcriptional coactivator and acetyltransferase, which modifies histones and other proteins to regulate gene expression.

gene:HGNC:2348:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome (autosomal dominant); Menke-Hennekam syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2348:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CREBBP have been reported in retinoblastoma, follicular lymphoma, and diffuse large b-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:2352:function.text: CREM encodes cAMP-responsive element modulator. It participates in signal transduction and cAMP/PKA signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:2352:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CREM have been reported in hyalinizing clear cell carcinoma of salivary gland and intracranial mesenchymal tumor, FET::CREB fusion-positive.

gene:HGNC:2363:function.text: CRKL encodes crk-like protein. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:14281:function.text: CRLF2 encodes cytokine receptor-like factor 2. It participates in cytokine-mediated signaling pathway and positive regulation of interleukin-5 production.

gene:HGNC:14281:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CRLF2 have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:15762:function.text: CRNKL1 encodes crooked neck pre-mRNA splicing factor 1. Its functions include mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and spliceosomal complex assembly.

gene:HGNC:15762:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CRNKL1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:16062:function.text: CRTC1 encodes CREB-regulated transcription coactivator 1. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and protein homotetramerization.

gene:HGNC:16062:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CRTC1 have been reported in hidradenocarcinoma, mucoepidermoid carcinoma of breast, and pulmonary mucoepidermoid carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:26148:function.text: CRTC3 encodes CREB-regulated transcription coactivator 3. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and macrophage activation.

gene:HGNC:26148:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CRTC3 have been reported in pulmonary mucoepidermoid carcinoma and mucoepidermoid carcinoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:29905:function.text: CSDE1 encodes cold shock domain-containing protein E1. It participates in CRD-mediated mRNA stabilization and male gonad development.

gene:HGNC:29905:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).
