gene:HGNC:2432:function.text: CSF1 encodes macrophage colony-stimulating factor 1 [Cleaved into: Processed macrophage colony-stimulating factor 1; Macrophage colony-stimulating factor 1 43 kDa subunit]. It participates in macrophage differentiation and monocyte activation.

gene:HGNC:2433:function.text: CSF1R encodes macrophage colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor. It participates in positive regulation of protein tyrosine kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:2433:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with brain abnormalities, neurodegeneration, and dysosteosclerosis (autosomal recessive); leukoencephalopathy, diffuse hereditary, with spheroids 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2433:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CSF1R have been reported in invasive breast carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2439:function.text: CSF3R encodes granulocyte colony-stimulating factor receptor. It participates in signal transduction and amelogenesis.

gene:HGNC:2439:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal recessive severe congenital neutropenia due to CSF3R deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2439:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CSF3R have been reported in chronic neutrophilic leukemia and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:2451:function.text: CSNK1A1 encodes casein kinase I isoform alpha. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:2467:function.text: CSPG5 encodes chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan 5. Its functions include growth factor activity and axon regeneration.

gene:HGNC:2467:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CSPG5 have been reported in ovarian carcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:13723:function.text: CTCF encodes transcriptional repressor CTCF. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:13723:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); CTCF-related neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:13723:somatic.text: CTCF mutations have been reported in invasive breast cancer, prostate cancer, and Wilms tumor.

gene:HGNC:2505:function.text: CTLA4 encodes cytotoxic T-lymphocyte protein 4. It participates in immune response and DNA damage response.

gene:HGNC:2505:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome due to CTLA4 haploinsufficiency (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2505:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CTLA4 have been reported in adult t-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:2509:function.text: CTNNA1 encodes catenin alpha-1. It participates in axon regeneration and cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:2509:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with CTNNA1-related diffuse gastric and lobular breast cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant); hereditary macular dystrophy (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2514:function.text: CTNNB1 encodes β-catenin, a protein with roles in cell adhesion and canonical Wnt signaling; regulated stabilization permits transcriptional effects through TCF/LEF factors.

gene:HGNC:2514:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with CTNNB1-related neurodevelopmental disorder and/or vitreoretinopathy (autosomal dominant); severe intellectual disability-progressive spastic diplegia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2514:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CTNNB1 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma, combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma, and endometrioid carcinoma of endometrium.

gene:HGNC:16850:function.text: CTR9 encodes RNA polymerase-associated protein CTR9 homolog. It participates in chromatin organization and transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:2553:function.text: CUL3 encodes cullin-3. It participates in negative regulation of Rho protein signal transduction and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:2553:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); pseudohypoaldosteronism type 2E (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2553:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CUL3 have been reported in renal cell carcinoma, lung squamous cell carcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2557:function.text: CUX1 encodes homeobox protein cut-like 1 [Cleaved into: CDP/Cux p110]. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:2557:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); global developmental delay with or without impaired intellectual development (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2557:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CUX1 have been reported in melanoma, glioblastoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2561:function.text: CXCR4 encodes C-X-C chemokine receptor type 4. It participates in neurogenesis and apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:2561:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with WHIM syndrome (autosomal dominant); WHIM syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2561:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CXCR4 have been reported in lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:26943:function.text: CXXC5 encodes CXXC-type zinc finger protein 5. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:26943:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CXXC5 have been reported in astroblastoma, MN1-altered and CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion.

gene:HGNC:2584:function.text: CYLD encodes ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase CYLD. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:2584:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Brooke-Spiegler syndrome (autosomal dominant); familial cylindromatosis (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2584:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CYLD have been reported in cylindrocarcinoma, spiradenocarcinoma, and follicular dendritic cell sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:2594:function.text: CYP19A1 encodes aromatase. It participates in androgen catabolic process and estrogen biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:2594:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with aromatase deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2610:function.text: CYP2A6 encodes cytochrome P450 2A6). It participates in coumarin catabolic process and coumarin metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:2622:function.text: CYP2C8 encodes cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily C member 8. Its functions include arachidonate 11,12-epoxygenase activity and arachidonate 14,15-epoxygenase activity.

gene:HGNC:2622:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CYP2C8 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:2642:function.text: CYP4A11 encodes cytochrome P450 family 4 subfamily A member 11. Its functions include alkane 1-monooxygenase activity and arachidonate epoxygenase activity.

gene:HGNC:2642:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CYP4A11 have been reported in breast carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2652:function.text: CYP7B1 encodes cytochrome P450 family 7 subfamily B member 1. Its functions include 24S-hydroxycholesterol 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity and 25-hydroxycholesterol 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity.

gene:HGNC:2652:germline.text: Germline disease associations include CYP7B1-related disorder of oxysterol accumulation (autosomal recessive); congenital bile acid synthesis defect 3 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2652:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CYP7B1 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18274:function.text: CYSLTR2 encodes cysteinyl leukotriene receptor 2. It participates in immune response and neuropeptide signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:18274:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CYSLTR2 have been reported in uveal melanoma.

gene:HGNC:2681:function.text: DAXX encodes a histone chaperone and regulatory protein that participates with ATRX in histone H3.3 deposition and chromatin maintenance.

gene:HGNC:2681:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DAXX have been reported in oncocytic thyroid carcinoma, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, and pancreas.

gene:HGNC:24535:function.text: DCAF13 encodes DDB1 and CUL4 associated factor 13. Its functions include nuclear estrogen receptor binding and ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity.

gene:HGNC:24535:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DCAF13 have been reported in breast carcinoma, esophageal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17642:function.text: DCLRE1C encodes protein artemis. It participates in telomere maintenance and interstrand cross-link repair.

gene:HGNC:17642:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with severe combined immunodeficiency due to DCLRE1C deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2711:function.text: DCTN1 encodes dynactin subunit 1. It participates in centriole-centriole cohesion and cholesterol homeostasis.

gene:HGNC:2711:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Perry syndrome (autosomal dominant); amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2711:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DCTN1 have been reported in ALK-positive histiocytosis.

gene:HGNC:18184:function.text: DCUN1D1 encodes DCN1-like protein 1. It participates in regulation of protein neddylation and regulation of protein ubiquitination.

gene:HGNC:2717:function.text: DDB1 encodes DNA damage-binding protein 1. It participates in DNA repair and spermatogenesis.

gene:HGNC:2717:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with White-Kernohan syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2718:function.text: DDB2 encodes DNA damage-binding protein 2. It participates in DNA repair and nucleotide-excision repair.

gene:HGNC:2718:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with xeroderma pigmentosum group E (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2718:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DDB2 have been reported in bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2726:function.text: DDIT3 encodes CHOP, a stress-responsive transcription factor that participates in endoplasmic-reticulum stress signaling and regulation of cellular differentiation and apoptosis.

gene:HGNC:2726:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DDIT3 have been reported in liposarcoma and GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing.

gene:HGNC:2731:function.text: DDR2 encodes discoidin domain-containing receptor 2. It participates in positive regulation of protein kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:2731:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia-short limb-abnormal calcification syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:17330:function.text: DDX28 encodes DEAD-box helicase 28. Its functions include ATP hydrolysis activity and RNA helicase activity.

gene:HGNC:17330:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DDX28 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:2745:function.text: DDX3X encodes ATP-dependent RNA helicase DDX3X. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and negative regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:2745:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked syndromic intellectual disability (x-linked); intellectual disability, X-linked 102 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:2745:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DDX3X have been reported in aggressive NK-cell leukemia, extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, and cribriform adenocarcinoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:18674:function.text: DDX41 encodes a DEAD-box helicase-family protein implicated in RNA processing and cellular nucleic-acid sensing.

gene:HGNC:18674:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with DDX41-related hematologic malignancy predisposition syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18674:somatic.text: Acquired DDX41 mutations occur in myeloid neoplasms, including myelodysplastic neoplasms and acute myeloid leukemia, and may coexist with an inherited predisposing allele.

gene:HGNC:2768:function.text: DEK encodes protein DEK. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:2768:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DEK have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia and DEK::AFF2 fusion-associated sinonasal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2770:function.text: DES encodes desmin. It participates in cytoskeleton organization and muscle contraction.

gene:HGNC:2770:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with dilated cardiomyopathy 1I (autosomal dominant); myofibrillar myopathy 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2847:function.text: DGCR8 encodes microprocessor complex subunit DGCR8. It participates in DNA damage response and primary miRNA processing.

gene:HGNC:2847:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DGCR8 have been reported in Wilms tumor, pineoblastoma, and wilms' tumor.

gene:HGNC:16985:function.text: DHRS4 encodes dehydrogenase/reductase 4. Its functions include 3-beta-hydroxy-5-beta-steroid dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity and 3-beta-hydroxysteroid 3-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity.

gene:HGNC:16985:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DHRS4 have been reported in medulloblastoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:2738:function.text: DHX15 encodes ATP-dependent RNA helicase DHX15. It participates in RNA splicing and mRNA splicing, via spliceosome.

gene:HGNC:17098:function.text: DICER1 encodes endoribonuclease Dicer. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and miRNA processing.

gene:HGNC:17098:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with DICER1-related tumor predisposition (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17098:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DICER1 have been reported in pineoblastoma, thyroblastoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:20604:function.text: DIS3 encodes exosome complex exonuclease RRP44. It participates in RNA processing and rRNA processing.

gene:HGNC:20604:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DIS3 have been reported in plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:28648:function.text: DIS3L2 encodes DIS3-like exonuclease 2. It participates in mRNA catabolic process and miRNA catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:28648:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Perlman syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2890:function.text: DKC1 encodes H/ACA ribonucleoprotein complex subunit DKC1. It participates in telomere maintenance via telomerase and positive regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase.

gene:HGNC:2890:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with DKC1-related disorder (x-linked); dyskeratosis congenita, X-linked (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:2907:function.text: DLK1 encodes protein delta homolog 1 [Cleaved into: Fetal antigen 1]. It participates in cell differentiation and negative regulation of ossification.

gene:HGNC:2927:function.text: DMC1 encodes meiotic recombination protein DMC1 homolog. It participates in spermatogenesis and mitotic recombination.

gene:HGNC:2934:function.text: DMRT1 encodes doublesex- and mab-3-related transcription factor 1. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:2934:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with 46 XY differences of sex development (autosomal dominant); spermatogenic failure (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2934:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DMRT1 have been reported in spermatocytic tumor.

gene:HGNC:2942:function.text: DNAH11 encodes dynein axonemal heavy chain 11. It participates in flagellated sperm motility and determination of left/right symmetry.

gene:HGNC:2942:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with primary ciliary dyskinesia 7 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2953:function.text: DNAH9 encodes dynein axonemal heavy chain 9. Its functions include dynein intermediate chain binding and dynein light intermediate chain binding.

gene:HGNC:2953:germline.text: Germline disease associations include ciliary dyskinesia, primary, 40 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2953:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DNAH9 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and esophageal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:5270:function.text: DNAJB1 encodes dnaJ homolog subfamily B member 1. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and forebrain development.

gene:HGNC:5270:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DNAJB1 have been reported in fibrolamellar carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:27030:function.text: DNAJC21 encodes dnaJ homolog subfamily C member 21. It participates in protein folding.

gene:HGNC:27030:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with bone marrow failure syndrome 3 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:2976:function.text: DNMT1 encodes DNA (cytosine-5)-methyltransferase 1. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and DNA methylation-dependent constitutive heterochromatin formation.

gene:HGNC:2976:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia, deafness and narcolepsy (autosomal dominant); hereditary sensory neuropathy-deafness-dementia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2978:function.text: DNMT3A encodes a de novo DNA methyltransferase that establishes cytosine methylation patterns and helps regulate chromatin state, gene expression, and cellular differentiation.

gene:HGNC:2978:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Tatton-Brown-Rahman overgrowth syndrome (autosomal dominant); Heyn-Sproul-Jackson syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:2978:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DNMT3A have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplastic syndromes, and peripheral t-cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:2979:function.text: DNMT3B encodes DNA (cytosine-5)-methyltransferase 3B. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of gene expression.

gene:HGNC:2979:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency-centromeric instability-facial anomalies syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:19191:function.text: DOCK8 encodes dedicator of cytokinesis protein 8. It participates in small GTPase-mediated signal transduction and regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:19191:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with combined immunodeficiency due to DOCK8 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:24948:function.text: DOT1L encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase, H3 lysine-79 specific. It participates in DNA repair and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:24948:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DOT1L have been reported in neuroblastoma and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:17904:function.text: DROSHA encodes ribonuclease 3. It participates in pre-miRNA processing and rRNA processing.

gene:HGNC:17904:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DROSHA have been reported in Wilms tumor, pineoblastoma, and wilms' tumor.

gene:HGNC:20277:function.text: DTD2 encodes D-aminoacyl-tRNA deacylase 2. Its functions include Ala-tRNA(Thr) deacylase activity and D-aminoacyl-tRNA deacylase activity.

gene:HGNC:20277:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DTD2 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and adrenocortical carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3060:function.text: DTX1 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase DTX1. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3060:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DTX1 have been reported in chronic lymphocytic leukemia/Small lymphocytic lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:17909:function.text: DUSP16 encodes dual specificity phosphatase 16. Its functions include JUN kinase binding and MAP kinase tyrosine phosphatase activity.

gene:HGNC:17909:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DUSP16 have been reported in breast carcinoma, colorectal carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3068:function.text: DUSP2 encodes dual specificity protein phosphatase 2. It participates in signal transduction and endoderm formation.

gene:HGNC:3068:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DUSP2 have been reported in t-cell/histiocyte-rich large b-cell lymphoma and nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:16077:function.text: DUSP22 encodes dual specificity protein phosphatase 22. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:16077:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DUSP22 have been reported in primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:3070:function.text: DUSP4 encodes dual specificity protein phosphatase 4. It participates in signal transduction and dephosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:50800:function.text: DUX4 encodes double homeobox protein 4. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:50800:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DUX4 have been reported in CIC-rearranged sarcoma, CNS CIC-rearranged sarcoma, and b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:3115:function.text: E2F3 encodes transcription factor E2F3. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and transcription initiation at RNA polymerase II promoter.

gene:HGNC:3115:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving E2F3 have been reported in urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:19090:function.text: EBF2 encodes EBF transcription factor 2. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

gene:HGNC:19090:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EBF2 have been reported in glioblastoma, cutaneous melanoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3188:function.text: EED encodes polycomb protein EED. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3188:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Cohen-Gibson syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3188:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EED have been reported in malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

gene:HGNC:25789:function.text: EFL1 encodes elongation factor-like GTPase 1. It participates in GTP metabolic process and cytosolic ribosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:25789:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Shwachman-Diamond syndrome 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3229:function.text: EGF encodes pro-epidermal growth factor [Cleaved into: Epidermal growth factor]. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:20594:function.text: EGFL7 encodes epidermal growth factor-like protein 7. It participates in vasculogenesis and blood vessel development.

gene:HGNC:3236:function.text: EGFR encodes an epidermal growth factor receptor family tyrosine kinase that activates growth and survival pathways, including RAS–MAPK and PI3K–AKT signaling.

gene:HGNC:3236:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with non-small cell lung carcinoma (autosomal dominant); lung cancer (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3236:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EGFR have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, and glioblastoma.

gene:HGNC:1232:function.text: EGLN1 encodes egl nine homolog 1. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and intracellular oxygen homeostasis.

gene:HGNC:1232:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with EGLN1-related erythrocytosis and pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma predisposition (autosomal dominant); erythrocytosis, familial, 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3238:function.text: EGR1 encodes early growth response protein 1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:3239:function.text: EGR2 encodes E3 SUMO-protein ligase EGR2. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3239:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (semidominant); Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4E (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3239:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EGR2 have been reported in chronic lymphocytic leukemia/Small lymphocytic lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:24650:function.text: EHMT1 encodes euchromatic histone lysine methyltransferase 1. Its functions include histone H3K27 methyltransferase activity and histone H3K9 methyltransferase activity.

gene:HGNC:24650:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Kleefstra syndrome (autosomal dominant); Kleefstra syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:24650:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EHMT1 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3250:function.text: EIF1AX encodes eukaryotic translation initiation factor 1A, X-chromosomal. It participates in ribosome assembly and translational initiation.

gene:HGNC:3250:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EIF1AX have been reported in uveal melanoma, pulmonary carcinoid tumor, and follicular thyroid carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3284:function.text: EIF4A2 encodes eukaryotic initiation factor 4A-II. It participates in negative regulation of RNA-dependent RNA polymerase activity and translational initiation.

gene:HGNC:3284:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EIF4A2 have been reported in invasive breast carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3287:function.text: EIF4E encodes eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4E. It participates in translational initiation and regulation of translation.

gene:HGNC:3309:function.text: ELANE encodes neutrophil elastase. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3309:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neutropenia (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3318:function.text: ELF3 encodes ETS-related transcription factor Elf-3. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3318:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ELF3 have been reported in ampullary adenocarcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:23114:function.text: ELL encodes RNA polymerase II elongation factor ELL. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription, elongation and snRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11617:function.text: ELOC encodes elongin-C. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and transcription initiation at RNA polymerase II promoter.

gene:HGNC:11617:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ELOC have been reported in ELOC-mutated renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:5959:function.text: ELP1 encodes elongator complex protein 1. It participates in regulation of translation and tRNA wobble base 5-methoxycarbonylmethyl-2-thiouridinylation.

gene:HGNC:5959:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Riley-Day syndrome (autosomal recessive); medulloblastoma (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:24965:function.text: EME1 encodes structure-specific endonuclease subunit EME1. It participates in double-strand break repair and replication fork processing.

gene:HGNC:19881:function.text: EMILIN2 encodes EMILIN-2. It participates in positive regulation of angiogenesis and regulation of blood pressure.

gene:HGNC:19881:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EMILIN2 have been reported in dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, fibrosarcomatous.

gene:HGNC:1316:function.text: EML4 encodes echinoderm microtubule-associated protein-like 4. It participates in microtubule-based process and microtubule cytoskeleton organization.

gene:HGNC:1316:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EML4 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, ALK-positive histiocytosis, and NTRK-rearranged spindle cell sarcoma of the uterine cervix / corpus.

gene:HGNC:18071:function.text: EMSY encodes BRCA2-interacting transcriptional repressor EMSY. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:3349:function.text: ENG encodes endoglin. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:3349:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with telangiectasia, hereditary hemorrhagic, type 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3373:function.text: EP300 encodes the p300 transcriptional coactivator and acetyltransferase, which regulates transcription through histone acetylation and interactions with transcription factors.

gene:HGNC:3373:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome due to EP300 haploinsufficiency (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3373:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EP300 have been reported in CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion, biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma, and angiosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:11958:function.text: EP400 encodes E1A-binding protein p400. It participates in DNA repair and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11958:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EP400 have been reported in ossifying fibromyxoid tumor, malignant.

gene:HGNC:3374:function.text: EPAS1 encodes endothelial PAS domain-containing protein 1. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3374:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with erythrocytosis, familial, 4 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3374:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EPAS1 have been reported in paraganglioma and pheochromocytoma.

gene:HGNC:19876:function.text: EPC1 encodes enhancer of polycomb homolog 1. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and chromatin organization.

gene:HGNC:19876:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EPC1 have been reported in ossifying fibromyxoid tumor, malignant.

gene:HGNC:11529:function.text: EPCAM encodes epithelial cell adhesion molecule. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and signal transduction involved in regulation of gene expression.

gene:HGNC:11529:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Lynch syndrome (autosomal dominant); Lynch syndrome 8 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3387:function.text: EPHA3 encodes ephrin type-A receptor 3. It participates in axon guidance and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:3387:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EPHA3 have been reported in melanoma, stomach adenocarcinoma, and esophageal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3389:function.text: EPHA5 encodes ephrin type-A receptor 5. It participates in axon guidance and axonal fasciculation.

gene:HGNC:3390:function.text: EPHA7 encodes ephrin type-A receptor 7. It participates in negative regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and phosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:3390:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EPHA7 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3392:function.text: EPHB1 encodes ephrin type-B receptor 1. It participates in angiogenesis and neurogenesis.

gene:HGNC:3416:function.text: EPOR encodes erythropoietin receptor. It participates in signal transduction and erythropoietin-mediated signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:3416:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with primary familial polycythemia due to EPO receptor mutation (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3430:function.text: ERBB2 encodes the HER2 receptor tyrosine kinase, an ERBB-family signaling protein that promotes growth and survival signaling through receptor dimerization.

gene:HGNC:3430:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ERBB2 have been reported in urachal carcinoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3431:function.text: ERBB3 encodes receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-3. It participates in signal transduction and negative regulation of signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:3431:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with lethal congenital contracture syndrome 2 (autosomal recessive); visceral neuropathy, familial, 1, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3431:somatic.text: ERBB3 amplification and/or overexpression has been reported in several cancers, including prostate, bladder, and breast tumors.

gene:HGNC:3432:function.text: ERBB4 encodes receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-4 [Cleaved into: ERBB4 intracellular domain]. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:3432:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ERBB4 have been reported in melanoma, cholangiocarcinoma, and stomach adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17072:function.text: ERC1 encodes ELKS/Rab6-interacting/CAST family member 1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:17072:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ERC1 have been reported in kinase-altered spindle cell neoplasm (non-NTRK), malignant.

gene:HGNC:3433:function.text: ERCC1 encodes DNA excision repair protein ERCC-1. It participates in DNA repair and negative regulation of telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:3433:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cerebrooculofacioskeletal syndrome 4 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3434:function.text: ERCC2 encodes general transcription and DNA repair factor IIH helicase subunit XPD. It participates in transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair and transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3434:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with xeroderma pigmentosum group D (autosomal recessive); trichothiodystrophy 1, photosensitive (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3434:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ERCC2 have been reported in bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3435:function.text: ERCC3 encodes general transcription and DNA repair factor IIH helicase/translocase subunit XPB. It participates in DNA repair and transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair.

gene:HGNC:3435:germline.text: Germline disease associations include xeroderma pigmentosum group B (autosomal recessive); trichothiodystrophy 2, photosensitive (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3435:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ERCC3 have been reported in melanoma.

gene:HGNC:3436:function.text: ERCC4 encodes DNA repair endonuclease XPF. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:3436:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with xeroderma pigmentosum group F (autosomal recessive); Fanconi anemia complementation group Q (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3437:function.text: ERCC5 encodes DNA excision repair protein ERCC-5. It participates in transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:3437:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with xeroderma pigmentosum group G (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3438:function.text: ERCC6 encodes chimeric ERCC6-PGBD3 protein. It participates in positive regulation of DNA repair and positive regulation of gene expression.

gene:HGNC:3438:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Cockayne spectrum with or without cerebrooculofacioskeletal syndrome (autosomal recessive); Cockayne syndrome type 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3444:function.text: ERF encodes ETS domain-containing transcription factor ERF. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3444:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with craniosynostosis 4 (autosomal dominant); Chitayat syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3446:function.text: ERG encodes transcriptional regulator ERG. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3446:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ERG have been reported in Ewing sarcoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and neuroendocrine carcinoma of prostate.

gene:HGNC:18185:function.text: ERRFI1 encodes ERBB receptor feedback inhibitor 1. It participates in negative regulation of epidermal growth factor-activated receptor activity and skin morphogenesis.

gene:HGNC:27230:function.text: ESCO2 encodes n-acetyltransferase ESCO2. It participates in post-translational protein acetylation and sister chromatid cohesion.

gene:HGNC:27230:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Roberts-SC phocomelia syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3467:function.text: ESR1 encodes estrogen receptor. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:3467:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ESR1 have been reported in uterine tumor resembling ovarian sex cord tumor, malignant, melanoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:24648:function.text: ETAA1 encodes ewing's tumor-associated antigen 1. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and DNA damage response.

gene:HGNC:24649:function.text: ETNK1 encodes ethanolamine kinase 1. It participates in phosphatidylethanolamine biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:24649:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ETNK1 have been reported in MDS/MPN with neutrophilia.

gene:HGNC:3488:function.text: ETS1 encodes protein C-ets-1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:3490:function.text: ETV1 encodes ETS translocation variant 1. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3490:somatic.text: ETV1 rearrangements can occur in Ewing sarcoma and prostate cancer, with multiple fusion partners described.

gene:HGNC:3493:function.text: ETV4 encodes ETS translocation variant 4. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3494:function.text: ETV5 encodes ETS translocation variant 5. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3495:function.text: ETV6 encodes transcription factor ETV6. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3495:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with thrombocytopenia 5 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3495:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ETV6 have been reported in infantile fibrosarcoma, papillary thyroid carcinoma, and secretory carcinoma of skin.

gene:HGNC:3503:function.text: EVPL encodes envoplakin. Its functions include cadherin binding and structural molecule activity.

gene:HGNC:3503:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EVPL have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, colorectal carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3508:function.text: EWSR1 encodes RNA-binding protein EWS. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:3508:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EWSR1 have been reported in liposarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:3511:function.text: EXO1 encodes exonuclease 1. It participates in DNA repair and mismatch repair.

gene:HGNC:19055:function.text: EXOSC6 encodes exosome complex component MTR3. It participates in DNA deamination and RNA processing.

gene:HGNC:3512:function.text: EXT1 encodes exostosin-1. It participates in ossification and glycosaminoglycan biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:3512:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with exostoses, multiple, type 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3512:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EXT1 have been reported in chondrosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:3513:function.text: EXT2 encodes exostosin-2. It participates in ossification and glycosaminoglycan biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:3513:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with exostoses, multiple, type 2 (autosomal dominant); seizures-scoliosis-macrocephaly syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3513:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EXT2 have been reported in chondrosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:3522:function.text: EYA4 encodes EYA transcriptional coactivator and phosphatase 4. Its functions include protein tyrosine phosphatase activity and anatomical structure morphogenesis.

gene:HGNC:3522:germline.text: Germline disease associations include nonsyndromic genetic hearing loss (autosomal dominant); autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 10 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3522:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EYA4 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:3526:function.text: EZH1 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase EZH1. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:3527:function.text: EZH2 encodes the catalytic methyltransferase component of polycomb repressive complex 2, which methylates histone H3 lysine 27 to regulate transcriptional repression.

gene:HGNC:3527:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Weaver syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3527:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EZH2 have been reported in follicular lymphoma, primary myelofibrosis, and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:33738:function.text: EZHIP encodes EZH inhibitory protein. It participates in chromatin organization and epigenetic regulation of gene expression.

gene:HGNC:33738:somatic.text: EZHIP overexpression is associated with posterior fossa group A ependymoma and can inhibit PRC2-mediated H3K27 methylation.

gene:HGNC:26171:function.text: FAAP100 encodes Fanconi anemia core complex-associated protein 100. It participates in interstrand cross-link repair.

gene:HGNC:26428:function.text: FAAP20 encodes Fanconi anemia core complex-associated protein 20. It participates in translesion synthesis and DNA damage response.

gene:HGNC:28467:function.text: FAAP24 encodes Fanconi anemia core complex-associated protein 24. It participates in interstrand cross-link repair.

gene:HGNC:3578:function.text: FAF1 encodes FAS-associated factor 1. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and ERAD pathway.

gene:HGNC:3579:function.text: FAH encodes fumarylacetoacetase. It participates in L-phenylalanine catabolic process and L-tyrosine catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:3579:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with tyrosinemia type I (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:29170:function.text: FAN1 encodes Fanconi-associated nuclease 1. It participates in DNA repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:29170:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with karyomegalic interstitial nephritis (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3582:function.text: FANCA encodes Fanconi anemia group A protein. It participates in DNA repair and interstrand cross-link repair.

gene:HGNC:3582:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group A (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3583:function.text: FANCB encodes Fanconi anemia group B protein. It participates in negative regulation of double-strand break repair via homologous recombination and positive regulation of double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:3583:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group B (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:3584:function.text: FANCC encodes Fanconi anemia group C protein. It participates in DNA repair and nucleotide-excision repair.

gene:HGNC:3584:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Fanconi anemia complementation group C (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3585:function.text: FANCD2 encodes Fanconi anemia group D2 protein. It participates in interstrand cross-link repair and response to gamma radiation.

gene:HGNC:3585:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group D2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3586:function.text: FANCE encodes Fanconi anemia group E protein. It participates in interstrand cross-link repair.

gene:HGNC:3586:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group E (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3587:function.text: FANCF encodes Fanconi anemia group F protein. It participates in DNA damage response and interstrand cross-link repair.

gene:HGNC:3587:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group F (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:3588:function.text: FANCG encodes Fanconi anemia group G protein. It participates in DNA repair and mitochondrion organization.

gene:HGNC:3588:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group G (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:25568:function.text: FANCI encodes Fanconi anemia group I protein. It participates in DNA damage response and interstrand cross-link repair.

gene:HGNC:25568:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group I (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:20748:function.text: FANCL encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase FANCL. It participates in DNA repair and protein monoubiquitination.

gene:HGNC:20748:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group L (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:23168:function.text: FANCM encodes Fanconi anemia group M protein. It participates in interstrand cross-link repair and replication fork processing.

gene:HGNC:23168:germline.text: Germline disease associations include FANCM Fanconi-like genomic instability disorder (autosomal recessive); spermatogenic failure 28 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:23527:function.text: FANK1 encodes fibronectin type III and ankyrin repeat domains 1. Its functions include negative regulation of apoptotic process and positive regulation of apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:23527:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving FANK1 have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11920:function.text: FAS encodes tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 6. It participates in signal transduction and apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:11920:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with FAS-related autoimmune lymphoproliferative immune disorder (semidominant); autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome type 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11920:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving FAS have been reported in malignant lymphoma, cervical squamous cell carcinoma, and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:4758:function.text: H2BC17 encodes histone H2B type 1-O. It participates in chromatin organization and antibacterial humoral response.

gene:HGNC:4757:function.text: H2BC4 encodes histone H2B type 1-C/E/F/G/I. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4747:function.text: H2BC5 encodes histone H2B type 1-D. It participates in chromatin organization and antibacterial humoral response.

gene:HGNC:4746:function.text: H2BC8 encodes histone H2B type 1-C/E/F/G/I. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4764:function.text: H3-3A encodes the histone variant H3.3, which is incorporated into chromatin independently of DNA replication and contributes to regulation of chromatin structure and transcription.

gene:HGNC:4764:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Bryant-Li-Bhoj neurodevelopmental syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:4764:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving H3-3A have been reported in malignant giant cell tumor of bone, diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered, and diffuse hemispheric glioma, H3 G34-mutant.

gene:HGNC:4765:function.text: H3-3B encodes the histone variant H3.3, which participates in replication-independent nucleosome assembly and regulation of chromatin organization.

gene:HGNC:4765:somatic.text: Somatic H3-3B (formerly H3F3B) mutations are characteristic of chondroblastoma. Their alteration spectrum differs from the H3-3A-associated spectrum in giant cell tumor of bone; these are distinct gene–lesion associations.

gene:HGNC:4778:function.text: H3-4 encodes histone H3.1t. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:33164:function.text: H3-5 encodes histone H3.3C. It participates in kinetochore assembly and mitotic metaphase chromosome alignment.

gene:HGNC:4766:function.text: H3C1 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4775:function.text: H3C10 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4771:function.text: H3C11 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4774:function.text: H3C12 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:25311:function.text: H3C13 encodes histone H3.2. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:20503:function.text: H3C14 encodes histone H3.2. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:20505:function.text: H3C15 encodes histone H3.2. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4776:function.text: H3C2 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4776:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving H3C2 have been reported in esophageal adenocarcinoma, invasive breast carcinoma, and bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:4768:function.text: H3C3 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4767:function.text: H3C4 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4769:function.text: H3C6 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4773:function.text: H3C7 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4772:function.text: H3C8 encodes histone H3.1. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

gene:HGNC:4798:function.text: HABP2 encodes factor VII-activating protease [Cleaved into: Factor VII-activating protease 50 kDa N-terminal heavy chain; Factor VII-activating protease 50 kDa N-terminal heavy chain alternate form; Factor VII-activating protease 27 kDa C-terminal light chain; Factor VII-activating protease 27 kDa C-terminal light chain alternate form]. It participates in proteolysis and cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:18437:function.text: HAVCR2 encodes hepatitis A virus cellular receptor 2. It participates in positive regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and defense response to Gram-positive bacterium.

gene:HGNC:18437:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:4852:function.text: HDAC1 encodes histone deacetylase 1. It participates in chromatin organization and host-mediated suppression of viral transcription.

gene:HGNC:14063:function.text: HDAC4 encodes histone deacetylase 4. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:14063:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurodevelopmental disorder with central hypotonia and dysmorphic facies (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:14063:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HDAC4 have been reported in thymoma.

gene:HGNC:14067:function.text: HDAC7 encodes histone deacetylase 7. It participates in negative regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:18536:function.text: HELQ encodes helicase POLQ-like. It participates in double-strand break repair via homologous recombination and positive regulation of double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:26307:function.text: HEXD encodes hexosaminidase D. Its functions include beta-N-acetylhexosaminidase activity and hexosaminidase activity.

gene:HGNC:26307:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HEXD have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung squamous cell carcinoma, and clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:4880:function.text: HEY1 encodes hairy/enhancer-of-split related with YRPW motif protein 1. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:4880:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HEY1 have been reported in chondrosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:4886:function.text: HFE encodes hereditary hemochromatosis protein. It participates in positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction and receptor-mediated endocytosis.

gene:HGNC:4886:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hemochromatosis type 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:4893:function.text: HGF encodes hepatocyte growth factor [Cleaved into: Hepatocyte growth factor alpha chain; Hepatocyte growth factor beta chain]. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:4893:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal recessive nonsyndromic hearing loss 39 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:4893:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HGF have been reported in small cell lung cancer.

gene:HGNC:4910:function.text: HIF1A encodes hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:4931:function.text: HLA-A encodes HLA class I histocompatibility antigen, A alpha chain. It participates in immune response and antibacterial humoral response.

gene:HGNC:4931:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HLA-A have been reported in melanoma, colon adenocarcinoma, and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:4932:function.text: HLA-B encodes HLA class I histocompatibility antigen, B alpha chain. It participates in defense response and immune response.

gene:HGNC:4932:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HLA-B have been reported in malignant lymphoma, esophageal adenocarcinoma, and cervical squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:4933:function.text: HLA-C encodes HLA class I histocompatibility antigen, C alpha chain. It participates in immune response and positive regulation of T cell mediated cytotoxicity.

gene:HGNC:4933:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HLA-C have been reported in diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:4977:function.text: HLF encodes transcription factor HLF. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:4977:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HLF have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:4982:function.text: HMBS encodes porphobilinogen deaminase. It participates in heme biosynthetic process and heme B biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:4982:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with acute intermittent porphyria (autosomal dominant) (semidominant); acute intermittent porphyria (autosomal dominant) (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:5010:function.text: HMGA1 encodes high mobility group protein HMG-I/HMG-Y). It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:5009:function.text: HMGA2 encodes high mobility group protein HMGI-C. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and chromatin organization.

gene:HGNC:5009:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Silver-Russell syndrome 5 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:5009:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HMGA2 have been reported in carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma, carcinosarcoma of salivary gland, and myoepithelial carcinoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:11621:function.text: HNF1A encodes hepatocyte nuclear factor 1-alpha. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11621:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with monogenic diabetes (autosomal dominant); type 1 diabetes mellitus 20 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11621:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HNF1A have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:5028:function.text: HNMT encodes histamine N-methyltransferase. Its functions include histamine N-methyltransferase activity and histamine catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:5028:germline.text: Germline disease associations include intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal recessive 51 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:5028:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HNMT have been reported in endometrial carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:5044:function.text: HNRNPK encodes heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein K. It participates in signal transduction and mRNA splicing, via spliceosome.

gene:HGNC:5044:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurodevelopmental disorder-craniofacial dysmorphism-cardiac defect-hip dysplasia syndrome (autosomal dominant); Au-Kline syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:19884:function.text: HOOK1 encodes protein Hook homolog 1. It participates in endosome organization and lysosome organization.

gene:HGNC:19885:function.text: HOOK2 encodes hook microtubule tethering protein 2. Its functions include dynein light intermediate chain binding and microtubule binding.

gene:HGNC:19885:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HOOK2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:5109:function.text: HOXA9 encodes homeobox protein Hox-A9. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:5112:function.text: HOXB13 encodes homeobox protein Hox-B13. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:5113:function.text: HOXB2 encodes homeobox B2. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

gene:HGNC:5113:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HOXB2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:5173:function.text: HRAS encodes a small GTPase that couples growth-factor receptor activity to downstream signaling pathways regulating cell proliferation, differentiation, and survival.

gene:HGNC:5173:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Costello syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:5173:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HRAS have been reported in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, bladder urothelial carcinoma, and salivary duct carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:5208:function.text: HSD11B1 encodes hydroxysteroid 11-beta dehydrogenase 1. Its functions include 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity and 7-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity.

gene:HGNC:5208:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HSD11B1 have been reported in breast carcinoma, cutaneous melanoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:5217:function.text: HSD3B1 encodes 3 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase/Delta 5-->4-isomerase type 1 (3-beta-hydroxy-Delta(5)-steroid dehydrogenase). It participates in androgen biosynthetic process and estrogen biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:5253:function.text: HSP90AA1 encodes heat shock protein HSP 90-alpha. It participates in telomere maintenance via telomerase and positive regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase.

gene:HGNC:9476:function.text: HTRA1 encodes serine protease HTRA1. It participates in proteolysis and programmed cell death.

gene:HGNC:9476:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal recessive, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy 2 (autosomal recessive); cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal dominant, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy, type 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:5351:function.text: ICOS encodes inducible T-cell costimulator. It participates in cell-cell adhesion and immune response.

gene:HGNC:5351:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with common variable immunodeficiency (autosomal recessive); immunodeficiency, common variable, 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:5351:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ICOS have been reported in adult t-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:17087:function.text: ICOSLG encodes ICOS ligand. It participates in signal transduction and defense response.

gene:HGNC:5362:function.text: ID3 encodes DNA-binding protein inhibitor ID-3. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:5362:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ID3 have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma, malignant lymphoma, and non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:5363:function.text: ID4 encodes DNA-binding protein inhibitor ID-4. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:5382:function.text: IDH1 encodes a cytosolic and peroxisomal NADP-dependent enzyme that converts isocitrate to alpha-ketoglutarate and generates NADPH.

gene:HGNC:5382:mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with Ollier disease and Maffucci syndrome.

gene:HGNC:5382:somatic.text: Somatic IDH1 mutations occur in diffuse gliomas, acute myeloid leukemia, and cholangiocarcinoma. Cancer-associated R132 variants can acquire a neomorphic activity that produces D-2-hydroxyglutarate.

gene:HGNC:5383:function.text: IDH2 encodes a mitochondrial NADP-dependent isocitrate dehydrogenase that interconverts isocitrate and alpha-ketoglutarate while contributing to cellular NADPH metabolism.

gene:HGNC:5383:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with mitochondrial disease (autosomal dominant); d-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:5383:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IDH2 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma, and chondrosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:5439:function.text: IFNGR1 encodes interferon gamma receptor 1. It participates in signal transduction and astrocyte activation.

gene:HGNC:5439:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal dominant mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial diseases due to partial IFNgammaR1 deficiency (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 27A (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:5464:function.text: IGF1 encodes insulin-like growth factor 1. It participates in signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:5464:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with growth delay due to insulin-like growth factor type 1 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:5465:function.text: IGF1R encodes insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor [Cleaved into: Insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor alpha chain; Insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor beta chain]. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:5465:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with growth delay due to insulin-like growth factor I resistance (autosomal dominant); growth delay due to insulin-like growth factor I resistance (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:5466:function.text: IGF2 encodes insulin-like growth factor 2 [Cleaved into: Insulin-like growth factor II Ala-25 Del; Preptin]. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:5466:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Silver-Russell syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:5466:somatic.text: Loss of imprinting and increased IGF2 expression have been documented in colorectal cancer. These epigenetic/expression-associated observations are distinct from a somatic coding mutation.

gene:HGNC:5477:function.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus; its variable, diversity, joining, and constant segments support antibody production through somatic rearrangement in B cells.

gene:HGNC:5477:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IGH have been reported in plasmacytoma, Burkitt lymphoma, and follicular lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:5650:function.text: IGHV4-34 encodes immunoglobulin heavy variable 4-34. It participates in immune response and immunoglobulin mediated immune response.

gene:HGNC:5715:function.text: IGK is the immunoglobulin kappa light-chain locus and contributes to antibody diversity through variable-to-joining segment rearrangement in B cells.

gene:HGNC:5715:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IGK have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:5853:function.text: IGL is the immunoglobulin lambda light-chain locus and contributes to antibody diversity through variable-to-joining segment rearrangement in B cells.

gene:HGNC:5853:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IGL have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:38476:function.text: IGLL5 encodes immunoglobulin lambda-like polypeptide 5. It participates in immunoglobulin mediated immune response.

gene:HGNC:14552:function.text: IKBKE encodes inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa-B kinase subunit epsilon. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and immune response.

gene:HGNC:14552:somatic.text: IKBKE amplification and overexpression have been described in breast carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:13176:function.text: IKZF1 encodes DNA-binding protein Ikaros. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:13176:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pancytopenia due to IKZF1 mutations (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:13176:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IKZF1 have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, cutaneous melanoma, and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:13178:function.text: IKZF3 encodes zinc finger protein Aiolos. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and mesoderm development.

gene:HGNC:13178:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 84 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:13178:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IKZF3 have been reported in diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS and chronic lymphocytic leukemia/Small lymphocytic lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:5962:function.text: IL10 encodes interleukin-10. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:18015:function.text: IL17RB encodes interleukin-17 receptor B. It participates in defense response and interleukin-17-mediated signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:6011:function.text: IL3 encodes interleukin-3. It participates in cell-cell signaling and embryonic hemopoiesis.

gene:HGNC:6021:function.text: IL6ST encodes interleukin-6 receptor subunit beta. It participates in negative regulation of cytokine activity and autocrine signaling.

gene:HGNC:6021:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hyper-IgE recurrent infection syndrome 4, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive); hyper-IgE recurrent infection syndrome 4A, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6021:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IL6ST have been reported in prostate and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6024:function.text: IL7R encodes interleukin-7 receptor subunit alpha. It participates in signal transduction and hemopoiesis.

gene:HGNC:6024:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 104 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6024:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IL7R have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, stomach adenocarcinoma, and esophageal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6062:function.text: ING1 encodes inhibitor of growth family member 1. Its functions include histone H3K4me3 reader activity and chromatin organization.

gene:HGNC:6062:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ING1 have been reported in low-grade glioma, colorectal carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6065:function.text: INHA encodes inhibin alpha chain. It participates in signal transduction and cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:6066:function.text: INHBA encodes inhibin beta A chain. It participates in SMAD protein signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:24029:function.text: INHBE encodes inhibin beta E chain. It participates in negative regulation of adipose tissue development and cell surface receptor protein serine/threonine kinase signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:6069:function.text: INMT encodes indolethylamine N-methyltransferase. Its functions include amine N-methyltransferase activity and N-methyltransferase activity.

gene:HGNC:6069:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving INMT have been reported in cervical carcinoma and cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:6074:function.text: INPP4A encodes inositol polyphosphate-4-phosphatase type I A. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6075:function.text: INPP4B encodes inositol polyphosphate 4-phosphatase type II. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6080:function.text: INPPL1 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate 5-phosphatase 2. It participates in endocytosis and cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:6080:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with opsismodysplasia (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6080:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving INPPL1 have been reported in endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6091:function.text: INSR encodes insulin receptor [Cleaved into: Insulin receptor subunit alpha; Insulin receptor subunit beta]. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:6091:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Donohue syndrome (autosomal recessive); insulin-resistance syndrome type A (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:25067:function.text: INTS12 encodes integrator complex subunit 12. Its functions include regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II and RNA polymerase II transcription initiation surveillance.

gene:HGNC:25067:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving INTS12 have been reported in multiple myeloma and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6116:function.text: IRF1 encodes interferon regulatory factor 1. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:6116:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IRF1 have been reported in plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:6117:function.text: IRF2 encodes interferon regulatory factor 2. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:21729:function.text: IRF2BP2 encodes interferon regulatory factor 2-binding protein 2. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6119:function.text: IRF4 encodes interferon regulatory factor 4. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6119:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with combined immunodeficiency (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6119:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IRF4 have been reported in large b-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement, malignant lymphoma, and plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:5358:function.text: IRF8 encodes interferon regulatory factor 8. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:5358:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial diseases due to partial IRF8 deficiency (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 32B (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:5358:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IRF8 have been reported in pediatric-type follicular lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:6125:function.text: IRS1 encodes insulin receptor substrate 1. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6126:function.text: IRS2 encodes insulin receptor substrate 2. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6128:function.text: IRS4 encodes insulin receptor substrate 4. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6128:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hypothyroidism, congenital, nongoitrous, 9 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:6171:function.text: ITK encodes tyrosine-protein kinase ITK/TSK. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6171:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with lymphoproliferative syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6171:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ITK have been reported in nodal t-follicular helper cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:6179:function.text: ITPKB encodes inositol-trisphosphate 3-kinase B. It participates in signal transduction and inositol phosphate biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:6190:function.text: JAK1 encodes tyrosine-protein kinase JAK1. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:6190:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autoinflammation, immune dysregulation, and eosinophilia (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6190:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving JAK1 have been reported in t-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, and enteropathy-associated t-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:6192:function.text: JAK2 encodes a nonreceptor tyrosine kinase that associates with cytokine receptors and transmits signals through STAT proteins and other downstream pathways in hematopoietic cells.

gene:HGNC:6192:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with thrombocythemia 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6192:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving JAK2 have been reported in polycythemia vera, primary myelofibrosis, and classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:6193:function.text: JAK3 encodes tyrosine-protein kinase JAK3. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:6193:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with T-B+ severe combined immunodeficiency due to JAK3 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6193:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving JAK3 have been reported in extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, t-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, and t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:6196:function.text: JARID2 encodes protein Jumonji. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and chromatin remodeling.

gene:HGNC:6196:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with developmental delay with variable intellectual disability and dysmorphic facies (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:28917:function.text: JAZF1 encodes juxtaposed with another zinc finger protein 1. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:28917:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving JAZF1 have been reported in endometrial stromal sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:6204:function.text: JUN encodes transcription factor Jun. It participates in SMAD protein signal transduction and host-mediated activation of viral transcription.

gene:HGNC:6205:function.text: JUNB encodes transcription factor JunB. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6205:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving JUNB have been reported in t-cell/histiocyte-rich large b-cell lymphoma and nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:27263:function.text: KANK4 encodes KN motif and ankyrin repeat domain-containing protein 4. It participates in negative regulation of actin filament polymerization.

gene:HGNC:27263:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KANK4 have been reported in amphicrine-like carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:13013:function.text: KAT6A encodes histone acetyltransferase KAT6A. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:13013:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); autosomal dominant intellectual disability-craniofacial anomalies-cardiac defects syndrome (autosomal dominant).
