gene:HGNC:13013:somatic.text: KAT6A rearrangements are associated with acute myeloid leukemia. The fusion partner and resulting product determine the relevant alteration context.

gene:HGNC:17582:function.text: KAT6B encodes histone acetyltransferase KAT6B. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:17582:germline.text: Germline disease associations include KAT6B-related multiple congenital anomalies syndrome (autosomal dominant); blepharophimosis - intellectual disability syndrome, SBBYS type (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17582:somatic.text: KAT6B–CREBBP rearrangements have been described in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:17933:function.text: KAT8 encodes lysine acetyltransferase 8. Its functions include enzyme binding and histone acetyltransferase activity.

gene:HGNC:17933:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Li-Ghorbani-Weisz-Hubshman syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17933:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KAT8 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, colorectal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:23761:function.text: KBTBD4 encodes kelch repeat and BTB domain-containing protein 4. It participates in proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:23761:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KBTBD4 have been reported in medulloblastoma and pineal parenchymal tumor of intermediate differentiation.

gene:HGNC:6254:function.text: KCNH5 encodes potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 5. Its functions include delayed rectifier potassium channel activity and protein-containing complex binding.

gene:HGNC:6254:germline.text: Germline disease associations include neonatal/infantile epilepsy syndrome (autosomal dominant); developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 112 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6254:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KCNH5 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:6258:function.text: KCNJ12 encodes potassium inwardly rectifying channel subfamily J member 12. Its functions include inward rectifier potassium channel activity and muscle contraction.

gene:HGNC:6258:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KCNJ12 have been reported in breast carcinoma, colorectal carcinoma, and adrenocortical carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6269:function.text: KCNJ8 encodes potassium inwardly rectifying channel subfamily J member 8. Its functions include ATP-activated inward rectifier potassium channel activity and ATPase-coupled monoatomic cation transmembrane transporter activity.

gene:HGNC:6269:germline.text: Germline disease associations include hypertrichotic osteochondrodysplasia Cantu type (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6269:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KCNJ8 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:6294:function.text: KCNQ1 encodes potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily KQT member 1. It participates in negative regulation of voltage-gated potassium channel activity and negative regulation of delayed rectifier potassium channel activity.

gene:HGNC:6294:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Jervell and Lange-Nielsen syndrome (autosomal recessive); long QT syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6299:function.text: KCNQ5 encodes potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily Q member 5. Its functions include voltage-gated potassium channel activity and potassium ion transmembrane transport.

gene:HGNC:6299:germline.text: Germline disease associations include intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 46 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6299:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KCNQ5 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:9886:function.text: KDM5A encodes lysine-specific demethylase 5A demethylase 5A). It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling.

gene:HGNC:11114:function.text: KDM5C encodes lysine-specific demethylase 5C demethylase 5C). It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11114:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked, syndromic, Claes-Jensen type (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:11114:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KDM5C have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, and renal clear cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12637:function.text: KDM6A encodes lysine-specific demethylase 6A demethylase 6A). It participates in chromatin remodeling and heart development.

gene:HGNC:12637:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Kabuki syndrome 2 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:12637:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KDM6A have been reported in urothelial carcinoma, appendiceal goblet cell adenocarcinoma, and prostate.

gene:HGNC:6307:function.text: KDR encodes vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2. It participates in positive regulation of nitric oxide-cGMP mediated signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6307:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pulmonary arterial hypertension (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6307:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KDR have been reported in angiosarcoma, skin, and pancreas.

gene:HGNC:23177:function.text: KEAP1 encodes kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and protein ubiquitination.

gene:HGNC:23177:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KEAP1 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, lung squamous cell carcinoma, and large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of lung.

gene:HGNC:6308:function.text: KEL encodes kell blood group glycoprotein. It participates in vasoconstriction and protein processing.

gene:HGNC:18114:function.text: KHDRBS2 encodes KH domain-containing, RNA-binding, signal transduction-associated protein 2. It participates in regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome.

gene:HGNC:22219:function.text: KIAA1549 encodes UPF0606 protein KIAA1549. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:22219:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with retinitis pigmentosa 86 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:22219:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KIAA1549 have been reported in diffuse leptomeningeal glioneuronal tumor.

gene:HGNC:16636:function.text: KIF1B encodes kinesin-like protein KIF1B. It participates in vesicle-mediated transport and neuromuscular synaptic transmission.

gene:HGNC:25484:function.text: KIF26B encodes kinesin family member 26B. Its functions include microtubule binding and microtubule motor activity.

gene:HGNC:25484:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KIF26B have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and ovarian carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6324:function.text: KIF5B encodes kinesin-1 heavy chain. It participates in centrosome localization and lysosome localization.

gene:HGNC:6324:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KIF5B have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, ALK-positive histiocytosis, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6342:function.text: KIT encodes the receptor for stem cell factor, a tyrosine kinase that regulates hematopoietic, melanocytic, germ-cell, and interstitial-cell lineages.

gene:HGNC:6342:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with gastrointestinal stromal tumor (autosomal dominant); piebaldism (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6342:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KIT have been reported in mucosal melanoma, thymic carcinoma, and mast cell sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:18830:function.text: KLF17 encodes krueppel-like factor 17. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:18830:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KLF17 have been reported in myoepithelial carcinoma of soft tissue/bone.

gene:HGNC:6347:function.text: KLF2 encodes krueppel-like factor 2. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6347:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KLF2 have been reported in marginal zone lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:6348:function.text: KLF4 encodes krueppel-like factor 4. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:6348:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KLF4 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma and invasive breast carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6349:function.text: KLF5 encodes krueppel-like factor 5. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6349:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KLF5 have been reported in bladder urothelial carcinoma, lung squamous cell carcinoma, and cervical squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18653:function.text: KLHL6 encodes kelch-like protein 6. It participates in germinal center formation and B cell receptor signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:18653:somatic.text: KLHL6 mutations have been reported in chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:37212:function.text: KLLN encodes killin. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:7132:function.text: KMT2A encodes a histone methyltransferase that helps establish H3K4 methylation and regulate transcriptional programs important for development and hematopoiesis.

gene:HGNC:7132:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Wiedemann-Steiner syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7132:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KMT2A have been reported in thymoma, myeloid sarcoma, and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:15840:function.text: KMT2B encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2B. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:15840:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder with motor features (autosomal dominant); dystonia 28, childhood-onset (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:15840:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KMT2B have been reported in vulva/Vagina and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:13726:function.text: KMT2C encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2C. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:13726:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Kleefstra syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:13726:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KMT2C have been reported in melanoma, pancreas, and prostate.

gene:HGNC:7133:function.text: KMT2D encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2D. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7133:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Kabuki syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant); choanal atresia-athelia-hypothyroidism-delayed puberty-short stature syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7133:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KMT2D have been reported in follicular lymphoma, marginal zone lymphoma, and adamantinoma of long bones.

gene:HGNC:29489:function.text: KMT5A encodes n-lysine methyltransferase KMT5A. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:29489:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KMT5A have been reported in invasive breast carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:30767:function.text: KNSTRN encodes small kinetochore-associated protein. It participates in cell migration and chromosome segregation.

gene:HGNC:30767:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KNSTRN have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:6407:function.text: KRAS encodes a small GTPase that switches between GDP- and GTP-bound states to relay receptor-derived signals to pathways controlling proliferation and survival.

gene:HGNC:6407:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6407:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KRAS have been reported in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, colorectal adenocarcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18610:function.text: KSR2 encodes kinase suppressor of Ras 2. It participates in Ras protein signal transduction and calcium-mediated signaling.

gene:HGNC:6470:function.text: L1CAM encodes neural cell adhesion molecule L1. It participates in chemotaxis and axon development.

gene:HGNC:6470:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with L1 syndrome (x-linked); X-linked hydrocephalus with stenosis of the aqueduct of Sylvius (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:6492:function.text: LAMC1 encodes laminin subunit gamma 1. Its functions include extracellular matrix structural constituent and cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:6492:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LAMC1 have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and thyroid carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6499:function.text: LAMP1 encodes lysosome-associated membrane glycoprotein 1. It participates in protein stabilization and lysosomal lumen acidification.

gene:HGNC:6514:function.text: LATS1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase LATS1. It participates in negative regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity and hippo signaling.

gene:HGNC:6514:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LATS1 have been reported in basal cell carcinoma, cervical adenocarcinoma, and ovarian epithelial tumor.

gene:HGNC:6515:function.text: LATS2 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase LATS2. It participates in negative regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6515:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LATS2 have been reported in pleural mesothelioma, pilocytic astrocytoma, and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29459:function.text: LCE1A encodes late cornified envelope 1A. Its functions include epidermis development.

gene:HGNC:29459:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LCE1A have been reported in esophageal carcinoma and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29467:function.text: LCE1F encodes late cornified envelope 1F. Its functions include epidermis development.

gene:HGNC:29467:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LCE1F have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6524:function.text: LCK encodes tyrosine-protein kinase Lck. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and hemopoiesis.

gene:HGNC:6524:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with severe combined immunodeficiency due to LCK deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:15500:function.text: LENG8 encodes leukocyte receptor cluster member 8. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:15500:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LENG8 have been reported in glioblastoma, medulloblastoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:31953:function.text: LEUTX encodes paired-like homeodomain transcription factor LEUTX. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:31953:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LEUTX have been reported in CNS CIC-rearranged sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:6601:function.text: LIG4 encodes DNA ligase 4. It participates in V(D)J recombination and base-excision repair.

gene:HGNC:6601:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with DNA ligase IV deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:49575:function.text: LINC01187 produces a long intergenic noncoding RNA. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:6636:function.text: LMNA encodes prelamin-A/C [Cleaved into: Lamin-A/C]. It participates in regulation of telomere maintenance and cellular senescence.

gene:HGNC:6636:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with dilated cardiomyopathy 1A (autosomal dominant); lipodystrophy (semidominant).

gene:HGNC:6636:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LMNA have been reported in NTRK-rearranged spindle cell neoplasm, malignant.

gene:HGNC:6641:function.text: LMO1 encodes rhombotin-1. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6641:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LMO1 have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:6642:function.text: LMO2 encodes rhombotin-2. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and embryonic hemopoiesis.

gene:HGNC:6642:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LMO2 have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:6677:function.text: LPL encodes lipoprotein lipase. It participates in cholesterol homeostasis and chylomicron remodeling.

gene:HGNC:6677:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with familial lipoprotein lipase deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6692:function.text: LRP1 encodes LDL receptor related protein 1. Its functions include alpha-2 macroglobulin receptor activity and amyloid-beta binding.

gene:HGNC:6692:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LRP1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6693:function.text: LRP1B encodes low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 1B. It participates in protein transport and receptor-mediated endocytosis.

gene:HGNC:6693:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LRP1B have been reported in skin, melanoma, and pancreas.

gene:HGNC:6697:function.text: LRP5 encodes LDL receptor related protein 5. Its functions include coreceptor activity and Wnt receptor activity.

gene:HGNC:6697:germline.text: Germline disease associations include LRP5-related exudative vitreoretinopathy (autosomal recessive); osteoporosis-pseudoglioma syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6697:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LRP5 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:26556:function.text: LRRC71 encodes leucine rich repeat containing 71. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:26556:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LRRC71 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma, pancreatic adenocarcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:24489:function.text: LSM14A encodes LSM14A mRNA processing body assembly factor. Its functions include mRNA binding and mitotic spindle assembly.

gene:HGNC:24489:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LSM14A have been reported in glioblastoma, colorectal carcinoma, and esophageal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6711:function.text: LTB encodes lymphotoxin-beta. It participates in activation of NF-kappaB-inducing kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6721:function.text: LTK encodes leukocyte tyrosine kinase receptor. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6721:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LTK have been reported in kinase-altered spindle cell neoplasm (non-NTRK), malignant.

gene:HGNC:13082:function.text: LTN1 encodes listerin E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1. Its functions include ribosomal large subunit binding and ubiquitin protein ligase activity.

gene:HGNC:13082:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LTN1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:6735:function.text: LYN encodes tyrosine-protein kinase Lyn. It participates in negative regulation of MAP kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6735:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autoinflammatory disease, systemic, with vasculitis (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6735:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LYN have been reported in diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:1968:function.text: LYST encodes lysosomal-trafficking regulator. It participates in pigmentation and leukocyte chemotaxis.

gene:HGNC:1968:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Chediak-Higashi syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6742:function.text: LZTR1 encodes leucine-zipper-like transcriptional regulator 1. It participates in negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction and protein ubiquitination.

gene:HGNC:6742:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with LZTR1-related schwannomatosis (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6742:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LZTR1 have been reported in endometrial carcinoma, glioblastoma multiforme, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6764:function.text: MAD2L2 encodes mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint protein MAD2B. It participates in DNA repair and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:6776:function.text: MAF encodes transcription factor Maf. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6776:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Ayme-Gripp syndrome (autosomal dominant); cataract 21 multiple types (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6776:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAF have been reported in plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:23145:function.text: MAFA encodes transcription factor MafA. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6408:function.text: MAFB encodes transcription factor MafB. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:6408:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with multicentric carpo-tarsal osteolysis with or without nephropathy (autosomal dominant); Duane retraction syndrome 3 with or without deafness (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6408:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAFB have been reported in plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:6812:function.text: MAGEC1 encodes MAGE family member C1. Its functions include negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6812:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAGEC1 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, esophageal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18957:function.text: MAGI2 encodes membrane-associated guanylate kinase, WW and PDZ domain-containing protein 2. It participates in signal transduction and SMAD protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:18957:germline.text: Germline disease associations include nephrotic syndrome 15 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6815:function.text: MAGOH encodes mago homolog, exon junction complex subunit. Its functions include mRNA export from nucleus and mRNA metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:6815:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAGOH have been reported in glioblastoma, pancreatic adenocarcinoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29665:function.text: MALAT1 produces a nuclear long noncoding RNA implicated in regulation of gene expression and ribonucleoprotein organization; processing of its precursor also generates a small cytoplasmic RNA.

gene:HGNC:29665:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MALAT1 have been reported in gastroblastoma, TFEB-altered renal cell carcinoma, and GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing.

gene:HGNC:6819:function.text: MALT1 encodes mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma translocation protein 1. It participates in regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6819:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with combined immunodeficiency due to MALT1 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6819:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MALT1 have been reported in marginal zone lymphoma and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:16259:function.text: MAML2 encodes mastermind-like protein 2. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription of Notch receptor target.

gene:HGNC:16259:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAML2 have been reported in thymoma, porocarcinoma, and hidradenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:16272:function.text: MAML3 encodes mastermind-like protein 3. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription of Notch receptor target.

gene:HGNC:16272:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAML3 have been reported in pheochromocytoma and biphenotypic sinonasal sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:2568:function.text: MAMLD1 encodes mastermind-like domain-containing protein 1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and male gonad development.

gene:HGNC:2568:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hypospadias 2, X-linked (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:2568:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAMLD1 have been reported in ependymoma.

gene:HGNC:6840:function.text: MAP2K1 encodes dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 1. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6840:germline.text: Germline disease associations include cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (autosomal dominant); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6840:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAP2K1 have been reported in histiocytic sarcoma, erdheim–Chester disease, and Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

gene:HGNC:6842:function.text: MAP2K2 encodes dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 2. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:6842:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (autosomal dominant); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome 4 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6844:function.text: MAP2K4 encodes dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 4. It participates in signal transduction and JNK cascade.

gene:HGNC:6844:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAP2K4 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma, colorectal adenocarcinoma, and invasive breast carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6848:function.text: MAP3K1 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 1. It participates in MAPK cascade and protein phosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:6848:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with 46,XY sex reversal 6 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6848:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAP3K1 have been reported in invasive breast carcinoma of no special type, plasma cell myeloma, and colon adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6852:function.text: MAP3K13 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 13. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and JNK cascade.

gene:HGNC:6853:function.text: MAP3K14 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 14. It participates in non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and MAPK cascade.

gene:HGNC:6856:function.text: MAP3K4 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 4. It participates in positive regulation of JUN kinase activity and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6858:function.text: MAP3K6 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 6. It participates in signal transduction and JNK cascade.

gene:HGNC:6859:function.text: MAP3K7 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 7. It participates in positive regulation of JUN kinase activity and canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6859:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cardiospondylocarpofacial syndrome (autosomal dominant); frontometaphyseal dysplasia 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6860:function.text: MAP3K8 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 8. It participates in MAPK cascade and protein phosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:6860:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAP3K8 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:6871:function.text: MAPK1 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase 1. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6871:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAPK1 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma, cervical squamous cell carcinoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6877:function.text: MAPK3 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase 3. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:6880:function.text: MAPK7 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase 7. Its functions include enzyme inhibitor activity and MAP kinase activity.

gene:HGNC:6880:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAPK7 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18752:function.text: MAPKAP1 encodes target of rapamycin complex 2 subunit MAPKAP1. It participates in negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction and TORC2 signaling.

gene:HGNC:26655:function.text: MARCHF10 encodes membrane associated ring-CH-type finger 10. Its functions include ubiquitin protein ligase activity and zinc ion binding.

gene:HGNC:26655:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MARCHF10 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:6913:function.text: MAX encodes protein max. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:6913:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); pheochromocytoma (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6913:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAX have been reported in pheochromocytoma, plasma cell myeloma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6919:function.text: MBD4 encodes methyl-CpG-binding domain protein 4. It participates in DNA repair and depyrimidination.

gene:HGNC:6943:function.text: MCL1 encodes induced myeloid leukemia cell differentiation protein Mcl-1. It participates in cellular homeostasis and mitochondrial fusion.

gene:HGNC:6943:somatic.text: Focal MCL1 amplification has been observed across multiple cancer types, including lung and breast cancers. Functional studies support an anti-apoptotic survival role in amplified tumor models; an arbitrary sequence variant is a different finding.

gene:HGNC:16147:function.text: MCM8 encodes DNA helicase MCM8. It participates in double-strand break repair via homologous recombination and mismatch repair involved in maintenance of fidelity involved in DNA-dependent DNA replication.

gene:HGNC:16147:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with premature ovarian failure 10 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:21163:function.text: MDC1 encodes mediator of DNA damage checkpoint protein 1. It participates in DNA damage response and DNA replication checkpoint signaling.

gene:HGNC:6973:function.text: MDM2 encodes an E3 ubiquitin ligase and negative regulator of p53, helping control p53 stability and activity.

gene:HGNC:6973:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MDM2 have been reported in liposarcoma, osteosarcoma, and intimal sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:6974:function.text: MDM4 encodes protein Mdm4. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6974:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MDM4 have been reported in YAP1::KMT2A-rearranged sarcoma and neuroendocrine carcinoma of breast.

gene:HGNC:25674:function.text: MEAF6 encodes chromatin modification-related protein MEAF6. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:25674:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEAF6 have been reported in CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion and ossifying fibromyxoid tumor, malignant.

gene:HGNC:3498:function.text: MECOM encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase MECOM. It participates in heterochromatin organization and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:3498:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with MECOM-associated syndrome (autosomal dominant); radioulnar synostosis with amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3498:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MECOM have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, melanoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11957:function.text: MED12 encodes mediator of RNA polymerase II transcription subunit 12. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11957:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with MED12-related intellectual disability syndrome (x-linked); FG syndrome 1 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:11957:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MED12 have been reported in malignant phyllodes tumor, prostate, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:24628:function.text: MED28 encodes mediator complex subunit 28. Its functions include positive regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription initiation by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:24628:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MED28 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6993:function.text: MEF2A encodes myocyte enhancer factor 2A. Its functions include chromatin binding and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

gene:HGNC:6993:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEF2A have been reported in medulloblastoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6995:function.text: MEF2B encodes myocyte-specific enhancer factor 2B. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:6995:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEF2B have been reported in malignant lymphoma, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:6996:function.text: MEF2C encodes myocyte-specific enhancer factor 2C. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:6996:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia, stereotypic hand movements, and impaired language (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6996:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEF2C have been reported in microsecretory adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6997:function.text: MEF2D encodes myocyte-specific enhancer factor 2D. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:6997:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEF2D have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:7000:function.text: MEIS1 encodes homeobox protein Meis1. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and angiogenesis.

gene:HGNC:7000:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEIS1 have been reported in rhabdomyosarcoma and MEIS1::NCOA1/2 primitive spindle cell sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:7010:function.text: MEN1 encodes menin. It participates in DNA repair and transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling.

gene:HGNC:7010:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7010:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEN1 have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma, pulmonary carcinoid tumor, and thymic neuroendocrine tumor.

gene:HGNC:7029:function.text: MET encodes the hepatocyte growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase, which regulates proliferation, survival, migration, and tissue-remodeling responses.

gene:HGNC:7029:germline.text: Germline disease associations include papillary renal cell carcinoma (autosomal dominant); hereditary papillary renal cell carcinoma (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7029:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MET have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29330:function.text: METTL14 encodes methyltransferase 14, N6-adenosine-methyltransferase non-catalytic subunit. Its functions include mRNA binding and mRNA m(6)A methyltransferase activity.

gene:HGNC:29330:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving METTL14 have been reported in endometrial carcinoma, nasopharyngeal carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:14010:function.text: MGA encodes MAX gene-associated protein. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:14010:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MGA have been reported in gastrointestinal NUT-rearranged sarcoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and pleural mesothelioma.

gene:HGNC:7043:function.text: MGAM encodes maltase-glucoamylase. It participates in dextrin catabolic process and maltose catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:7059:function.text: MGMT encodes methylated-DNA--protein-cysteine methyltransferase. It participates in DNA repair and negative regulation of apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:7059:somatic.text: MGMT promoter methylation is a tumor-associated epigenetic mechanism of gene silencing studied in glioblastoma.

gene:HGNC:21086:function.text: MIB1 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase MIB1. It participates in endocytosis and protein ubiquitination.

gene:HGNC:7090:function.text: MICA encodes MHC class I polypeptide-related sequence A. Its functions include natural killer cell lectin-like receptor binding and receptor ligand activity.

gene:HGNC:7090:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MICA have been reported in colorectal carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:31530:function.text: MIR143 encodes a microRNA precursor. The mature microRNA participates in post-transcriptional regulation of target transcripts through effects on mRNA stability and translation.

gene:HGNC:31530:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MIR143 have been reported in glomus tumor, malignant.

gene:HGNC:23564:function.text: MIR17HG is the host gene for the miR-17–92 microRNA cluster. Its primary transcript gives rise to microRNAs that regulate expression of target genes involved in growth and differentiation.

gene:HGNC:23564:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Feingold syndrome type 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:23564:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MIR17HG have been reported in embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes.

gene:HGNC:7105:function.text: MITF encodes microphthalmia-associated transcription factor. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7105:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Waardenburg syndrome type 2 (autosomal dominant); Waardenburg syndrome type 2A (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7107:function.text: MKI67 encodes proliferation marker protein Ki-67. It participates in regulation of chromatin organization and chromosome segregation.

gene:HGNC:7127:function.text: MLH1 encodes a DNA mismatch-repair protein that forms the MutLα complex with PMS2, helping correct replication-associated mismatches and insertion/deletion errors.

gene:HGNC:7127:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Lynch syndrome (autosomal dominant); Constitutional mismatch repair deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7127:somatic.text: Loss of mismatch-repair function involving MLH1 is relevant in colorectal and endometrial carcinomas. MLH1 promoter methylation is a distinct mechanism of tumor-associated silencing.

gene:HGNC:7128:function.text: MLH3 encodes DNA mismatch repair protein Mlh3. It participates in mismatch repair and reciprocal meiotic recombination.

gene:HGNC:7134:function.text: MLLT1 encodes protein ENL. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:16063:function.text: MLLT10 encodes protein AF-10. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:16063:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MLLT10 have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:7136:function.text: MLLT3 encodes protein AF-9. It participates in regulation of chromatin organization and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7136:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MLLT3 have been reported in melanoma.

gene:HGNC:7162:function.text: MMP16 encodes matrix metalloproteinase-16. It participates in proteolysis and protein processing.

gene:HGNC:7180:function.text: MN1 encodes transcriptional activator MN1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of osteoblast proliferation.

gene:HGNC:7180:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with CEBALID syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7180:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MN1 have been reported in astroblastoma, MN1-altered.

gene:HGNC:23825:function.text: MOB3B encodes MOB kinase activator 3B. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of hippo signaling.

gene:HGNC:29619:function.text: MPEG1 encodes macrophage-expressed gene 1 protein [Cleaved into: Macrophage-expressed gene 1 protein, processed form]. It participates in antibacterial innate immune response and defense response to bacterium.

gene:HGNC:7217:function.text: MPL encodes the thrombopoietin receptor, which regulates hematopoietic stem-cell maintenance and megakaryocyte and platelet production through cytokine signaling.

gene:HGNC:7217:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia 1 (autosomal recessive); thrombocythemia 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7217:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MPL have been reported in primary myelofibrosis, essential thrombocythemia, and myeloproliferative neoplasm, NOS.

gene:HGNC:7218:function.text: MPO encodes myeloperoxidase [Cleaved into: Myeloperoxidase; 89 kDa myeloperoxidase; 84 kDa myeloperoxidase; Myeloperoxidase light chain; Myeloperoxidase heavy chain; 38 kDa myeloperoxidase; 22 kDa myeloperoxidase]. It participates in defense response and nucleosome disassembly.

gene:HGNC:7230:function.text: MRE11 encodes double-strand break repair protein MRE11. It participates in DNA repair and homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:7230:germline.text: Germline disease associations include ataxia-telangiectasia-like disorder 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7230:somatic.text: Somatic MRE11 alterations have been reported in ovarian carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:14334:function.text: MRTFA encodes myocardin-related transcription factor A. It participates in positive regulation of miRNA transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:14334:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MRTFA have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:29819:function.text: MRTFB encodes myocardin-related transcription factor B. It participates in positive regulation of miRNA transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7325:function.text: MSH2 encodes a DNA mismatch-recognition protein. It forms complexes with MSH6 or MSH3 to recognize mismatched bases and insertion/deletion loops and initiate mismatch repair.

gene:HGNC:7325:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Lynch syndrome (autosomal dominant); Constitutional mismatch repair deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7325:somatic.text: Loss of mismatch-repair function involving MSH2 is relevant in colorectal and endometrial carcinomas.

gene:HGNC:7326:function.text: MSH3 encodes DNA mismatch repair protein Msh3. It participates in DNA repair and mismatch repair.

gene:HGNC:7326:germline.text: Germline disease associations include familial adenomatous polyposis 4 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7329:function.text: MSH6 encodes the mismatch-recognition component of the MSH2–MSH6 complex, which detects base mismatches and small insertion/deletion loops during DNA mismatch repair.

gene:HGNC:7329:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Lynch syndrome (autosomal dominant); Constitutional mismatch repair deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7329:somatic.text: Loss of mismatch-repair function involving MSH6 is relevant in colorectal and endometrial carcinomas.

gene:HGNC:7330:function.text: MSI1 encodes RNA-binding protein Musashi homolog 1. It participates in epithelial cell differentiation and nervous system development.

gene:HGNC:18585:function.text: MSI2 encodes RNA-binding protein Musashi homolog 2. It participates in regulation of translation and stem cell development.

gene:HGNC:18585:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MSI2 have been reported in neuroblastoma.

gene:HGNC:7380:function.text: MST1 encodes hepatocyte growth factor-like protein [Cleaved into: Hepatocyte growth factor-like protein alpha chain; Hepatocyte growth factor-like protein beta chain]. It participates in regulation of cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity and proteolysis.

gene:HGNC:7381:function.text: MST1R encodes macrophage-stimulating protein receptor [Cleaved into: Macrophage-stimulating protein receptor alpha chain; Macrophage-stimulating protein receptor beta chain]. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:7410:function.text: MTA1 encodes metastasis-associated protein MTA1. It participates in signal transduction and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7413:function.text: MTAP encodes s-methyl-5'-thioadenosine phosphorylase. It participates in L-methionine cycle and nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:7413:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with diaphyseal medullary stenosis-bone malignancy syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7413:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MTAP have been reported in mesothelioma.

gene:HGNC:7423:function.text: MTCP1 encodes protein p13 MTCP-1. It participates in intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:7423:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MTCP1 have been reported in t-cell prolymphocytic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:3942:function.text: MTOR encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase mTOR. It participates in positive regulation of protein kinase activity and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:3942:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes (autosomal dominant); macrocephaly-intellectual disability-neurodevelopmental disorder-small thorax syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:3942:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MTOR have been reported in clear cell renal cell carcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7514:function.text: MUC4 encodes mucin-4 [Cleaved into: Mucin-4 alpha chain; Mucin-4 beta chain]. It participates in cell-matrix adhesion and maintenance of gastrointestinal epithelium.

gene:HGNC:7517:function.text: MUC6 encodes mucin-6. It participates in maintenance of gastrointestinal epithelium.

gene:HGNC:7517:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MUC6 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, hepatocellular carcinoma, and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29814:function.text: MUS81 encodes structure-specific endonuclease subunit MUS81. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:7527:function.text: MUTYH encodes adenine DNA glycosylase. It participates in DNA repair and mismatch repair.

gene:HGNC:7527:germline.text: Germline disease associations include familial adenomatous polyposis 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7527:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MUTYH have been reported in amphicrine-like carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6761:function.text: MXD1 encodes max dimerization protein 1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6761:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MXD1 have been reported in gastrointestinal NUT-rearranged sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:13906:function.text: MXD4 encodes max dimerization protein 4. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:13906:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MXD4 have been reported in gastrointestinal NUT-rearranged sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:7534:function.text: MXI1 encodes max-interacting protein 1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7534:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MXI1 have been reported in gastrointestinal NUT-rearranged sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:7539:function.text: MXRA5 encodes matrix remodeling associated 5. Its functions include extracellular matrix structural constituent and response to transforming growth factor beta.

gene:HGNC:7539:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MXRA5 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:7545:function.text: MYB encodes transcriptional activator Myb. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7545:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYB have been reported in basal cell carcinoma of prostate, adenoid cystic carcinoma of breast, and pulmonary adenoid cystic carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7546:function.text: MYBBP1A encodes myb-binding protein 1A. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7547:function.text: MYBL1 encodes myb-related protein A. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of piRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:7547:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYBL1 have been reported in adenoid cystic carcinoma of breast and adenoid cystic carcinoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:7553:function.text: MYC encodes a transcription factor that dimerizes with MAX to regulate gene-expression programs controlling growth, metabolism, proliferation, and differentiation.

gene:HGNC:7553:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYC have been reported in angiosarcoma, pineoblastoma, and medulloblastoma.

gene:HGNC:7555:function.text: MYCL encodes protein L-Myc. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7555:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYCL have been reported in small cell lung carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7559:function.text: MYCN encodes an MYC-family transcription factor that regulates developmental growth and differentiation programs, particularly in neural and embryonal tissues.

gene:HGNC:7559:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Feingold syndrome type 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7559:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYCN have been reported in ependymoma, retinoblastoma, and medulloblastoma.

gene:HGNC:7562:function.text: MYD88 encodes an adaptor for Toll-like and interleukin-1 receptor signaling that links receptor activation to downstream inflammatory signaling, including NF-κB activation.

gene:HGNC:7562:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pyogenic bacterial infections due to MyD88 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7562:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYD88 have been reported in lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, diffuse large b-cell lymphoma, and intravascular large b-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:7569:function.text: MYH11 encodes myosin-11. It participates in actomyosin structure organization and elastic fiber assembly.

gene:HGNC:7569:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with aortic aneurysm, familial thoracic 4 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7569:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYH11 have been reported in myeloid sarcoma, acute myeloid leukemia, and melanoma.

gene:HGNC:7579:function.text: MYH9 encodes myosin-9. It participates in angiogenesis and cytokinetic process.

gene:HGNC:7579:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with macrothrombocytopenia and granulocyte inclusions with or without nephritis or sensorineural hearing loss (autosomal dominant); autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 17 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7579:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYH9 have been reported in neuroblastoma, basal cell carcinoma, and ovarian epithelial tumor.

gene:HGNC:31104:function.text: MYO18A encodes putative TGFB1-induced anti-apoptotic factor 1. It participates in canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:18150:function.text: MYO18B encodes myosin XVIIIB. Its functions include actin filament binding and cytoskeletal motor activity.

gene:HGNC:18150:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Klippel-Feil anomaly-myopathy-facial dysmorphism syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:18150:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYO18B have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7608:function.text: MYO9A encodes myosin IXA. Its functions include actin filament binding and GTPase activator activity.

gene:HGNC:7608:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYO9A have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:16067:function.text: MYOCD encodes myocardin. It participates in transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:16067:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYOCD have been reported in leiomyosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:7611:function.text: MYOD1 encodes myoblast determination protein 1. It participates in regulation of RNA splicing and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7611:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with myopathy, congenital, with diaphragmatic defects, respiratory insufficiency, and dysmorphic facies (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7611:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYOD1 have been reported in rhabdomyosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:7622:function.text: MYT1 encodes myelin transcription factor 1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7622:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYT1 have been reported in amphicrine-like carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7623:function.text: MYT1L encodes myelin transcription factor 1 like. Its functions include cobalt ion binding and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

gene:HGNC:7623:germline.text: Germline disease associations include syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 39 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7623:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYT1L have been reported in esophageal carcinoma, uterine carcinosarcoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7627:function.text: NAB2 encodes NGFI-A-binding protein 2. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase III.

gene:HGNC:7627:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NAB2 have been reported in solitary fibrous tumor, malignant/high-risk.

gene:HGNC:29831:function.text: NADK encodes NAD kinase/ATP NAD kinase). It participates in phosphorylation and ATP metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:7639:function.text: NAP1L3 encodes nucleosome assembly protein 1 like 3. Its functions include chromatin binding and histone binding.

gene:HGNC:7639:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NAP1L3 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, esophageal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7652:function.text: NBN encodes nibrin. It participates in homologous recombination and telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:7652:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Nijmegen breakage syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7668:function.text: NCOA1 encodes nuclear receptor coactivator 1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7668:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NCOA1 have been reported in MEIS1::NCOA1/2 primitive spindle cell sarcoma, uterine tumor resembling ovarian sex cord tumor, malignant, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7669:function.text: NCOA2 encodes nuclear receptor coactivator 2. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7669:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NCOA2 have been reported in chondrosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and MEIS1::NCOA1/2 primitive spindle cell sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:7670:function.text: NCOA3 encodes nuclear receptor coactivator 3. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and cell dedifferentiation.

gene:HGNC:7670:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NCOA3 have been reported in uterine tumor resembling ovarian sex cord tumor, malignant.

gene:HGNC:7671:function.text: NCOA4 encodes nuclear receptor coactivator 4. It participates in autophagy and erythrocyte differentiation.

gene:HGNC:7671:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NCOA4 have been reported in papillary thyroid carcinoma and intraductal carcinoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:7672:function.text: NCOR1 encodes nuclear receptor corepressor 1. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:7672:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NCOR1 have been reported in prostate, pleural mesothelioma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7673:function.text: NCOR2 encodes nuclear receptor corepressor 2. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:7673:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NCOR2 have been reported in leiomyosarcoma, pleural mesothelioma, and high-Grade glioma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:6731:function.text: NCR1 encodes natural cytotoxicity triggering receptor 1. Its functions include immune receptor activity and transmembrane signaling receptor activity.

gene:HGNC:6731:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NCR1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17091:function.text: NCSTN encodes nicastrin. It participates in proteolysis and amyloid-beta formation.

gene:HGNC:17091:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with acne inversa, familial, 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:30815:function.text: NEAT1 produces a nuclear long noncoding RNA that serves as a structural component of paraspeckles, nuclear bodies involved in regulation of RNA handling and gene expression.

gene:HGNC:19688:function.text: NECTIN4 encodes nectin-4 [Cleaved into: Processed poliovirus receptor-related protein 4]. It participates in heterophilic cell-cell adhesion and homophilic cell-cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:19688:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with ectodermal dysplasia-syndactyly syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:17302:function.text: NEGR1 encodes neuronal growth regulator 1. It participates in cholesterol homeostasis and protein secretion.

gene:HGNC:18448:function.text: NEIL1 encodes endonuclease 8-like 1 lyase Neil1). It participates in depyrimidination and base-excision repair.

gene:HGNC:18956:function.text: NEIL2 encodes endonuclease 8-like 2 lyase Neil2). It participates in depyrimidination.

gene:HGNC:24573:function.text: NEIL3 encodes endonuclease 8-like 3. It participates in depurination and base-excision repair.

gene:HGNC:7765:function.text: NF1 encodes neurofibromin, a RAS GTPase-activating protein that promotes conversion of active RAS-GTP to inactive RAS-GDP and restrains RAS signaling.

gene:HGNC:7765:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurofibromatosis type 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7765:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NF1 have been reported in malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, and glioblastoma.

gene:HGNC:7773:function.text: NF2 encodes merlin, a cytoskeletal and membrane-associated tumor-suppressor protein involved in cell-contact signaling and regulation of growth-control pathways.

gene:HGNC:7773:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with NF2-related schwannomatosis (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7773:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NF2 have been reported in meningioma, CNS WHO grade 3, mesothelioma, and pleural mesothelioma.

gene:HGNC:7776:function.text: NFATC2 encodes nuclear factor of activated T-cells, cytoplasmic 2. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7776:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NFATC2 have been reported in NFATC2-rearranged sarcoma, round cell sarcoma with EWSR1–non-ETS fusions, and rectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7780:function.text: NFE2 encodes transcription factor NF-E2 45 kDa subunit. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7782:function.text: NFE2L2 encodes nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7782:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency, developmental delay, and hypohomocysteinemia (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7782:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NFE2L2 have been reported in hepatoblastoma, lung squamous cell carcinoma, and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7785:function.text: NFIB encodes nuclear factor 1 B-type. It participates in negative regulation of miRNA transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7785:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); macrocephaly, acquired, with impaired intellectual development (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7785:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NFIB have been reported in basal cell carcinoma of prostate, adenoid cystic carcinoma of breast, and pulmonary adenoid cystic carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7786:function.text: NFIC encodes nuclear factor I C. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity.

gene:HGNC:7786:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NFIC have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7797:function.text: NFKBIA encodes NF-kappa-B inhibitor alpha. It participates in canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:7797:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with ectodermal dysplasia and immunodeficiency 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7797:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NFKBIA have been reported in follicular dendritic cell sarcoma, malignant lymphoma, and plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:7799:function.text: NFKBIE encodes NF-kappa-B inhibitor epsilon. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:7799:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NFKBIE have been reported in malignant lymphoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:29805:function.text: NFKBIZ encodes NF-kappa-B inhibitor zeta. It participates in regulation of gene expression and T cell receptor signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:7820:function.text: NHS encodes NHS actin remodeling regulator. Its functions include cell differentiation and lens development in camera-type eye.

gene:HGNC:7820:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Nance-Horan syndrome (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:7820:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NHS have been reported in breast carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:11825:function.text: NKX2-1 encodes homeobox protein Nkx-2.1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11825:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with NKX2-1 related choreoathetosis and congenital hypothyroidism with or without pulmonary dysfunction (autosomal dominant); brain-lung-thyroid syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11825:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NKX2-1 have been reported in low-Grade glioma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:7838:function.text: NKX3-1 encodes homeobox protein Nkx-3.1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7870:function.text: NOL4 encodes nucleolar protein 4. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:7870:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NOL4 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma and esophageal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7871:function.text: NONO encodes non-POU domain-containing octamer-binding protein). It participates in RNA splicing and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7871:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked syndromic intellectual disability (x-linked); intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked, syndromic 34 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:7871:somatic.text: NONO can participate in TFE3-associated rearrangements in renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7881:function.text: NOTCH1 encodes a transmembrane receptor whose proteolytic activation releases an intracellular signaling component that regulates transcription, cell fate, and differentiation.

gene:HGNC:7881:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with NOTCH1-related AOS spectrum disorder (autosomal dominant); Adams-Oliver syndrome 5 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7881:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NOTCH1 have been reported in mantle cell lymphoma, pleomorphic dermal sarcoma, and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7882:function.text: NOTCH2 encodes neurogenic locus notch homolog protein 2 [Cleaved into: Notch 2 extracellular truncation; Notch 2 intracellular domain]. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:7882:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Alagille syndrome (autosomal dominant); acroosteolysis dominant type (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7882:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NOTCH2 have been reported in mantle cell lymphoma, marginal zone lymphoma, and glomus tumor, malignant.

gene:HGNC:7883:function.text: NOTCH3 encodes neurogenic locus notch homolog protein 3 [Cleaved into: Notch 3 extracellular truncation; Notch 3 intracellular domain]. It participates in positive regulation of miRNA transcription and axon guidance.

gene:HGNC:7883:germline.text: Germline disease associations include cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal dominant, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy, type 1 (autosomal dominant); cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal recessive, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:7884:function.text: NOTCH4 encodes neurogenic locus notch homolog protein 4 [Cleaved into: Notch 4 extracellular truncation; Notch 4 intracellular domain]. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7894:function.text: NPAS1 encodes neuronal PAS domain protein 1. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

gene:HGNC:7894:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NPAS1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7910:function.text: NPM1 encodes nucleophosmin, a nucleolar protein involved in ribosome biogenesis, nucleic-acid handling, and regulation of cellular stress responses and genome stability.

gene:HGNC:7910:germline.text: Rare germline NPM1 variants have been reported in dyskeratosis congenita; evidence for a broader inherited bone-marrow-failure syndrome is limited.

gene:HGNC:7910:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NPM1 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, myeloid sarcoma, and anaplastic large cell lymphoma, systemic.

gene:HGNC:7931:function.text: NPM3 encodes nucleoplasmin-3. It participates in chromatin remodeling.

gene:HGNC:7960:function.text: NR0B1 encodes nuclear receptor subfamily 0 group B member 1. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7960:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked adrenal hypoplasia congenita (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:7982:function.text: NR4A3 encodes nuclear receptor subfamily 4 group A member 3. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:7982:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NR4A3 have been reported in extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma and acinic cell carcinoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:7989:function.text: NRAS encodes a small GTPase that relays growth-factor signals to pathways including RAF–MEK–ERK and PI3K signaling through regulated GDP/GTP cycling.

gene:HGNC:7989:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome 6 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:7989:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NRAS have been reported in mucosal melanoma, cutaneous melanoma, and conjunctival melanoma.

gene:HGNC:7997:function.text: NRG1 encodes pro-neuregulin-1, membrane-bound isoform [Cleaved into: Neuregulin-1]. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:7997:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NRG1 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, stomach adenocarcinoma, and esophageal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:14234:function.text: NSD1 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase, H3 lysine-36 specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:14234:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Sotos syndrome (autosomal dominant); Sotos syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:14234:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NSD1 have been reported in biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma, melanoma, and esophagus/Stomach.

gene:HGNC:12766:function.text: NSD2 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase NSD2. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and double-strand break repair.

gene:HGNC:12766:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Rauch-Steindl syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:12766:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NSD2 have been reported in plasma cell myeloma, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and upper tract urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12767:function.text: NSD3 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase NSD3. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:12767:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NSD3 have been reported in NUT carcinoma and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8022:function.text: NT5C2 encodes cytosolic purine 5'-nucleotidase. It participates in GMP metabolic process and IMP catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:8022:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex hereditary spastic paraplegia (autosomal recessive); hereditary spastic paraplegia 45 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:17820:function.text: NT5C3A encodes 5'-nucleotidase, cytosolic IIIA. Its functions include 5'-nucleotidase activity and magnesium ion binding.

gene:HGNC:17820:germline.text: Germline disease associations include hemolytic anemia due to pyrimidine 5' nucleotidase deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:17820:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NT5C3A have been reported in breast carcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8028:function.text: NTHL1 encodes endonuclease III-like protein 1 lyase). It participates in depyrimidination and nucleotide-excision repair.

gene:HGNC:8028:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with NTHL1-deficiency tumor predisposition syndrome (autosomal recessive); familial adenomatous polyposis 3 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:8031:function.text: NTRK1 encodes the TRKA receptor tyrosine kinase, which mediates nerve growth factor signaling important for neuronal development and survival.

gene:HGNC:8031:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathy type 4 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:8031:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NTRK1 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, infant-type hemispheric glioma, and NTRK-rearranged spindle cell neoplasm, malignant.

gene:HGNC:8032:function.text: NTRK2 encodes the TRKB neurotrophin receptor tyrosine kinase, which regulates neuronal survival, differentiation, and function.

gene:HGNC:8032:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 58 (autosomal dominant); obesity, hyperphagia, and developmental delay (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8032:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NTRK2 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, infant-type hemispheric glioma, and NTRK-rearranged spindle cell neoplasm, malignant.

gene:HGNC:8033:function.text: NTRK3 encodes the TRKC neurotrophin receptor tyrosine kinase, which transduces neurotrophin signaling involved in neuronal development and maintenance.

gene:HGNC:8033:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NTRK3 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, infantile fibrosarcoma, and papillary thyroid carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8039:function.text: NTSR1 encodes neurotensin receptor type 1. It participates in temperature homeostasis and vocalization behavior.

gene:HGNC:8039:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NTSR1 have been reported in amphicrine-like carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:14621:function.text: NUF2 encodes kinetochore protein Nuf2. It participates in chromosome segregation and kinetochore organization.

gene:HGNC:8059:function.text: NUMA1 encodes nuclear mitotic apparatus protein 1. It participates in nucleus organization and anastral spindle assembly.

gene:HGNC:8059:somatic.text: NUMA1–RARA rearrangements have been described in acute promyelocytic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:8064:function.text: NUP214 encodes nuclear pore complex protein Nup214. It participates in nucleocytoplasmic transport and RNA export from nucleus.

gene:HGNC:8064:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with encephalopathy, acute, infection-induced, susceptibility to, 9 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:8064:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NUP214 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:28958:function.text: NUP93 encodes nuclear pore complex protein Nup93. It participates in positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction and nucleocytoplasmic transport.

gene:HGNC:28958:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with nephrotic syndrome, type 12 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:8068:function.text: NUP98 encodes nuclear pore complex protein Nup98-Nup96 [Cleaved into: Nuclear pore complex protein Nup98; Nuclear pore complex protein Nup96]. It participates in positive regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and post-transcriptional tethering of RNA polymerase II gene DNA at nuclear periphery.

gene:HGNC:8068:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NUP98 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29919:function.text: NUTM1 encodes NUT family member 1. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:29919:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NUTM1 have been reported in NUT carcinoma, porocarcinoma, and CIC-rearranged sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:23438:function.text: NUTM2A encodes NUT family member 2A. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:23438:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NUTM2A have been reported in endometrial stromal sarcoma and gastrointestinal NUT-rearranged sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:23445:function.text: NUTM2B encodes NUT family member 2B. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:23445:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NUTM2B have been reported in sarcoma with BCOR genetic alterations.

gene:HGNC:8071:function.text: NXF1 encodes nuclear RNA export factor 1. It participates in mRNA export from nucleus and poly(A)+ mRNA export from nucleus.

gene:HGNC:8071:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NXF1 have been reported in chronic lymphocytic leukemia/Small lymphocytic lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:23381:function.text: OBP2B encodes odorant binding protein 2B. Its functions include odorant binding and small molecule binding.

gene:HGNC:23381:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving OBP2B have been reported in medulloblastoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:7056:function.text: OGA encodes protein O-GlcNAcase. It participates in protein deglycosylation and N-acetylglucosamine metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:8125:function.text: OGG1 encodes n-glycosylase/DNA lyase [Includes: 8-oxoguanine DNA glycosylase; DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) lyase]. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9398:function.text: OLIG2 encodes oligodendrocyte transcription factor 2. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and myelination.
