gene:HGNC:9398:somatic.text: OLIG2 can be involved in chromosomal rearrangements associated with T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Expression as a lineage marker is a distinct observation.

gene:HGNC:8522:function.text: OTX2 encodes homeobox protein OTX2. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:8522:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic microphthalmia type 5 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8524:function.text: OVGP1 encodes oviductal glycoprotein 1. Its functions include chitin binding and chitinase activity.

gene:HGNC:8524:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving OVGP1 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and chromophobe renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8526:function.text: OXA1L encodes OXA1L mitochondrial inner membrane insertase. Its functions include membrane insertase activity and mitochondrial ribosome binding.

gene:HGNC:8526:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving OXA1L have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:15524:function.text: P2RY8 encodes s-geranylgeranyl-glutathione receptor P2RY8. It participates in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway and Rho-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:15524:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving P2RY8 have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:23794:function.text: PACS2 encodes phosphofurin acidic cluster sorting protein 2. Its functions include autophagosome assembly and endoplasmic reticulum calcium ion homeostasis.

gene:HGNC:23794:germline.text: Germline disease associations include genetic developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (autosomal dominant); developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 66 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:23794:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PACS2 have been reported in esophageal carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8590:function.text: PAK1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase PAK 1. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:8590:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with intellectual developmental disorder with macrocephaly, seizures, and speech delay (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8592:function.text: PAK3 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase PAK 3. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and axonogenesis.

gene:HGNC:8592:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked 30 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:15916:function.text: PAK5 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase PAK 5. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:26144:function.text: PALB2 encodes a repair scaffold that connects BRCA1- and BRCA2-associated functions and supports RAD51-mediated homologous-recombination repair.

gene:HGNC:26144:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group N (autosomal recessive); PALB2-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:26144:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PALB2 have been reported in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and ovarian epithelial tumor.

gene:HGNC:29991:function.text: PAN3 encodes PAN2-PAN3 deadenylation complex subunit PAN3 (PAB1P-dependent poly(A)-specific ribonuclease) (Poly(A)-nuclease deadenylation complex subunit 3). It participates in nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening and positive regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly.

gene:HGNC:29991:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PAN3 have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:19365:function.text: PANK3 encodes pantothenate kinase 3. Its functions include acetyl-CoA binding and pantothenate kinase activity.

gene:HGNC:19365:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PANK3 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8609:function.text: PARN encodes poly(A)-specific ribonuclease PARN. It participates in positive regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase and RNA modification.

gene:HGNC:8609:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pulmonary fibrosis and/or bone marrow failure, Telomere-related, 4 (semidominant); dyskeratosis congenita, autosomal recessive 6 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:270:function.text: PARP1 encodes poly [ADP-ribose] polymerase 1 ADP-ribosyltransferase 1) [Cleaved into: Poly [ADP-ribose] polymerase 1, processed C-terminus; Poly [ADP-ribose] polymerase 1, processed N-terminus]. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:20686:function.text: PASD1 encodes PAS domain containing repressor 1. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription factor binding and transcription regulator inhibitor activity.

gene:HGNC:20686:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PASD1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:13071:function.text: PATZ1 encodes POZ-, AT hook-, and zinc finger-containing protein 1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:13071:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PATZ1 have been reported in thyroid-like follicular renal cell carcinoma and round cell sarcoma with EWSR1–non-ETS fusions.

gene:HGNC:8617:function.text: PAX3 encodes paired box protein Pax-3. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:8617:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Waardenburg syndrome (autosomal dominant); Waardenburg syndrome type 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8617:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PAX3 have been reported in rhabdomyosarcoma and biphenotypic sinonasal sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:8619:function.text: PAX5 encodes paired box protein Pax-5. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:8619:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with leukemia, acute lymphoblastic, susceptibility to, 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8619:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PAX5 have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:8621:function.text: PAX7 encodes paired box protein Pax-7. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and anatomical structure morphogenesis.

gene:HGNC:8621:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with myopathy, congenital, progressive, with scoliosis (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:8621:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PAX7 have been reported in rhabdomyosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:8622:function.text: PAX8 encodes paired box protein Pax-8. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:8622:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hypothyroidism, congenital, nongoitrous, 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8622:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PAX8 have been reported in follicular thyroid carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8624:function.text: PAXIP1 encodes PAX-interacting protein 1. It participates in DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator and positive regulation of transcription initiation by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:30064:function.text: PBRM1 encodes protein polybromo-1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and chromatin remodeling.

gene:HGNC:30064:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PBRM1 have been reported in chordoma, clear cell renal cell carcinoma, and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8632:function.text: PBX1 encodes pre-B-cell leukemia transcription factor 1. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and brain development.

gene:HGNC:8632:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital anomalies of kidney and urinary tract syndrome with or without hearing loss, abnormal ears, or developmental delay (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8632:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PBX1 have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma and myoepithelial carcinoma of soft tissue/bone.

gene:HGNC:8634:function.text: PBX3 encodes pre-B-cell leukemia transcription factor 3. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and brain development.

gene:HGNC:8634:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PBX3 have been reported in myoepithelial carcinoma of soft tissue/bone.

gene:HGNC:8647:function.text: PCBP1 encodes poly(rC)-binding protein 1. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and viral RNA genome replication.

gene:HGNC:8647:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PCBP1 have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma, colon adenocarcinoma, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8664:function.text: PCDHA10 encodes protocadherin alpha 10. Its functions include calcium ion binding and cell adhesion molecule binding.

gene:HGNC:8664:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PCDHA10 have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8696:function.text: PCDHGA1 encodes protocadherin gamma-A1. It participates in cell adhesion and homophilic cell-cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:28255:function.text: PCED1B encodes PC-esterase domain containing 1B. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:28255:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PCED1B have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8727:function.text: PCM1 encodes pericentriolar material 1 protein. It participates in centrosome cycle and cilium assembly.

gene:HGNC:8727:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PCM1 have been reported in myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with tyrosine kinase fusion.

gene:HGNC:30483:function.text: PCMTD1 encodes protein-L-isoaspartate (D-aspartate) O-methyltransferase domain containing 1. Its functions include protein-L-isoaspartate (D-aspartate) O-methyltransferase activity and ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity.

gene:HGNC:30483:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PCMTD1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8747:function.text: PCSK5 encodes proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 5. Its functions include endopeptidase activity and endopeptidase inhibitor activity.

gene:HGNC:8747:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PCSK5 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8760:function.text: PDCD1 encodes programmed cell death protein 1. It participates in apoptotic process and humoral immune response.

gene:HGNC:18731:function.text: PDCD1LG2 encodes programmed cell death 1 ligand 2. It participates in immune response and negative regulation of interleukin-10 production.

gene:HGNC:18731:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PDCD1LG2 have been reported in classic Hodgkin lymphoma, primary mediastinal large b-cell lymphoma, and melanoma.

gene:HGNC:8800:function.text: PDGFB encodes platelet-derived growth factor subunit B. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:8800:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with basal ganglia calcification, idiopathic, 5 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8800:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PDGFB have been reported in COL1A1::PDGFB fusion-associated uterine sarcoma and dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, fibrosarcomatous.

gene:HGNC:30620:function.text: PDGFD encodes platelet-derived growth factor D [Cleaved into: Platelet-derived growth factor D, latent form; Platelet-derived growth factor D, receptor-binding form]. It participates in positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and positive regulation of cell migration.

gene:HGNC:30620:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PDGFD have been reported in dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, fibrosarcomatous.

gene:HGNC:8803:function.text: PDGFRA encodes platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha. It participates in positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and luteinization.

gene:HGNC:8803:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with gastrointestinal stromal tumor (autosomal dominant); polyps, multiple and recurrent inflammatory fibroid, gastrointestinal (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8803:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PDGFRA have been reported in intimal sarcoma, glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, and gastrointestinal stromal tumor.

gene:HGNC:8804:function.text: PDGFRB encodes platelet-derived growth factor receptor beta. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:8804:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with acroosteolysis-keloid-like lesions-premature aging syndrome (autosomal dominant); myofibromatosis, infantile, 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8804:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PDGFRB have been reported in COL1A1::PDGFB fusion-associated uterine sarcoma, myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with tyrosine kinase fusion, and angiosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:8806:function.text: PDHA1 encodes pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 subunit alpha 1. Its functions include pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) activity and pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA.

gene:HGNC:8806:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Leigh syndrome (x-linked); mitochondrial disease (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:8806:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PDHA1 have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8809:function.text: PDK1 encodes [Pyruvate dehydrogenase] kinase isozyme 1, mitochondrial. It participates in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and cell population proliferation.

gene:HGNC:8816:function.text: PDPK1 encodes 3-phosphoinositide-dependent protein kinase 1. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:20418:function.text: PDS5B encodes sister chromatid cohesion protein PDS5 homolog B. It participates in double-strand break repair via homologous recombination and cell population proliferation.

gene:HGNC:17704:function.text: PDZRN3 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase PDZRN3. It participates in protein ubiquitination and neuromuscular junction development.

gene:HGNC:17704:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PDZRN3 have been reported in kinase-altered spindle cell neoplasm (non-NTRK), malignant.

gene:HGNC:19405:function.text: PGBD5 encodes piggyBac transposable element-derived protein 5. It participates in non-replicative DNA transposition.

gene:HGNC:8910:function.text: PGR encodes progesterone receptor. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:8919:function.text: PHF1 encodes PHD finger protein 1. It participates in DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:8919:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PHF1 have been reported in ossifying fibromyxoid tumor, malignant.

gene:HGNC:18145:function.text: PHF6 encodes PHD finger protein 6. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:18145:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Borjeson-Forssman-Lehmann syndrome (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:18145:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PHF6 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:15673:function.text: PHIP encodes PH-interacting protein. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:15673:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with PHIP-related behavioral problems-intellectual disability-obesity-dysmorphic features syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9143:function.text: PHOX2B encodes paired mesoderm homeobox protein 2B. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9143:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Haddad syndrome (autosomal dominant); central hypoventilation syndrome, congenital, 1, with or without Hirschsprung disease (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:15514:function.text: PICALM encodes phosphatidylinositol-binding clathrin assembly protein. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:15514:somatic.text: PICALM–MLLT10 rearrangements have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and lymphoid malignancies.

gene:HGNC:8957:function.text: PIGA encodes phosphatidylinositol N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase subunit A. It participates in GPI anchor biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:8957:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 2 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:8972:function.text: PIK3C2B encodes phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate 3-kinase C2 domain-containing subunit beta. It participates in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:8973:function.text: PIK3C2G encodes phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase C2 domain-containing subunit gamma. It participates in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:8974:function.text: PIK3C3 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase catalytic subunit type 3. It participates in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and autophagy.

gene:HGNC:8975:function.text: PIK3CA encodes the p110α catalytic subunit of class I phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase, which produces lipid signals that activate AKT-dependent growth and survival pathways.

gene:HGNC:8975:germline.text: Germline disease associations include overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8975:mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with megalencephaly-capillary malformation-polymicrogyria syndrome.

gene:HGNC:8975:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PIK3CA have been reported in invasive breast carcinoma of no special type, endometrioid carcinoma of endometrium, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8976:function.text: PIK3CB encodes phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit beta isoform. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:8976:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PIK3CB have been reported in glioblastoma multiforme, prostate adenocarcinoma, and bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:8977:function.text: PIK3CD encodes phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit delta isoform. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:8977:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 14 (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 14b, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:8978:function.text: PIK3CG encodes phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit gamma isoform. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:8979:function.text: PIK3R1 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase regulatory subunit alpha. It participates in positive regulation of RNA splicing and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:8979:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with PIK3R1-related immunodeficiency and SHORT syndrome (autosomal dominant); SHORT syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8979:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PIK3R1 have been reported in metaplastic breast carcinoma, endometrioid carcinoma of endometrium, and glioblastoma.

gene:HGNC:8980:function.text: PIK3R2 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase regulatory subunit beta. It participates in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:8980:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes (autosomal dominant); megalencephaly-polymicrogyria-polydactyly-hydrocephalus syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:8981:function.text: PIK3R3 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase regulatory subunit gamma. It participates in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and immune response.

gene:HGNC:8986:function.text: PIM1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase pim-1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and protein stabilization.

gene:HGNC:8986:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PIM1 have been reported in large b-cell lymphoma of immune-privileged sites, plasma cell myeloma, and non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:9008:function.text: PKD1 encodes polycystin-1. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and mitocytosis.

gene:HGNC:9008:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (autosomal dominant); autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9009:function.text: PKD2 encodes polycystin-2. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and aorta development.

gene:HGNC:9009:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (autosomal dominant); polycystic kidney disease 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9016:function.text: PKHD1 encodes fibrocystin. It participates in cell-cell adhesion and homeostatic process.

gene:HGNC:9016:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease (autosomal recessive); polycystic kidney disease 4 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9045:function.text: PLAG1 encodes zinc finger protein PLAG1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9045:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with silver-russell syndrome 4 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9045:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PLAG1 have been reported in malignant mixed tumor of skin, carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma, and carcinosarcoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:9046:function.text: PLAGL1 encodes zinc finger protein PLAGL1. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9046:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PLAGL1 have been reported in CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration.

gene:HGNC:9047:function.text: PLAGL2 encodes zinc finger protein PLAGL2. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9047:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PLAGL2 have been reported in CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration.

gene:HGNC:9056:function.text: PLCB3 encodes phospholipase C beta 3. Its functions include C-type glycerophospholipase activity and cadherin binding.

gene:HGNC:9056:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PLCB3 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9059:function.text: PLCB4 encodes 1-phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate phosphodiesterase beta-4. It participates in phosphatidylinositol-mediated signaling and lipid catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:9059:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with auriculocondylar syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant); auriculocondylar syndrome 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9059:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PLCB4 have been reported in uveal melanoma.

gene:HGNC:9065:function.text: PLCG1 encodes 1-phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate phosphodiesterase gamma-1. It participates in calcium-mediated signaling and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:9065:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PLCG1 have been reported in angiosarcoma, sézary syndrome, and mycosis fungoides.

gene:HGNC:9066:function.text: PLCG2 encodes 1-phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate phosphodiesterase gamma-2. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9066:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autoinflammation-PLCG2-associated antibody deficiency-immune dysregulation (autosomal dominant); familial cold autoinflammatory syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:19699:function.text: PLK2 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase PLK2. It participates in Rap protein signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9108:function.text: PMAIP1 encodes phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate-induced protein 1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator and apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:9113:function.text: PML encodes protein PML. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:9113:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PML have been reported in acute promyelocytic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:9121:function.text: PMS1 encodes PMS1 protein homolog 1. It participates in mismatch repair and response to xenobiotic stimulus.

gene:HGNC:9122:function.text: PMS2 encodes the endonuclease component of the MLH1–PMS2 mismatch-repair complex, which helps remove replication-associated DNA errors.

gene:HGNC:9122:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Lynch syndrome (autosomal dominant); Constitutional mismatch repair deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9122:somatic.text: Loss of mismatch-repair function involving PMS2 is relevant in colorectal and endometrial carcinomas.

gene:HGNC:9154:function.text: PNKP encodes bifunctional polynucleotide phosphatase/kinase [Includes: Polynucleotide 3'-phosphatase (2'(3')-polynucleotidase); Polynucleotide 5'-hydroxyl-kinase]. It participates in DNA repair and regulation of DNA repair.

gene:HGNC:9154:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with microcephaly, seizures, and developmental delay (autosomal recessive); ataxia - oculomotor apraxia type 4 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:23492:function.text: PNLIPRP3 encodes pancreatic lipase related protein 3. Its functions include glycerophospholipid phospholipase A1 activity and lipoprotein lipase activity.

gene:HGNC:23492:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PNLIPRP3 have been reported in esophageal carcinoma and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17278:function.text: PNRC1 encodes proline-rich nuclear receptor coactivator 1. It participates in nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:9171:function.text: PODXL encodes podocalyxin like. Its functions include cell migration and epithelial tube formation.

gene:HGNC:9171:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PODXL have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma, papillary renal cell carcinoma, and clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9174:function.text: POLB encodes DNA polymerase beta. It participates in DNA repair and regulation of DNA repair.

gene:HGNC:9175:function.text: POLD1 encodes the catalytic subunit of DNA polymerase delta, which participates in DNA replication and repair and provides proofreading exonuclease activity.

gene:HGNC:9175:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with POLD1-related polyposis and colorectal cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant); mandibular hypoplasia-deafness-progeroid syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9175:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving POLD1 have been reported in esophageal adenocarcinoma and invasive breast carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9177:function.text: POLE encodes the catalytic subunit of DNA polymerase epsilon, which participates in DNA replication and contains a proofreading exonuclease domain.

gene:HGNC:9177:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with POLE-related polyposis and colorectal cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant); colorectal cancer, susceptibility to, 12 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9177:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving POLE have been reported in colorectal adenocarcinoma and endometrioid carcinoma of endometrium.

gene:HGNC:9181:function.text: POLH encodes DNA polymerase eta. It participates in DNA repair and regulation of DNA repair.

gene:HGNC:9181:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with xeroderma pigmentosum variant type (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9186:function.text: POLQ encodes DNA polymerase theta [Includes: Helicase POLQ; DNA polymerase POLQ]. It participates in DNA repair and negative regulation of double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:9186:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving POLQ have been reported in melanoma, endometrial carcinoma, and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:19702:function.text: POM121 encodes POM121 transmembrane nucleoporin. Its functions include structural constituent of nuclear pore and nucleocytoplasmic transport.

gene:HGNC:19702:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving POM121 have been reported in glioblastoma, cutaneous melanoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17284:function.text: POT1 encodes protection of telomeres protein 1. It participates in telomere maintenance via telomerase and positive regulation of telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:17284:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with tumor predisposition syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17284:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving POT1 have been reported in angiosarcoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia/Small lymphocytic lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:9221:function.text: POU5F1 encodes POU domain, class 5, transcription factor 1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:9221:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving POU5F1 have been reported in myoepithelial carcinoma of soft tissue/bone.

gene:HGNC:9236:function.text: PPARG encodes peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:9236:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with lipodystrophy (semidominant); PPARG-related familial partial lipodystrophy (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9236:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PPARG have been reported in follicular thyroid carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9277:function.text: PPM1D encodes protein phosphatase 1D. It participates in regulation of intracellular signal transduction and regulation of transcription initiation by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9277:germline.text: Germline disease associations include syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder with gastrointestinal difficulties and high pain threshold (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9277:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PPM1D have been reported in diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered, lung adenocarcinoma, and basal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9284:function.text: PPP1R10 encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 1 regulatory subunit 10. It participates in positive regulation of telomere maintenance and negative regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9302:function.text: PPP2R1A encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 2A 65 kDa regulatory subunit A alpha isoform. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and RNA polymerase II transcription initiation surveillance.

gene:HGNC:9302:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); Houge-Janssens syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9302:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PPP2R1A have been reported in serous carcinoma of endometrium, carcinosarcoma of female genital tract, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9304:function.text: PPP2R2A encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 2A 55 kDa regulatory subunit B alpha isoform. It participates in protein dephosphorylation and regulation of chromosome segregation.

gene:HGNC:18296:function.text: PPP4R2 encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 4 regulatory subunit 2. It participates in regulation of double-strand break repair via homologous recombination and protein modification process.

gene:HGNC:9323:function.text: PPP6C encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 6 catalytic subunit [Cleaved into: Serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 6 catalytic subunit, N-terminally processed]. It participates in protein dephosphorylation and COPII vesicle coat assembly.

gene:HGNC:9323:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PPP6C have been reported in melanoma, cutaneous melanoma, and basal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9343:function.text: PRCC encodes proline-rich protein PRCC. It participates in regulation of cell cycle.

gene:HGNC:9343:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRCC have been reported in TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9346:function.text: PRDM1 encodes PR domain zinc finger protein 1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9346:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRDM1 have been reported in prostate, plasma cell myeloma, and non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:13995:function.text: PRDM10 encodes PR domain zinc finger protein 10. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:14001:function.text: PRDM14 encodes PR domain zinc finger protein 14. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and germ cell development.

gene:HGNC:9350:function.text: PRDM6 encodes putative histone-lysine N-methyltransferase PRDM6. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of gene expression.

gene:HGNC:9350:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRDM6 have been reported in medulloblastoma.

gene:HGNC:22950:function.text: PREX2 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate-dependent Rac exchanger 2 protein (PtdIns(3,4,5)-dependent Rac exchanger 2). It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:22950:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PREX2 have been reported in melanoma, pancreas, and colon adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9360:function.text: PRF1 encodes perforin-1. It participates in apoptotic process and protein homooligomerization.

gene:HGNC:9360:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9380:function.text: PRKACA encodes cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit alpha. It participates in cAMP/PKA signal transduction and bone resorption.

gene:HGNC:9380:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cardioacrofacial dysplasia 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9380:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKACA have been reported in fibrolamellar carcinoma and extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9381:function.text: PRKACB encodes cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit beta. It participates in signal transduction and protein phosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:9381:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cardioacrofacial dysplasia 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9381:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKACB have been reported in extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9388:function.text: PRKAR1A encodes cAMP-dependent protein kinase type I-alpha regulatory subunit. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and negative regulation of cAMP/PKA signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9388:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Carney complex, type 1 (autosomal dominant); Acrodysostosis 1 with or without hormone resistance (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9388:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKAR1A have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma, Sertoli cell tumor, malignant, and malignant melanotic nerve sheath tumor.

gene:HGNC:9393:function.text: PRKCA encodes protein kinase C alpha type. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9395:function.text: PRKCB encodes protein kinase C beta type. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9395:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKCB have been reported in adult t-cell leukemia/lymphoma and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:9399:function.text: PRKCD encodes protein kinase C delta type [Cleaved into: Protein kinase C delta type regulatory subunit; Protein kinase C delta type catalytic subunit]. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9399:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with systemic lupus erythematosus (autosomal recessive); autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome, type III caused by mutation in PRKCD (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9399:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKCD have been reported in non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:9404:function.text: PRKCI encodes protein kinase C iota type. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and secretion.

gene:HGNC:9407:function.text: PRKD1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase D1. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9407:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital heart defects and ectodermal dysplasia (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9407:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKD1 have been reported in polymorphous adenocarcinoma, cribriform adenocarcinoma of salivary gland, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17293:function.text: PRKD2 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase D2. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:17293:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKD2 have been reported in polymorphous adenocarcinoma, cribriform adenocarcinoma of salivary gland, and plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:9408:function.text: PRKD3 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase D3. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and protein phosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:9408:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKD3 have been reported in polymorphous adenocarcinoma and cribriform adenocarcinoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:9413:function.text: PRKDC encodes DNA-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit. It participates in telomere maintenance and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9413:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with severe combined immunodeficiency due to DNA-PKcs deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:8607:function.text: PRKN encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase parkin. It participates in negative regulation of glucokinase activity and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:8607:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Parkinson disease (autosomal recessive); autosomal recessive juvenile Parkinson disease 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9452:function.text: PROCR encodes protein C receptor. Its functions include signaling receptor activity and negative regulation of coagulation.

gene:HGNC:9452:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PROCR have been reported in breast carcinoma, cervical carcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9475:function.text: PRSS1 encodes serine protease 1 [Cleaved into: Alpha-trypsin chain 1; Alpha-trypsin chain 2]. It participates in proteolysis and extracellular matrix disassembly.

gene:HGNC:9475:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary chronic pancreatitis (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:15475:function.text: PRSS27 encodes serine protease 27. Its functions include serine-type endopeptidase activity and serine-type peptidase activity.

gene:HGNC:15475:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRSS27 have been reported in low-grade glioma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9491:function.text: PRSS8 encodes prostasin [Cleaved into: Prostasin light chain; Prostasin heavy chain]. It participates in protein processing and positive regulation of sodium ion transport.

gene:HGNC:9521:function.text: PSG4 encodes pregnancy specific beta-1-glycoprotein 4. Its functions include female pregnancy.

gene:HGNC:9521:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PSG4 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9585:function.text: PTCH1 encodes protein patched homolog 1. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:9585:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome (autosomal dominant); holoprosencephaly 7 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9585:mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with basal cell nevus syndrome 1.

gene:HGNC:9585:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PTCH1 have been reported in gastroblastoma, medulloblastoma, and basal cell carcinoma of skin.

gene:HGNC:9588:function.text: PTEN encodes a tumor-suppressor phosphatase that counteracts PI3K signaling by dephosphorylating phosphatidylinositol lipid messengers, thereby restraining AKT pathway activation.

gene:HGNC:9588:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome (autosomal dominant); Cowden syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9588:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PTEN have been reported in endometrioid carcinoma of endometrium, prostate adenocarcinoma, and prostate.

gene:HGNC:9612:function.text: PTK2B encodes protein-tyrosine kinase 2-beta. It participates in activation of Janus kinase activity and positive regulation of protein kinase activity.

gene:HGNC:9630:function.text: PTN encodes pleiotrophin. Its functions include carbohydrate binding and chondroitin sulfate binding.

gene:HGNC:9630:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PTN have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, esophageal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9634:function.text: PTP4A1 encodes protein tyrosine phosphatase type IVA 1). It participates in positive regulation of cell migration.

gene:HGNC:9642:function.text: PTPN1 encodes tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 1. It participates in negative regulation of MAP kinase activity and regulation of signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9644:function.text: PTPN11 encodes tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 11. It participates in positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9644:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9644:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PTPN11 have been reported in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, and neuroblastoma / ganglioneuroblastoma.

gene:HGNC:9647:function.text: PTPN14 encodes tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 14. It participates in lymphangiogenesis and protein dephosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:9647:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with lymphedema-posterior choanal atresia syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9647:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PTPN14 have been reported in basal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9650:function.text: PTPN2 encodes tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 2. It participates in erythrocyte differentiation and glucose homeostasis.

gene:HGNC:9665:function.text: PTPRB encodes receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase beta. It participates in angiogenesis and dephosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:9665:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PTPRB have been reported in angiosarcoma, thymoma, and melanoma.

gene:HGNC:9668:function.text: PTPRD encodes receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase delta. It participates in signal transduction and neuron differentiation.

gene:HGNC:9668:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PTPRD have been reported in non-Hodgkin lymphoma, ovarian epithelial tumor, and esophageal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9681:function.text: PTPRS encodes receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase S. It participates in signal transduction and peptidyl-tyrosine dephosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:9682:function.text: PTPRT encodes receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase T. It participates in signal transduction and cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:9682:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PTPRT have been reported in melanoma, stomach adenocarcinoma, and ovarian epithelial tumor.

gene:HGNC:29676:function.text: PUM3 encodes pumilio RNA binding family member 3. Its functions include mRNA binding and regulation of protein ADP-ribosylation.

gene:HGNC:29676:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PUM3 have been reported in glioblastoma, cutaneous melanoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9709:function.text: PVT1 is a noncoding locus near MYC that produces regulatory RNA transcripts. Its proximity to MYC is relevant when interpreting regional copy-number changes and rearrangements.

gene:HGNC:9709:somatic.text: PVT1 copy-number gain and increased expression have been reported in breast and ovarian cancers, acute myeloid leukemia, and Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:21100:function.text: QKI encodes KH domain-containing RNA-binding protein QKI. It participates in regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and mRNA stabilization.

gene:HGNC:21100:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving QKI have been reported in melanoma and glioblastoma multiforme.

gene:HGNC:9774:function.text: RAB35 encodes ras-related protein Rab-35. It participates in Rab protein signal transduction and endocytic recycling.

gene:HGNC:9801:function.text: RAC1 encodes ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 1. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and Rac protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9801:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 48 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9801:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RAC1 have been reported in melanoma, cutaneous melanoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9802:function.text: RAC2 encodes ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 2. It participates in signal transduction and chemotaxis.

gene:HGNC:9802:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 73b with defective neutrophil chemotaxis and lymphopenia (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 73c with defective neutrophil chemotaxis and hypogammaglobulinemia (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9811:function.text: RAD21 encodes double-strand-break repair protein rad21 homolog [Cleaved into: 64-kDa C-terminal product]. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and DNA recombination.

gene:HGNC:9811:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Cornelia de Lange syndrome (autosomal dominant); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 4 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9811:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RAD21 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:9816:function.text: RAD50 encodes DNA repair protein RAD50. It participates in DNA repair and homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:9816:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Nijmegen breakage syndrome-like disorder (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9816:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RAD50 have been reported in glioblastoma multiforme.

gene:HGNC:9817:function.text: RAD51 encodes DNA repair protein RAD51 homolog 1. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance via recombination.

gene:HGNC:9817:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group R (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9822:function.text: RAD51B encodes DNA repair protein RAD51 homolog 2. It participates in DNA repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:9820:function.text: RAD51C encodes DNA repair protein RAD51 homolog 3. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance via recombination.

gene:HGNC:9820:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with RAD51C-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); Fanconi anemia complementation group O (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9820:somatic.text: Somatic RAD51C loss-of-function mutations have been documented in ovarian carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9823:function.text: RAD51D encodes DNA repair protein RAD51 homolog 4. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:9823:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with RAD51D-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); breast-ovarian cancer, familial, susceptibility to, 4 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9824:function.text: RAD52 encodes DNA repair protein RAD52 homolog. It participates in telomere maintenance and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:17228:function.text: RAD54B encodes DNA repair and recombination protein RAD54B. It participates in homologous recombination and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:17228:somatic.text: Biallelic RAD54B sequence mutations have been reported in primary lymphoma and colorectal cancer.

gene:HGNC:9826:function.text: RAD54L encodes DNA repair and recombination protein RAD54-like. It participates in DNA repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:9829:function.text: RAF1 encodes RAF proto-oncogene serine/threonine-protein kinase. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9829:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome 5 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9829:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RAF1 have been reported in amphicrine-like carcinoma, pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma, and pancreatic acinar cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9848:function.text: RANBP2 encodes E3 SUMO-protein ligase RanBP2. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and centrosome localization.

gene:HGNC:9848:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with familial acute necrotizing encephalopathy (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9848:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RANBP2 have been reported in epithelioid inflammatory myofibroblastic sarcoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and renal clear cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9864:function.text: RARA encodes retinoic acid receptor alpha. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:9864:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RARA have been reported in acute promyelocytic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:9871:function.text: RASA1 encodes ras GTPase-activating protein 1. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9871:germline.text: Germline disease associations include capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9871:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RASA1 have been reported in lung squamous cell carcinoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9884:function.text: RB1 encodes the retinoblastoma tumor-suppressor protein, which restrains E2F-dependent transcription and regulates progression from G1 into the DNA-synthesis phase of the cell cycle.

gene:HGNC:9884:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with retinoblastoma (autosomal dominant); hereditary retinoblastoma (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9884:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RB1 have been reported in retinoblastoma, small cell lung carcinoma, and small cell lung cancer.

gene:HGNC:9891:function.text: RBBP8 encodes DNA endonuclease RBBP8. It participates in homologous recombination and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:9891:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Jawad syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9896:function.text: RBM10 encodes ribosome biogenesis inhibitor MINAS-60. It participates in negative regulation of ribosomal large subunit export from nucleus.

gene:HGNC:9896:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with TARP syndrome (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:9896:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RBM10 have been reported in cholangiocarcinoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:14959:function.text: RBM15 encodes RNA-binding protein 15. It participates in regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and RNA methylation.

gene:HGNC:14959:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RBM15 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:15923:function.text: RBM39 encodes RNA binding motif protein 39. Its functions include U1 snRNP binding and mRNA processing.

gene:HGNC:15923:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RBM39 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9910:function.text: RBMX encodes RNA-binding motif protein, X chromosome [Cleaved into: RNA-binding motif protein, X chromosome, N-terminally processed]. It participates in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9948:function.text: RECQL encodes ATP-dependent DNA helicase Q1. It participates in DNA repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:9949:function.text: RECQL4 encodes ATP-dependent DNA helicase Q4. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:9949:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Rothmund-Thomson syndrome (autosomal recessive); Baller-Gerold syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:9954:function.text: REL encodes proto-oncogene c-Rel. It participates in canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:9954:somatic.text: REL mutation or amplification has been associated with B-cell lymphomas, including Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:9955:function.text: RELA encodes transcription factor p65. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and chromatin organization.

gene:HGNC:9955:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with combined immunodeficiency due to RELA haploinsufficiency (autosomal dominant); autoinflammatory disease, familial, Behcet-like-3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9955:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RELA have been reported in ependymoma and stomach adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29289:function.text: RELCH encodes RAB11 binding and LisH domain, coiled-coil and HEAT repeat containing. Its functions include intracellular cholesterol transport.

gene:HGNC:29289:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RELCH have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and adrenocortical carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:9966:function.text: REST encodes RE1-silencing transcription factor. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and host-mediated suppression of viral transcription.

gene:HGNC:9966:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Wilms tumor 6 (autosomal dominant); fibromatosis, gingival, 5 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9967:function.text: RET encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase that transduces signals from glial-cell-line-derived neurotrophic factor family ligands through coreceptor-dependent signaling.

gene:HGNC:9967:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2A (autosomal dominant); multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2B (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:9967:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RET have been reported in pheochromocytoma, cutaneous melanoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:20788:function.text: RHBDF2 encodes inactive rhomboid protein 2. It participates in regulation of protein secretion and negative regulation of protein secretion.

gene:HGNC:20788:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with palmoplantar keratoderma-esophageal carcinoma syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18140:function.text: RHCG encodes ammonium transporter Rh type C. It participates in amine transport and ammonium excretion.

gene:HGNC:10011:function.text: RHEB encodes GTP-binding protein Rheb. It participates in signal transduction and small GTPase-mediated signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:667:function.text: RHOA encodes transforming protein RhoA. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and Rho protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:667:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RHOA have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma, appendiceal goblet cell adenocarcinoma, and nodal t-follicular helper cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:686:function.text: RHOH encodes rho-related GTP-binding protein RhoH. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:686:somatic.text: RHOH can be affected by aberrant somatic mutation or rearrangement in leukemias and lymphomas, including rearrangements involving BCL6.

gene:HGNC:21168:function.text: RHOT1 encodes mitochondrial Rho GTPase 1. It participates in cellular homeostasis and mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization.

gene:HGNC:28611:function.text: RICTOR encodes rapamycin-insensitive companion of mTOR. It participates in regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:23207:function.text: RIF1 encodes telomere-associated protein RIF1. It participates in telomere maintenance and telomere maintenance in response to DNA damage.

gene:HGNC:17282:function.text: RIMS1 encodes regulating synaptic membrane exocytosis 1. Its functions include GTPase regulator activity and small GTPase binding.

gene:HGNC:17282:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RIMS1 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17283:function.text: RIMS2 encodes regulating synaptic membrane exocytosis 2. Its functions include small GTPase binding and structural constituent of presynaptic active zone.

gene:HGNC:17283:germline.text: Germline disease associations include cone-rod synaptic disorder syndrome, congenital nonprogressive (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:17283:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RIMS2 have been reported in breast carcinoma, esophageal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:21876:function.text: RINT1 encodes RAD50-interacting protein 1. It participates in mitotic G2 DNA damage checkpoint signaling and regulation of ER to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport.

gene:HGNC:21876:germline.text: Germline disease associations include infantile liver failure syndrome 3 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:21390:function.text: RIPPLY2 encodes ripply transcriptional repressor 2. Its functions include embryonic pattern specification and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:21390:germline.text: Germline disease associations include spondylocostal dysostosis 6, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:21390:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RIPPLY2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10023:function.text: RIT1 encodes GTP-binding protein Rit1. It participates in signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:10023:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome 8 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10023:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RIT1 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18505:function.text: RNF43 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase RNF43. It participates in protein ubiquitination and stem cell proliferation.

gene:HGNC:18505:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with sessile serrated polyposis cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18505:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RNF43 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma, mucinous carcinoma of ovary, and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10071:function.text: RNF8 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase RNF8. It participates in DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling and positive regulation of DNA repair.

gene:HGNC:10249:function.text: ROBO1 encodes roundabout homolog 1. It participates in positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction and aorta development.

gene:HGNC:10249:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurooculorenal syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:10261:function.text: ROS1 encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase whose signaling can regulate cellular proliferation, survival, and differentiation.

gene:HGNC:10261:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ROS1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and infant-type hemispheric glioma.

gene:HGNC:10289:function.text: RPA1 encodes replication protein A 70 kDa DNA-binding subunit [Cleaved into: Replication protein A 70 kDa DNA-binding subunit, N-terminally processed]. It participates in DNA repair and mismatch repair.

gene:HGNC:10289:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pulmonary fibrosis and/or bone marrow failure, telomere-related, 6 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17976:function.text: RPL10L encodes ribosomal protein L10 like. Its functions include structural constituent of ribosome and male meiosis I.

gene:HGNC:17976:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RPL10L have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, colorectal carcinoma, and esophageal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10388:function.text: RPS15 encodes small ribosomal subunit protein uS19. It participates in positive regulation of signal transduction by p53 class mediator and translation.

gene:HGNC:10402:function.text: RPS19 encodes small ribosomal subunit protein eS19. It participates in translation and cytoplasmic translation.

gene:HGNC:10402:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Diamond-Blackfan anemia (autosomal dominant); Diamond-Blackfan anemia 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10414:function.text: RPS26 encodes small ribosomal subunit protein eS26. It participates in negative regulation of RNA splicing and translation.

gene:HGNC:10414:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Diamond-Blackfan anemia 10 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10433:function.text: RPS6KA4 encodes ribosomal protein S6 kinase alpha-4. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:10436:function.text: RPS6KB1 encodes ribosomal protein S6 kinase beta-1. It participates in regulation of kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:10437:function.text: RPS6KB2 encodes ribosomal protein S6 kinase beta-2. It participates in signal transduction and translation.

gene:HGNC:30287:function.text: RPTOR encodes regulatory-associated protein of mTOR (p150 target of rapamycin (TOR)-scaffold protein). It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase III and TOR signaling.

gene:HGNC:19902:function.text: RRAGC encodes ras-related GTP-binding protein C. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and RNA splicing.

gene:HGNC:19902:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RRAGC have been reported in non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:10447:function.text: RRAS encodes ras-related protein R-Ras. It participates in Ras protein signal transduction and regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:17271:function.text: RRAS2 encodes ras-related protein R-Ras2. It participates in Ras protein signal transduction and osteoblast differentiation.

gene:HGNC:17271:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); noonan syndrome 12 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17271:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RRAS2 have been reported in endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10448:function.text: RRBP1 encodes ribosome-binding protein 1. It participates in translation and osteoblast differentiation.

gene:HGNC:10448:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RRBP1 have been reported in epithelioid inflammatory myofibroblastic sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:10449:function.text: RREB1 encodes ras-responsive element-binding protein 1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:24765:function.text: RSBN1L encodes round spermatid basic protein 1 like. Its functions include protein demethylase activity.

gene:HGNC:24765:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RSBN1L have been reported in breast carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:28583:function.text: RSPO2 encodes r-spondin-2. It participates in limb development and positive regulation of Wnt signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:28583:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with tetraamelia syndrome 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:20866:function.text: RSPO3 encodes r-spondin-3. It participates in sprouting angiogenesis and blood vessel remodeling.

gene:HGNC:15888:function.text: RTEL1 encodes regulator of telomere elongation helicase 1. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:15888:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pulmonary fibrosis and/or bone marrow failure, Telomere-related, 3 (semidominant); dyskeratosis congenita, autosomal recessive 5 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:19364:function.text: RTKN2 encodes rhotekin 2. Its functions include adaptive immune response and hemopoiesis.

gene:HGNC:19364:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RTKN2 have been reported in glioblastoma, breast carcinoma, and cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:10471:function.text: RUNX1 encodes a DNA-binding transcription factor that forms the core-binding factor complex with CBFB and regulates hematopoietic development and differentiation.

gene:HGNC:10471:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary thrombocytopenia and hematologic cancer predisposition syndrome (autosomal dominant); hereditary thrombocytopenia and hematological cancer predisposition syndrome associated with RUNX1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10471:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RUNX1 have been reported in myeloid sarcoma, systemic mastocytosis, and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:1535:function.text: RUNX1T1 encodes protein CBFA2T1. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:1535:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RUNX1T1 have been reported in myeloid sarcoma, acute myeloid leukemia, and melanoma.

gene:HGNC:10472:function.text: RUNX2 encodes runt-related transcription factor 2. It participates in SMAD protein signal transduction and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:10472:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cleidocranial dysplasia 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10472:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RUNX2 have been reported in blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

gene:HGNC:10477:function.text: RXRA encodes retinoic acid receptor RXR-alpha. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:10477:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RXRA have been reported in bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10480:function.text: RYBP encodes RING1 and YY1-binding protein. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:10493:function.text: S100A3 encodes S100 calcium binding protein A3. Its functions include calcium ion binding and calcium-dependent protein binding.

gene:HGNC:10493:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving S100A3 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10498:function.text: S100A8 encodes S100 calcium binding protein A8. Its functions include arachidonate binding and calcium ion binding.

gene:HGNC:10498:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving S100A8 have been reported in glioblastoma, thyroid carcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:1348:function.text: SAMD9 encodes sterile alpha motif domain-containing protein 9. It participates in endosomal vesicle fusion.

gene:HGNC:1348:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with SAMD9-related spectrum and myeloid neoplasm risk (autosomal dominant); MIRAGE syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:1349:function.text: SAMD9L encodes a SAM-domain-containing protein implicated in regulation of cellular growth and hematopoietic homeostasis.

gene:HGNC:1349:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with SAMD9L-related spectrum and myeloid neoplasm risk (autosomal dominant); ataxia-pancytopenia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:15925:function.text: SAMHD1 encodes deoxynucleoside triphosphate triphosphohydrolase SAMHD1. It participates in double-strand break repair via homologous recombination and immune response.

gene:HGNC:15925:germline.text: Germline disease associations include SAMHD1-related type 1 interferonopathy (autosomal recessive); Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome 5 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:15925:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SAMHD1 have been reported in plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:19440:function.text: SBDS encodes ribosome maturation protein SBDS. It participates in bone mineralization and leukocyte chemotaxis.

gene:HGNC:19440:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Shwachman-Diamond syndrome (autosomal recessive); Shwachman-Diamond syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:21646:function.text: SBDSP1 is a pseudogene related to SBDS. Sequence homology with SBDS can complicate variant mapping.

gene:HGNC:10816:function.text: SCG5 encodes neuroendocrine protein 7B2 [Cleaved into: N-terminal peptide; C-terminal peptide]. It participates in intracellular protein transport and neuropeptide signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:10816:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary mixed polyposis syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10680:function.text: SDHA encodes succinate dehydrogenase [ubiquinone] flavoprotein subunit, mitochondrial. It participates in nervous system development and succinate metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:10680:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); mitochondrial disease (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:10680:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SDHA have been reported in paraganglioma, gastrointestinal stromal tumor, and SDH-deficient renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:26034:function.text: SDHAF2 encodes succinate dehydrogenase assembly factor 2, mitochondrial. It participates in protein dephosphorylation and protein-FAD linkage.

gene:HGNC:26034:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:26034:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SDHAF2 have been reported in paraganglioma.

gene:HGNC:10681:function.text: SDHB encodes succinate dehydrogenase [ubiquinone] iron-sulfur subunit, mitochondrial. It participates in aerobic respiration and succinate metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:10681:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); mitochondrial disease (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:10681:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SDHB have been reported in paraganglioma, SDH-deficient renal cell carcinoma, and succinate dehydrogenase (SDH)-deficient gastrointestinal stromal tumor.

gene:HGNC:10682:function.text: SDHC encodes succinate dehydrogenase cytochrome b560 subunit, mitochondrial. It participates in aerobic respiration and tricarboxylic acid cycle.

gene:HGNC:10682:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10682:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SDHC have been reported in paraganglioma, SDH-deficient renal cell carcinoma, and succinate dehydrogenase (SDH)-deficient gastrointestinal stromal tumor.

gene:HGNC:10683:function.text: SDHD encodes succinate dehydrogenase [ubiquinone] cytochrome b small subunit, mitochondrial. It participates in tricarboxylic acid cycle and mitochondrial electron transport, succinate to ubiquinone.

gene:HGNC:10683:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10683:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SDHD have been reported in paraganglioma, SDH-deficient renal cell carcinoma, and succinate dehydrogenase (SDH)-deficient gastrointestinal stromal tumor.

gene:HGNC:10730:function.text: SEMA4B encodes semaphorin 4B. Its functions include chemorepellent activity and neuropilin binding.

gene:HGNC:10730:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SEMA4B have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:20607:function.text: SERP2 encodes stress-associated endoplasmic reticulum protein 2. It participates in endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response.

gene:HGNC:8941:function.text: SERPINA1 encodes alpha-1-antitrypsin [Cleaved into: Short peptide from AAT]. Its functions include serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity and protease binding.

gene:HGNC:8941:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with alpha 1-antitrypsin deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:10569:function.text: SERPINB3 encodes serpin B3. It participates in regulation of apoptotic process.

gene:HGNC:10570:function.text: SERPINB4 encodes serpin B4. It participates in regulation of proteolysis and protection from natural killer cell mediated cytotoxicity.

gene:HGNC:8583:function.text: SERPINE1 encodes plasminogen activator inhibitor 1. It participates in angiogenesis and dentinogenesis.

gene:HGNC:8583:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital plasminogen activator inhibitor type 1 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:21595:function.text: SESN1 encodes sestrin-1. It participates in cellular oxidant detoxification and positive regulation of macroautophagy.

gene:HGNC:20746:function.text: SESN2 encodes sestrin-2. It participates in activation of protein kinase activity and DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator.

gene:HGNC:23060:function.text: SESN3 encodes sestrin-3. It participates in TORC2 signaling and glucose homeostasis.

gene:HGNC:15573:function.text: SETBP1 encodes SET-binding protein. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:15573:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Schinzel-Giedion midface retraction syndrome (autosomal dominant); complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:15573:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SETBP1 have been reported in MDS/MPN with neutrophilia, chronic neutrophilic leukemia, and adrenocortical carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29010:function.text: SETD1A encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETD1A. It participates in regulation of chromatin organization and brain development.

gene:HGNC:29010:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurodevelopmental disorder with speech impairment and dysmorphic facies (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:29187:function.text: SETD1B encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETD1B. Its functions include histone H3 methyltransferase activity and histone H3K4 monomethyltransferase activity.

gene:HGNC:29187:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder with seizures and language delay (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:29187:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SETD1B have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, esophageal adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18420:function.text: SETD2 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETD2. It participates in mismatch repair and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:18420:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with SETD2-related neurodevelopmental disorder without or with macrocephaly/overgrowth (autosomal dominant); SETD2-related microcephaly-severe intellectual disability-multiple congenital anomalies syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18420:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SETD2 have been reported in mesothelioma, collecting duct carcinoma, and hepatosplenic t-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:20493:function.text: SETD3 encodes actin-histidine N-methyltransferase. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and actin filament organization.
