gene:HGNC:1258:function.text: SETD4 encodes SET domain-containing protein 4. It participates in chromatin remodeling and positive regulation of inflammatory response.

gene:HGNC:25566:function.text: SETD5 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETD5. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of chromatin organization.

gene:HGNC:25566:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual disability-facial dysmorphism syndrome due to SETD5 haploinsufficiency (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:26116:function.text: SETD6 encodes n-lysine methyltransferase SETD6. It participates in peptidyl-lysine monomethylation and stem cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:30412:function.text: SETD7 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETD7. It participates in chromatin organization and heterochromatin organization.

gene:HGNC:10761:function.text: SETDB1 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETDB1. It participates in heterochromatin organization and DNA methylation-dependent constitutive heterochromatin formation.

gene:HGNC:10761:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SETDB1 have been reported in colon adenocarcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:20263:function.text: SETDB2 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETDB2. It participates in heterochromatin organization and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:10768:function.text: SF3B1 encodes a component of the U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein complex that participates in branch-point recognition during pre-mRNA splicing.

gene:HGNC:10768:somatic.text: Somatic SF3B1 mutations occur in myelodysplastic neoplasms, particularly those with ring sideroblasts.

gene:HGNC:10774:function.text: SFPQ encodes splicing factor, proline- and glutamine-rich. It participates in RNA splicing and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:10774:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SFPQ have been reported in PEComa, malignant and TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10810:function.text: SGK1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase Sgk1. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of signal transduction by p53 class mediator.

gene:HGNC:10810:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SGK1 have been reported in t-cell/histiocyte-rich large b-cell lymphoma, nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, and malignant lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:29605:function.text: SH2B3 encodes SH2B adapter protein 3. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and negative regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:29605:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with SH2B3-related immune system disorder (semidominant).

gene:HGNC:29605:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SH2B3 have been reported in indolent NK-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

gene:HGNC:10820:function.text: SH2D1A encodes SH2 domain-containing protein 1A. It participates in cell-cell signaling and cellular defense response.

gene:HGNC:10820:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked lymphoproliferative disease due to SH2D1A deficiency (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:23664:function.text: SH3PXD2A encodes SH3 and PX domain-containing protein 2A. It participates in osteoclast fusion and superoxide anion generation.

gene:HGNC:10838:function.text: SHB encodes SH2 domain containing adaptor protein B. Its functions include phosphotyrosine residue binding and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:10838:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SHB have been reported in glioblastoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10848:function.text: SHH encodes sonic hedgehog protein [Cleaved into: Sonic hedgehog protein N-product]. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:10848:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with holoprosencephaly 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10848:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SHH have been reported in medulloblastoma.

gene:HGNC:15454:function.text: SHOC2 encodes leucine-rich repeat protein SHOC-2. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:15454:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Noonan syndrome-like disorder with loose anagen hair (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome-like disorder with loose anagen hair 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:25543:function.text: SHQ1 encodes protein SHQ1 homolog. It participates in protein-RNA complex assembly and box H/ACA snoRNP assembly.

gene:HGNC:25543:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurodevelopmental disorder with dystonia and seizures (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:24084:function.text: SHROOM1 encodes shroom family member 1. Its functions include actin filament binding and myosin II binding.

gene:HGNC:24084:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SHROOM1 have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10887:function.text: SIX1 encodes homeobox protein SIX1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:10887:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with branchio-oto-renal syndrome (autosomal dominant); autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 23 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:10887:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SIX1 have been reported in Wilms tumor and wilms' tumor.

gene:HGNC:10888:function.text: SIX2 encodes homeobox protein SIX2. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and cell migration.

gene:HGNC:10888:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SIX2 have been reported in Wilms tumor.

gene:HGNC:10903:function.text: SLAMF1 encodes signaling lymphocytic activation molecule. It participates in signal transduction and immune response.

gene:HGNC:31037:function.text: SLC16A13 encodes solute carrier family 16 member 13. Its functions include monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity.

gene:HGNC:31037:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SLC16A13 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:10983:function.text: SLC25A13 encodes electrogenic aspartate/glutamate antiporter SLC25A13, mitochondrial. It participates in cellular respiration and malate-aspartate shuttle.

gene:HGNC:10983:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with citrin deficiency (autosomal recessive); neonatal intrahepatic cholestasis due to citrin deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:10999:function.text: SLC27A5 encodes solute carrier family 27 member 5. Its functions include cholate-CoA ligase activity and long-chain fatty acid transmembrane transporter activity.

gene:HGNC:10999:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SLC27A5 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11020:function.text: SLC34A2 encodes sodium-dependent phosphate transport protein 2B (Na(+)-dependent phosphate cotransporter 2B)/Pi cotransporter 2B). It participates in phosphate ion transport and response to estrogen.

gene:HGNC:11020:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pulmonary alveolar microlithiasis (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:11020:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SLC34A2 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, acute myeloid leukemia, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11026:function.text: SLC3A2 encodes amino acid transporter heavy chain SLC3A2. It participates in L-histidine transport and L-leucine transport.

gene:HGNC:18798:function.text: SLC44A1 encodes choline transporter-like protein 1. It participates in choline transport and ethanolamine transport.

gene:HGNC:18798:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurodegeneration, childhood-onset, with ataxia, tremor, optic atrophy, and cognitive decline (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:16438:function.text: SLC4A11 encodes solute carrier family 4 member 11. Its functions include bicarbonate transmembrane transporter activity and borate efflux transmembrane transporter activity.

gene:HGNC:16438:germline.text: Germline disease associations include congenital hereditary endothelial dystrophy of cornea (autosomal recessive); corneal dystrophy-perceptive deafness syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:16438:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SLC4A11 have been reported in breast carcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:32934:function.text: SLCO1B7 encodes solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B7 (putative). Its functions include bile acid transmembrane transporter activity and secondary active transmembrane transporter activity.

gene:HGNC:32934:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SLCO1B7 have been reported in glioblastoma, breast carcinoma, and cervical carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:26633:function.text: SLFN11 encodes schlafen family member 11. It participates in chromatin remodeling and DNA damage response.

gene:HGNC:11086:function.text: SLIT2 encodes slit homolog 2 protein [Cleaved into: Slit homolog 2 protein N-product; Slit homolog 2 protein C-product]. It participates in negative regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction and axon guidance.

gene:HGNC:16643:function.text: SLMAP encodes sarcolemmal membrane-associated protein. It participates in muscle contraction and negative regulation of hippo signaling.

gene:HGNC:16643:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SLMAP have been reported in kinase-altered spindle cell neoplasm (non-NTRK), malignant.

gene:HGNC:20922:function.text: SLX1A encodes structure-specific endonuclease subunit SLX1. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance via telomere lengthening.

gene:HGNC:28748:function.text: SLX1B encodes structure-specific endonuclease subunit SLX1. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance via telomere lengthening.

gene:HGNC:23845:function.text: SLX4 encodes structure-specific endonuclease subunit SLX4. It participates in DNA repair and positive regulation of telomere maintenance.

gene:HGNC:23845:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Fanconi anemia complementation group P (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:6768:function.text: SMAD2 encodes SMAD family member 2. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:6768:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Loeys-Dietz syndrome 6 (autosomal dominant); congenital heart disease (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6768:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SMAD2 have been reported in colon adenocarcinoma and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6769:function.text: SMAD3 encodes SMAD family member 3. It participates in SMAD protein signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:6769:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with aneurysm-osteoarthritis syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6769:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SMAD3 have been reported in colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6770:function.text: SMAD4 encodes a shared signaling mediator that forms complexes with receptor-activated SMAD proteins to regulate transcription downstream of TGF-β superfamily receptors.

gene:HGNC:6770:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Myhre syndrome (autosomal dominant); juvenile polyposis/hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:6770:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SMAD4 have been reported in gallbladder carcinoma, ampullary adenocarcinoma, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:6774:function.text: SMAD9 encodes SMAD family member 9. It participates in SMAD protein signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:6774:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pulmonary arterial hypertension (autosomal dominant); pulmonary hypertension, primary, 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11097:function.text: SMARCA1 encodes SWI/SNF-related matrix-associated actin-dependent regulator of chromatin subfamily A member 1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11097:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:11098:function.text: SMARCA2 encodes SWI/SNF-related matrix-associated actin-dependent regulator of chromatin subfamily A member 2. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11098:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with intellectual disability-sparse hair-brachydactyly syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11098:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SMARCA2 have been reported in SWI/SNF complex-deficient undifferentiated carcinoma of the GI tract / pancreas and salivary carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11100:function.text: SMARCA4 encodes BRG1, an ATP-dependent catalytic subunit of SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complexes that regulate nucleosome organization and gene expression.

gene:HGNC:11100:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11100:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SMARCA4 have been reported in small cell carcinoma of ovary, hypercalcemic type, thoracic SMARCA4-deficient undifferentiated tumor, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11103:function.text: SMARCB1 encodes a core component of SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complexes that regulate access to DNA and control transcriptional and differentiation programs.

gene:HGNC:11103:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11103:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SMARCB1 have been reported in chordoma, epithelioid sarcoma, and rhabdoid tumor of kidney.

gene:HGNC:11104:function.text: SMARCC1 encodes SWI/SNF complex subunit SMARCC1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11104:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with SMARCC1-associated developmental dysgenesis syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11105:function.text: SMARCC2 encodes SWI/SNF complex subunit SMARCC2. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11105:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); Coffin-Siris syndrome 8 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11106:function.text: SMARCD1 encodes SWI/SNF-related matrix-associated actin-dependent regulator of chromatin subfamily D member 1. It participates in transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11109:function.text: SMARCE1 encodes SWI/SNF-related matrix-associated actin-dependent regulator of chromatin subfamily E member 1. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11109:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); familial meningioma (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11111:function.text: SMC1A encodes structural maintenance of chromosomes protein 1A. It participates in DNA repair and meiotic cell cycle.

gene:HGNC:11111:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 2 (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:11111:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SMC1A have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:2468:function.text: SMC3 encodes structural maintenance of chromosomes protein 3. It participates in meiotic cell cycle and mitotic cell cycle.

gene:HGNC:2468:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Cornelia de Lange syndrome (autosomal dominant); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:30045:function.text: SMG1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase SMG1. It participates in regulation of telomere maintenance and peptidyl-serine phosphorylation.

gene:HGNC:11119:function.text: SMO encodes protein smoothened. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11119:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Curry-Jones syndrome (autosomal dominant); congenital hypothalamic hamartoma syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:11119:mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with mosaic SMO syndrome.

gene:HGNC:11119:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SMO have been reported in medulloblastoma, basal cell carcinoma of skin, and skin.

gene:HGNC:24764:function.text: SMTNL2 encodes smoothelin like 2. Its functions include actin cytoskeleton organization.

gene:HGNC:24764:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SMTNL2 have been reported in breast carcinoma and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:15513:function.text: SMYD3 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SMYD3. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and heart development.

gene:HGNC:11139:function.text: SNCAIP encodes synphilin-1. It participates in cell death and dopamine metabolic process.

gene:HGNC:30646:function.text: SND1 encodes staphylococcal nuclease domain-containing protein 1. It participates in osteoblast differentiation and mRNA catabolic process.

gene:HGNC:30646:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SND1 have been reported in pancreatic acinar cell carcinoma and cervical squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11160:function.text: SNRPD3 encodes small nuclear ribonucleoprotein D3 polypeptide. Its functions include enzyme binding and histone pre-mRNA DCP binding.

gene:HGNC:11160:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SNRPD3 have been reported in cervical carcinoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:19383:function.text: SOCS1 encodes suppressor of cytokine signaling 1. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and macrophage differentiation.

gene:HGNC:19383:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autoinflammatory syndrome with immunodeficiency (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:19383:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SOCS1 have been reported in classic Hodgkin lymphoma, mediastinal gray zone lymphoma, and primary mediastinal large b-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:19382:function.text: SOCS2 encodes suppressor of cytokine signaling 2. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:19391:function.text: SOCS3 encodes suppressor of cytokine signaling 3. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and protein ubiquitination.

gene:HGNC:11187:function.text: SOS1 encodes son of sevenless homolog 1. It participates in signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:11187:germline.text: Germline disease associations include Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome 4 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11187:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SOS1 have been reported in endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11190:function.text: SOX10 encodes transcription factor SOX-10. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11190:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Waardenburg syndrome type 4C (autosomal dominant); PCWH syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11191:function.text: SOX11 encodes transcription factor SOX-11. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11191:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with SOX11-related complex neurodevelopmental disorder with or without congenital anomalies (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder with microcephaly and with or without ocular malformations or hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18122:function.text: SOX17 encodes transcription factor SOX-17. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:18122:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pulmonary arterial hypertension (autosomal dominant); vesicoureteral reflux 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:18122:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SOX17 have been reported in endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11195:function.text: SOX2 encodes transcription factor SOX-2. It participates in chromatin organization and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11195:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with anophthalmia/microphthalmia-esophageal atresia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11195:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SOX2 have been reported in lung squamous cell carcinoma and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11204:function.text: SOX9 encodes transcription factor SOX-9. It participates in signal transduction and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11204:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with campomelic dysplasia (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11204:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SOX9 have been reported in appendiceal goblet cell adenocarcinoma, colon adenocarcinoma, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17133:function.text: SP140 encodes nuclear body protein SP140. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and defense response.

gene:HGNC:17133:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SP140 have been reported in plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:17575:function.text: SPEN encodes msx2-interacting protein. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:17575:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Radio-Tartaglia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17575:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SPEN have been reported in malignant lymphoma, salivary carcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11241:function.text: SPI1 encodes transcription factor PU.1. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling.

gene:HGNC:11241:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with agammaglobulinemia 10, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11241:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SPI1 have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11254:function.text: SPOP encodes speckle-type POZ protein. It participates in protein polyubiquitination and regulation of proteolysis.

gene:HGNC:11254:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurodevelopmental disorder with relative macrocephaly and with or without cardiac or endocrine anomalies (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder with microcephaly and dysmorphic facies (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11254:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SPOP have been reported in prostate adenocarcinoma, prostate, and non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:20249:function.text: SPRED1 encodes sprouty-related, EVH1 domain-containing protein 1. It participates in negative regulation of intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator.

gene:HGNC:20249:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Legius syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:25356:function.text: SPRTN encodes DNA-dependent metalloprotease SPRTN. It participates in proteolysis and protein autoprocessing.

gene:HGNC:11272:function.text: SPTA1 encodes spectrin alpha chain, erythrocytic 1. It participates in actin cytoskeleton organization and actin filament organization.

gene:HGNC:11272:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary spherocytosis type 3 (autosomal recessive); elliptocytosis 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11283:function.text: SRC encodes proto-oncogene tyrosine-protein kinase Src. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:16974:function.text: SRCAP encodes chromatin remodeling protein SRCAP. It participates in cAMP/PKA signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:16974:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Floating-Harbor syndrome (autosomal dominant); developmental delay, hypotonia, musculoskeletal defects, and behavioral abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11291:function.text: SRF encodes serum response factor. It participates in negative regulation of miRNA transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:11300:function.text: SRP19 encodes signal recognition particle 19 kDa protein. It participates in cotranslational protein targeting to membrane and SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane, signal sequence recognition.

gene:HGNC:11301:function.text: SRP54 encodes signal recognition particle subunit SRP54. It participates in granulocyte differentiation and neutrophil chemotaxis.

gene:HGNC:11301:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neutropenia, severe congenital, 8, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11303:function.text: SRP72 encodes signal recognition particle subunit SRP72. It participates in SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane and SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane, signal sequence recognition.

gene:HGNC:10783:function.text: SRSF2 encodes a serine/arginine-rich RNA-binding splicing factor that regulates splice-site selection and processing of pre-mRNA.

gene:HGNC:10783:somatic.text: Somatic SRSF2 mutations occur in myelodysplastic and myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasms.

gene:HGNC:11311:function.text: SRY encodes sex-determining region Y protein. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11340:function.text: SS18 encodes protein SSXT. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11340:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SS18 have been reported in synovial sarcoma and microsecretory adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:15592:function.text: SS18L1 encodes calcium-responsive transactivator. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:15674:function.text: SSBP3 encodes single stranded DNA binding protein 3. Its functions include single-stranded DNA binding and transcription coactivator activity.

gene:HGNC:15674:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SSBP3 have been reported in cervical carcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11335:function.text: SSX1 encodes protein SSX1. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and spermatogenesis.

gene:HGNC:11335:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SSX1 have been reported in synovial sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:11336:function.text: SSX2 encodes protein SSX2. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11336:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SSX2 have been reported in synovial sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:11338:function.text: SSX4 encodes protein SSX4. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11338:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SSX4 have been reported in synovial sarcoma.

gene:HGNC:11354:function.text: STAG1 encodes cohesin subunit SA-1. It participates in mitotic spindle assembly and sister chromatid cohesion.

gene:HGNC:11354:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 47 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11355:function.text: STAG2 encodes cohesin subunit SA-2. It participates in mitotic spindle assembly and sister chromatid cohesion.

gene:HGNC:11355:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Mullegama-Klein-Martinez syndrome (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:11355:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving STAG2 have been reported in urothelial carcinoma, bladder urothelial carcinoma, and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:11364:function.text: STAT3 encodes signal transducer and activator of transcription 3. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11364:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with STAT3-related early-onset multisystem autoimmune disease (autosomal dominant); hyper-IgE recurrent infection syndrome 1, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11364:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving STAT3 have been reported in mycosis fungoides, extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, and hepatosplenic t-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11365:function.text: STAT4 encodes signal transducer and activator of transcription 4. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11366:function.text: STAT5A encodes signal transducer and activator of transcription 5A. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11367:function.text: STAT5B encodes signal transducer and activator of transcription 5B. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11367:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with growth hormone insensitivity with immune dysregulation 1, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive); growth hormone insensitivity syndrome with immune dysregulation 2, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11367:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving STAT5B have been reported in mycosis fungoides, chronic eosinophilic leukemia, and hepatosplenic t-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11368:function.text: STAT6 encodes signal transducer and activator of transcription 6. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11368:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hyper-IgE syndrome 6, autosomal dominant, with recurrent infections (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11368:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving STAT6 have been reported in classic Hodgkin lymphoma, mediastinal gray zone lymphoma, and primary mediastinal large b-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:10879:function.text: STIL encodes SCL-interrupting locus protein. It participates in centrosome duplication and forebrain development.

gene:HGNC:10879:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal recessive primary microcephaly (autosomal recessive); microcephaly 7, primary, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:10879:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving STIL have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11389:function.text: STK11 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase STK11. It participates in activation of protein kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:11389:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11389:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving STK11 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, STK11 adnexal tumor, and adenocarcinoma of cervix.

gene:HGNC:21373:function.text: STK40 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase 40. It participates in regulation of MAPK cascade.

gene:HGNC:11424:function.text: STRN encodes striatin. It participates in regulation of signal transduction and dendrite development.

gene:HGNC:11424:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving STRN have been reported in ALK-rearranged renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:16466:function.text: SUFU encodes suppressor of fused homolog. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:16466:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with medulloblastoma (autosomal dominant); nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:16466:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SUFU have been reported in medulloblastoma and basal cell carcinoma of skin.

gene:HGNC:17101:function.text: SUZ12 encodes polycomb protein SUZ12. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and heterochromatin formation.

gene:HGNC:17101:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Imagawa-Matsumoto syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:17101:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SUZ12 have been reported in endometrial stromal sarcoma, malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:31412:function.text: SWI5 encodes SWI5 homologous recombination repair protein. Its functions include cellular response to ionizing radiation and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:31412:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SWI5 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:11491:function.text: SYK encodes tyrosine-protein kinase SYK. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11491:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 82 with systemic inflammation (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11491:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SYK have been reported in nodal t-follicular helper cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:14962:function.text: SYT13 encodes synaptotagmin 13. Its functions include calcium ion sensor activity and calcium-dependent phospholipid binding.

gene:HGNC:14962:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SYT13 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11522:function.text: TACC1 encodes transforming acidic coiled-coil-containing protein 1. It participates in neurogenesis and nuclear migration.

gene:HGNC:11524:function.text: TACC3 encodes transforming acidic coiled-coil-containing protein 3. It participates in neurogenesis and chromosome segregation.

gene:HGNC:11524:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TACC3 have been reported in urothelial carcinoma and glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype.

gene:HGNC:11535:function.text: TAF1 encodes transcription initiation factor TFIID subunit 1250). It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11535:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked, syndromic 33 (x-linked); X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:11547:function.text: TAF15 encodes TATA-binding protein-associated factor 2N68). It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and mRNA stabilization.

gene:HGNC:11547:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TAF15 have been reported in extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma and pleural mesothelioma.

gene:HGNC:11577:function.text: TAFAZZIN encodes tafazzin. It participates in cristae formation and cardiolipin acyl-chain remodeling.

gene:HGNC:11577:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Barth syndrome (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:11556:function.text: TAL1 encodes t-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia protein 1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of chromatin organization.

gene:HGNC:11556:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TAL1 have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11557:function.text: TAL2 encodes t-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia protein 2. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11557:somatic.text: TAL2 activation through rearrangements involving the T-cell receptor locus has been described in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

gene:HGNC:43:function.text: TAP1 encodes antigen peptide transporter 1. It participates in defense response and peptide transport.

gene:HGNC:43:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with MHC class I deficiency (autosomal recessive); MHC class I deficiency 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:44:function.text: TAP2 encodes antigen peptide transporter 2. It participates in defense response and peptide transport.

gene:HGNC:44:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with MHC class I deficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:11569:function.text: TARBP2 encodes TARBP2 subunit of RISC loading complex. Its functions include double-stranded RNA binding and enzyme binding.

gene:HGNC:11569:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TARBP2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, colorectal carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29529:function.text: TBL1XR1 encodes f-box-like/WD repeat-containing protein TBL1XR1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:29529:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); Pierpont syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:29529:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TBL1XR1 have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma, malignant lymphoma, and non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11597:function.text: TBX2 encodes T-box transcription factor 2. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor binding.

gene:HGNC:11597:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TBX2 have been reported in low-grade glioma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11599:function.text: TBX21 encodes t-box transcription factor TBX21. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11602:function.text: TBX3 encodes t-box transcription factor TBX3. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11602:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with ulnar-mammary syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11602:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TBX3 have been reported in neuroendocrine tumor of breast, invasive lobular carcinoma of breast, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11515:function.text: TBXT encodes t-box transcription factor T. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11515:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TBXT have been reported in chordoma.

gene:HGNC:11631:function.text: TCF20 encodes transcription factor 20. Its functions include transcription coactivator activity and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11631:germline.text: Germline disease associations include developmental delay with variable intellectual impairment and behavioral abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11631:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TCF20 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:11633:function.text: TCF3 encodes transcription factor E2-alpha. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11633:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal agammaglobulinemia (semidominant).

gene:HGNC:11633:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TCF3 have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma and b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11634:function.text: TCF4 encodes transcription factor 4. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11634:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Pitt-Hopkins syndrome (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11634:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TCF4 have been reported in CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration, medulloblastoma, and pilocytic astrocytoma.

gene:HGNC:11641:function.text: TCF7L2 encodes transcription factor 7-like 2. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11641:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11641:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TCF7L2 have been reported in colon adenocarcinoma, rectal adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11648:function.text: TCL1A encodes t-cell leukemia/lymphoma protein 1A. It participates in intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:11648:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TCL1A have been reported in t-cell prolymphocytic leukemia and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.

gene:HGNC:11700:function.text: TDG encodes G/T mismatch-specific thymine DNA glycosylase. It participates in depyrimidination and base-excision repair.

gene:HGNC:11714:function.text: TEAD1 encodes transcriptional enhancer factor TEF-1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

gene:HGNC:11714:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with helicoid peripapillary chorioretinal degeneration (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11724:function.text: TEK encodes angiopoietin-1 receptor. It participates in positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of Rac protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:11724:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with TEK-related primary glaucoma (autosomal dominant); multiple cutaneous and mucosal venous malformations (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:24712:function.text: TENT5C encodes terminal nucleotidyltransferase 5C polymerase FAM46C). It participates in mRNA stabilization and negative regulation of cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:24712:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TENT5C have been reported in plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:28399:function.text: TENT5D encodes terminal nucleotidyltransferase 5D. Its functions include poly(A) RNA polymerase activity and mRNA stabilization.

gene:HGNC:28399:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TENT5D have been reported in esophageal carcinoma and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11727:function.text: TERC encodes the RNA component of telomerase, providing the template used by the TERT catalytic subunit to add telomeric repeats to chromosome ends.

gene:HGNC:11727:germline.text: Pathogenic constitutional TERC variants cause autosomal dominant telomere biology disorders, including dyskeratosis congenita. Marrow failure and myeloid malignancy risk occur within this inherited disease context.

gene:HGNC:11727:somatic.text: Somatic copy-number gain involving the TERC region has been associated with progression of cervical neoplasia to invasive carcinoma. Regional gain is distinct from the constitutional loss-of-function mechanisms underlying telomere biology disorders.

gene:HGNC:11730:function.text: TERT encodes the catalytic reverse-transcriptase component of telomerase. Together with the TERC RNA template, it adds telomeric repeats to chromosome ends.

gene:HGNC:11730:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with dyskeratosis congenita, autosomal dominant 2 (semidominant); dyskeratosis congenita, autosomal dominant 2 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:11730:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TERT have been reported in liposarcoma, paraganglioma, and chondrosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:29484:function.text: TET1 encodes methylcytosine dioxygenase TET1. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:29484:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TET1 have been reported in colon adenocarcinoma, mixed germ cell tumor, and stomach adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:25941:function.text: TET2 encodes an enzyme that oxidizes methylated cytosine in DNA, contributing to DNA-demethylation pathways and regulation of hematopoietic differentiation.

gene:HGNC:25941:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 75 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:25941:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TET2 have been reported in myelodysplastic neoplasm, chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, and acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:28313:function.text: TET3 encodes methylcytosine dioxygenase TET3. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and protein O-linked glycosylation.

gene:HGNC:28313:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Beck-Fahrner syndrome (autosomal dominant); Beck-Fahrner syndrome (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:11734:function.text: TEX12 encodes testis-expressed protein 12. It participates in homologous recombination and reciprocal meiotic recombination.

gene:HGNC:11748:function.text: TFCP2 encodes alpha-globin transcription factor CP2. It participates in mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11748:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TFCP2 have been reported in rhabdomyosarcoma.

gene:HGNC:11752:function.text: TFE3 encodes transcription factor E3. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:11752:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked).

gene:HGNC:11752:mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked, syndromic, with pigmentary mosaicism and coarse facies.

gene:HGNC:11752:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TFE3 have been reported in PEComa, malignant, alveolar soft part sarcoma, and epithelioid hemangioendothelioma.

gene:HGNC:11753:function.text: TFEB encodes transcription factor EB. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:11753:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TFEB have been reported in TFEB-altered renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11758:function.text: TFG encodes protein TFG. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and COPII vesicle coat assembly.

gene:HGNC:11758:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary motor and sensory neuropathy, Okinawa type (autosomal dominant); hereditary spastic paraplegia 57 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:11758:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TFG have been reported in ALK-positive histiocytosis and NTRK-rearranged spindle cell sarcoma of the uterine cervix / corpus.

gene:HGNC:11763:function.text: TFRC encodes transferrin receptor protein 1 [Cleaved into: Transferrin receptor protein 1, serum form]. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:11763:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with TFRC-related combined immunodeficiency (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:11772:function.text: TGFBR1 encodes TGF-beta receptor type-1. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:11772:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Loeys-Dietz syndrome (autosomal dominant); multiple self-healing squamous epithelioma (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11772:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TGFBR1 have been reported in esophageal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11773:function.text: TGFBR2 encodes TGF-beta receptor type-2. It participates in positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction and vasculogenesis.

gene:HGNC:11773:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Loeys-Dietz syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11773:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TGFBR2 have been reported in pancreas, cervical adenocarcinoma, and esophageal adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11774:function.text: TGFBR3 encodes transforming growth factor beta receptor type 3. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and negative regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:16836:function.text: TGFBRAP1 encodes transforming growth factor beta receptor associated protein 1. Its functions include SMAD binding and transforming growth factor beta receptor binding.

gene:HGNC:16836:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TGFBRAP1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.

gene:HGNC:11784:function.text: THBD encodes thrombomodulin. Its functions include calcium ion binding and signaling receptor activity.

gene:HGNC:11784:germline.text: Germline disease associations include atypical hemolytic-uremic syndrome with thrombomodulin anomaly (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11784:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving THBD have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11796:function.text: THRA encodes thyroid hormone receptor alpha. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

gene:HGNC:11796:germline.text: Germline disease associations include congenital nongoitrous hypothyroidism 6 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11796:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving THRA have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29348:function.text: THSD7B encodes thrombospondin type 1 domain containing 7B. Its functions include actin cytoskeleton organization.

gene:HGNC:29348:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving THSD7B have been reported in glioblastoma, cutaneous melanoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:5056:function.text: TLX1 encodes t-cell leukemia homeobox protein 1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and animal organ development.

gene:HGNC:5056:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TLX1 have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:13532:function.text: TLX3 encodes t-cell leukemia homeobox protein 3. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and animal organ development.

gene:HGNC:13532:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TLX3 have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:26038:function.text: TMEM127 encodes transmembrane protein 127. It participates in regulation of TOR signaling and negative regulation of TOR signaling.

gene:HGNC:26038:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); pheochromocytoma (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:26038:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TMEM127 have been reported in pheochromocytoma.

gene:HGNC:30366:function.text: TMEM131 encodes transmembrane protein 131. Its functions include collagen binding and collagen biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:30366:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TMEM131 have been reported in breast carcinoma, cervical carcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:30414:function.text: TMEM147 encodes transmembrane protein 147. Its functions include ribosome binding and multi-pass transmembrane protein insertion into ER membrane.

gene:HGNC:30414:germline.text: Germline disease associations include neurodevelopmental disorder with facial dysmorphism, absent language, and pseudo-pelger-huet anomaly (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:30414:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TMEM147 have been reported in glioblastoma, endometrial carcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:37208:function.text: TMEM200C encodes transmembrane protein 200C. Its molecular function remains incompletely characterized.

gene:HGNC:37208:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TMEM200C have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, colorectal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:26510:function.text: TMEM68 encodes DGAT1/2-independent enzyme synthesizing storage lipids. It participates in triglyceride biosynthetic process.

gene:HGNC:26510:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TMEM68 have been reported in CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration.

gene:HGNC:11876:function.text: TMPRSS2 encodes transmembrane protease serine 2 [Cleaved into: Transmembrane protease serine 2 non-catalytic chain; Transmembrane protease serine 2 catalytic chain]. It participates in proteolysis and protein autoprocessing.

gene:HGNC:11876:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TMPRSS2 have been reported in prostate adenocarcinoma and neuroendocrine carcinoma of prostate.

gene:HGNC:11896:function.text: TNFAIP3 encodes tumor necrosis factor alpha-induced protein 3 [Cleaved into: A20p50; A20p37]. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and protein deubiquitination.

gene:HGNC:11896:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autoinflammatory syndrome, familial, Behcet-like 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11896:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TNFAIP3 have been reported in marginal zone lymphoma, classic Hodgkin lymphoma, and diffuse large b-cell lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11912:function.text: TNFRSF14 encodes tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 14. It participates in immune response and T cell costimulation.

gene:HGNC:11912:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TNFRSF14 have been reported in pediatric-type follicular lymphoma, primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma, and BCL2-rearrangement-negative, CD23-positive follicle center lymphoma.

gene:HGNC:11917:function.text: TNFRSF1B encodes tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 1B [Cleaved into: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 1b, membrane form; Tumor necrosis factor-binding protein 2]. It participates in activation of NF-kappaB-inducing kinase activity and inflammatory response.

gene:HGNC:11986:function.text: TOP1 encodes DNA topoisomerase 1. It participates in rRNA transcription and DNA replication.

gene:HGNC:11986:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TOP1 have been reported in basal cell carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11989:function.text: TOP2A encodes DNA topoisomerase 2-alpha. It participates in chromatin organization and chromosome segregation.

gene:HGNC:11989:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TOP2A have been reported in stomach adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11990:function.text: TOP2B encodes DNA topoisomerase II beta. Its functions include chromatin binding and DNA topoisomerase type II (double strand cut, ATP-hydrolyzing) activity.

gene:HGNC:11990:germline.text: Germline disease associations include B-cell immunodeficiency, distal limb anomalies, and urogenital malformations (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:11990:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TOP2B have been reported in medulloblastoma, colorectal carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17008:function.text: TOPBP1 encodes DNA topoisomerase 2-binding protein 1. It participates in DNA repair and homologous recombination.

gene:HGNC:11998:function.text: TP53 encodes the p53 transcription factor, a tumor suppressor that coordinates cellular stress responses through cell-cycle arrest, DNA repair, senescence, and apoptosis.

gene:HGNC:11998:germline.text: Germline pathogenic variants cause autosomal dominant Li-Fraumeni syndrome, which predisposes to a broad spectrum of cancers, notably early-onset breast cancer, sarcomas, central nervous system tumors, and adrenocortical carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:11998:somatic.text: Somatic TP53 mutations occur across many cancer types.

gene:HGNC:11999:function.text: TP53BP1 encodes TP53-binding protein 1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:15979:function.text: TP63 encodes tumor protein 63. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

gene:HGNC:15979:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with ectrodactyly, ectodermal dysplasia, and cleft lip-palate syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:15979:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TP63 have been reported in lung squamous cell carcinoma, esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, and melanoma.

gene:HGNC:12012:function.text: TPM3 encodes tropomyosin alpha-3 chain. It participates in muscle contraction and actin filament organization.

gene:HGNC:12012:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with TPM3-related myopathy (autosomal dominant); TPM3-related myopathy (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:12012:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TPM3 have been reported in ALK-positive histiocytosis, ALK-rearranged renal cell carcinoma, and NTRK-rearranged spindle cell neoplasm, malignant.

gene:HGNC:12017:function.text: TPR encodes nucleoprotein TPR. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and nucleocytoplasmic transport.

gene:HGNC:12017:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TPR have been reported in NTRK-rearranged spindle cell sarcoma of the uterine cervix / corpus and medulloblastoma.

gene:HGNC:14118:function.text: TPSD1 encodes tryptase delta 1. Its functions include serine-type endopeptidase activity and serine-type peptidase activity.

gene:HGNC:14118:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TPSD1 have been reported in low-grade glioma, colorectal carcinoma, and adrenocortical carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:17299:function.text: TPTE2 encodes transmembrane phosphoinositide 3-phosphatase and tensin homolog 2. Its functions include monoatomic ion channel activity and phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate 3-phosphatase activity.

gene:HGNC:17299:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TPTE2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12027:function.text: TRA encodes M1-specific T cell receptor alpha chain. It participates in adaptive immune response and T cell activation involved in immune response.

gene:HGNC:12032:function.text: TRAF2 encodes TNF receptor-associated factor 2. It participates in positive regulation of JUN kinase activity and signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:12033:function.text: TRAF3 encodes TNF receptor-associated factor 3. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:12033:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TRAF3 have been reported in plasma cell myeloma.

gene:HGNC:12035:function.text: TRAF5 encodes TNF receptor-associated factor 5. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:20456:function.text: TRAF7 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRAF7. It participates in apoptotic process and protein ubiquitination.

gene:HGNC:20456:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); cardiac, facial, and digital anomalies with developmental delay (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:20456:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TRAF7 have been reported in pleural mesothelioma.

gene:HGNC:29947:function.text: TRAK1 encodes trafficking kinesin-binding protein 1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and neurogenesis.

gene:HGNC:12155:function.text: TRB encodes M1-specific T cell receptor beta chain. It participates in adaptive immune response and T cell activation involved in immune response.

gene:HGNC:12271:function.text: TRG is the T-cell receptor gamma locus. Somatic variable-to-joining segment rearrangement contributes to the antigen-receptor repertoire of gamma-delta T cells.

gene:HGNC:16281:function.text: TRIM11 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRIM11. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and protein autoubiquitination.

gene:HGNC:9975:function.text: TRIM27 encodes zinc finger protein RFP. It participates in negative regulation of viral transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:9975:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TRIM27 have been reported in intraductal carcinoma of salivary gland.

gene:HGNC:16290:function.text: TRIM33 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRIM33. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:16290:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TRIM33 have been reported in ALK-positive histiocytosis.

gene:HGNC:7523:function.text: TRIM37 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRIM37. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and aggresome assembly.

gene:HGNC:7523:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with mulibrey nanism (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:27316:function.text: TRIM65 encodes tripartite motif containing 65. Its functions include protein domain specific binding and ubiquitin protein ligase activity.

gene:HGNC:27316:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TRIM65 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and lung squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12307:function.text: TRIP13 encodes pachytene checkpoint protein 2 homolog. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and oogenesis.

gene:HGNC:12307:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with oocyte maturation defect 9 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:12307:mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 3.

gene:HGNC:12327:function.text: TROAP encodes trophinin associated protein. Its functions include cell adhesion.

gene:HGNC:12327:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TROAP have been reported in low-grade glioma and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12340:function.text: TRPS1 encodes zinc finger transcription factor Trps1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:12340:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with trichorhinophalangeal syndrome type I (autosomal dominant); trichorhinophalangeal syndrome, type III (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:16060:function.text: TRUB1 encodes TruB pseudouridine synthase family member 1. Its functions include pre-miRNA binding and pseudouridine synthase activity.

gene:HGNC:16060:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TRUB1 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, pancreatic adenocarcinoma, and bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12362:function.text: TSC1 encodes hamartin. It participates in activation of GTPase activity and negative regulation of ATP-dependent activity.

gene:HGNC:12362:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with tuberous sclerosis 1 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:12362:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TSC1 have been reported in PEComa, malignant, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, and eosinophilic solid and cystic renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12363:function.text: TSC2 encodes tuberin. It participates in small GTPase-mediated signal transduction and regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction.

gene:HGNC:12363:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with tuberous sclerosis 2 (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:12363:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TSC2 have been reported in PEComa, malignant, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, and eosinophilic solid and cystic renal cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:29095:function.text: TSC22D2 encodes TSC22 domain family member 2. Its functions include negative regulation of cell cycle and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

gene:HGNC:29095:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TSC22D2 have been reported in breast carcinoma, cutaneous melanoma, and colorectal carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12373:function.text: TSHR encodes thyrotropin receptor. It participates in cell-cell signaling and hormone-mediated signaling pathway.

gene:HGNC:12373:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with familial gestational hyperthyroidism (autosomal dominant); hypothyroidism due to TSH receptor mutations (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:12373:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TSHR have been reported in colon adenocarcinoma and well-Differentiated thyroid cancer.

gene:HGNC:13476:function.text: TTYH1 encodes protein tweety homolog 1. It participates in chloride transport and L-glutamate transmembrane transport.

gene:HGNC:13476:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TTYH1 have been reported in embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes.

gene:HGNC:16691:function.text: TUBGCP4 encodes tubulin gamma complex component 4. Its functions include gamma-tubulin binding and structural constituent of cytoskeleton.

gene:HGNC:16691:germline.text: Germline disease associations include microcephaly and chorioretinopathy 3 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:16691:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TUBGCP4 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, esophageal carcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

gene:HGNC:18127:function.text: TUBGCP6 encodes tubulin gamma complex component 6. Its functions include gamma-tubulin binding and microtubule binding.

gene:HGNC:18127:germline.text: Germline disease associations include microcephaly and chorioretinopathy 1 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:18127:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TUBGCP6 have been reported in low-grade glioma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:12440:function.text: TYK2 encodes non-receptor tyrosine-protein kinase TYK2. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and cell differentiation.

gene:HGNC:12440:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 35 (autosomal recessive).

gene:HGNC:12453:function.text: U2AF1 encodes a component of the U2 auxiliary splicing factor that contributes to recognition of 3′ splice sites during pre-mRNA processing.

gene:HGNC:12453:somatic.text: Recurrent somatic U2AF1 mutations occur in myelodysplastic neoplasms.

gene:HGNC:23156:function.text: U2AF2 encodes splicing factor U2AF 65 kDa subunit). It participates in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and positive regulation of RNA splicing.

gene:HGNC:23156:germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with developmental delay, dysmorphic facies, and brain anomalies (autosomal dominant).

gene:HGNC:23156:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving U2AF2 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.

gene:HGNC:12476:function.text: UBE2D3 encodes ubiquitin conjugating enzyme E2 D3. Its functions include ubiquitin conjugating enzyme activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity.

gene:HGNC:12476:somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving UBE2D3 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and bladder urothelial carcinoma.

gene:HGNC:25009:function.text: UBE2T encodes ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme E2 T. It participates in DNA repair and protein autoubiquitination.
